            fn is_valid(_it: &'_ Self::CLayout) -> ::safer_ffi::ඞ::bool {
                let mut _ret = true;
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<&'a BinHeaderPs3>() != 0
                    && <&'a BinHeaderPs3 as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(
                        &_it.header,
                    ) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "header",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<&'a BinHeaderPs3>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.header),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.header),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<StringsRefPs3<'a>>() != 0
                    && <StringsRefPs3<
                        'a,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.strings) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "strings",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<StringsRefPs3<'a>>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.strings),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.strings),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, AssetHandlePs3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        AssetHandlePs3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.asset_handles)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "asset_handles",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    slice<'a, AssetHandlePs3>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<
                                            ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8,
                                        >(&_it.asset_handles),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.asset_handles),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<
                    Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                >() != 0
                    && <Map<
                        u32,
                        &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.model_data) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "model_data",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.model_data),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.model_data),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<
                    Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                >() != 0
                    && <Map<
                        u32,
                        &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.texture_data)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "texture_data",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.texture_data),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.texture_data),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                _ret
            }
        }
        impl Default for BinRefPc<'_> {
            fn default() -> Self {
                Self {
                    header: get_default_ref(),
                    strings: StringsRefPc::default(),
                    asset_handles: slice::default(),
                    model_data: MapImpl::default().into(),
                    texture_data: MapImpl::default().into(),
                }

        }

                Self {

        impl<'a> BinRefPc<'a> {
            pub fn from_data<'b: 'a, 'c: 'b>(
                src: &'c [u8],
                data: &'a mut BinCompressedData<'b>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = BinHeaderPc::from_data(src).context("header")?;
                let strings = StringsRefPc::from_data(
                        &src[header.strings_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.strings_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                let asset_handles = AssetHandlePc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[header.asset_handle_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.asset_handle_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("Bin headers in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let split = header.vdata_num.get() as usize;
                data.model_data = asset_handles
                    .iter()
                    .take(split)
                    .map(|info| (
                        info.key.get(),
                        CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                            &src[info.offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                            info.size.get() as usize,
                        ),
                    ))
                    .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                    .into();
                data.texture_data = asset_handles
                    .iter()
                    .skip(split)
                    .map(|info| (
                        info.key.get(),
                        CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                            &src[info.offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                            info.size.get() as usize,
                        ),
                    ))
                    .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                    .into();
                data.model_data
                    .par_values_mut()
                    .chain(data.texture_data.par_values_mut())
                    .try_for_each(|data| data.decompress())
                    .context("compressed data")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Bin compressed data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    header,
                    asset_handles: asset_handles.into(),
                    strings,
                    model_data: data
                        .model_data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                        .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                        .into(),
                    texture_data: data
                        .texture_data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                        .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                        .into(),
                })
            }
        }

        impl<'a> BinData<'a> {
            pub fn parse_pc(&'a mut self) -> Result<BinRefPc<'a>> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = BinHeaderPc::from_data(&self.data[..]).context("header")?;
                let strings = StringsRefPc::from_data(
                        &self.data[header.strings_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.strings_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                let asset_handles = AssetHandlePc::slice_from_data(
                        &self.data[header.asset_handle_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.asset_handle_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("Bin headers in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let mut raw_data = asset_handles
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| (
                        info.key.get(),
                        CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                            &self.data[info.offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.size.get() as usize,
                            info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                        ),
                    ));
                let split = header.vdata_num.get() as usize;
                let mut model_data = MapImpl::with_capacity(split);
                let mut texture_data = MapImpl::with_capacity(
                    asset_handles.len() - split,
                );
                for _ in 0..split {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    model_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                for _ in split..asset_handles.len() {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    texture_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                self.model_data = model_data.into();
                self.texture_data = texture_data.into();
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("Bin raw data in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                Ok(BinRefPc {
                    header,
                    asset_handles: asset_handles.into(),
                    strings,
                    model_data: self
                        .model_data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                        .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                        .into(),
                    texture_data: self
                        .texture_data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                        .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                        .into(),
                })
            }

            pub fn parse_ps3(&'a mut self) -> Result<BinRefPs3<'a>> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = BinHeaderPs3::from_data(&self.data[..]).context("header")?;
                let strings = StringsRefPs3::from_data(
                        &self.data[header.strings_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.strings_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                let asset_handles = AssetHandlePs3::slice_from_data(
                        &self.data[header.asset_handle_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.asset_handle_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("Bin headers in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let mut raw_data = asset_handles
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| (
                        info.key.get(),
                        CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                            &self.data[info.offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.size.get() as usize,
                            info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                        ),
                    ));
                let split = header.vdata_num.get() as usize;
                let mut model_data = MapImpl::with_capacity(split);
                let mut texture_data = MapImpl::with_capacity(
                    asset_handles.len() - split,
                );
                for _ in 0..split {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    model_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                for _ in split..asset_handles.len() {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    texture_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                self.model_data = model_data.into();
                self.texture_data = texture_data.into();
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("Bin raw data in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                Ok(BinRefPs3 {
                    header,
                    asset_handles: asset_handles.into(),
                    strings,
                    model_data: self
                        .model_data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                        .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                        .into(),
                    texture_data: self
                        .texture_data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                        .collect::<MapImpl<_, _>>()
                        .into(),
                })
            }
            pub fn parse(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
                self.model_data
                    .par_values_mut()
                    .chain(self.texture_data.par_values_mut())
                    .try_for_each(|x| x.decompress())
            }
        }
        impl<'a> BinRefPc<'a> {
            pub fn model_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                &self.asset_handles[..self.header.vdata_num.get() as usize]
            }
            pub fn texture_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                &self.asset_handles[self.header.vdata_num.get() as usize..]
            }
        }
        impl<'a> BinRefXbox<'a> {
            pub fn model_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandleXbox] {
                &self.asset_handles[..self.header.vdata_num.get() as usize]
            }
            pub fn texture_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandleXbox] {
                &self.asset_handles[self.header.vdata_num.get() as usize..]
            }
        }
        impl<'a> BinRefPs3<'a> {
            pub fn model_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePs3] {
                &self.asset_handles[..self.header.vdata_num.get() as usize]
            }
            pub fn texture_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePs3] {
                &self.asset_handles[self.header.vdata_num.get() as usize..]
            }
        }
        pub struct BinPc {
            _data: BufType,
            header: NonNull<BinHeaderPc>,
            strings: types::StringsPc,
            asset_handles: NonNull<[AssetHandlePc]>,
            model_data: IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
            texture_data: IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for BinPc {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                let names: &'static _ = &[
                    "_data",
                    "header",
                    "strings",
                    "asset_handles",
                    "model_data",
                    "texture_data",
                ];
                let values: &[&dyn ::core::fmt::Debug] = &[
                    &self._data,
                    &self.header,
                    &self.strings,
                    &self.asset_handles,
                    &self.model_data,
                    &&self.texture_data,
                ];
                ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_fields_finish(
                    f,
                    "BinPc",
                    names,
                    values,
                )
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for BinPc {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> BinPc {
                BinPc {
                    _data: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self._data),
                    header: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.header),
                    strings: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.strings),
                    asset_handles: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.asset_handles),
                    model_data: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.model_data),
                    texture_data: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.texture_data),
                }
            }
        }

        unsafe impl Sync for BinPc {}
        unsafe impl Sync for BinXbox {}
        unsafe impl Sync for BinPs3 {}
        unsafe impl Send for BinPc {}
        unsafe impl Send for BinXbox {}
        unsafe impl Send for BinPs3 {}
        impl BinPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(data: BufType) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = BinHeaderPc::from_data(&data).context("header")?;
                let strings = types::StringsPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        header.strings_offset.get() as usize,
                        header.strings_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                let asset_handles = AssetHandlePc::slice_from_data(
                        &data[header.asset_handle_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.asset_handle_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("Bin headers in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut raw_data = asset_handles
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| (
                        info.key.get(),
                        CompressedDataRef::from_bytes(
                            &data,
                            info.offset.get() as usize,
                            info.size.get() as usize,
                            info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                        ),
                    ));
                let split = header.vdata_num.get() as usize;
                let mut model_data = IndexMap::with_capacity(split);
                let mut texture_data = IndexMap::with_capacity(
                    asset_handles.len() - split,
                );
                for _ in 0..split {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    model_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                for _ in split..asset_handles.len() {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    texture_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                let header = NonNull::from_ref(header);
                let asset_handles = NonNull::from_ref(asset_handles);
                Ok(Self {
                    _data: data,
                    header,
                    asset_handles,
                    strings,
                    model_data,
                    texture_data,
                })
            }
        }

        impl BinPc {
            pub fn parse(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
                self.model_data
                    .par_values()
                    .chain(self.texture_data.par_values())
                    .try_for_each(|d| {
                        d.get()?;
                        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(())
                    })?;
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn header(&self) -> &BinHeaderPc {
                unsafe { self.header.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn strings(&self) -> &types::StringsPc {
                &self.strings
            }
            pub fn asset_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                unsafe { self.asset_handles.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn model_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                &self.asset_handles()[..self.header().vdata_num.get() as usize]
            }
            pub fn texture_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                &self.asset_handles()[self.header().vdata_num.get() as usize..]
            }
        }

        pub trait DumpBinPc {
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsPc;
            fn dump(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                model_data: &[(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                texture_data: &[(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                rad_data: Option<&(u32Pc, u32Pc, impl DumpCompressedData)>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = BinHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                dst.align(2048);
                header.constx06 = 0x6u32.conv();
                if true {
                    header.version = 1u32.conv();
                }
                if false {
                    header.version = 2u32.conv();
                }
                if false {
                    header.version = 3u32.conv();
                }
                let mut model_handles = Vec::with_capacity(model_data.len() + 1);
                for (key, kind, data) in model_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let (size, size_comp) = if let Some(data) = data {
                        data.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("dump model asset {0}", key),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(2048);
                        if (data.size() == 0) {
                            (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                        } else {
                            (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())
                        }
                    } else {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    };
                    model_handles
                        .push(AssetHandlePc {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                let mut texture_handles = Vec::with_capacity(texture_data.len());
                for (key, kind, data) in texture_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let (size, size_comp) = if let Some(data) = data {
                        data.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("dump texture asset {0}", key),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(2048);
                        if (data.size() == 0) {
                            (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                        } else {
                            (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())
                        }
                    } else {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    };
                    texture_handles
                        .push(AssetHandlePc {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                if let Some((key, kind, data)) = rad_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    data.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("dump radiosity asset {0}", key),
                            )
                        }))?;
                    dst.align(2048);
                    let (size, size_comp) = if (data.size() == 0) {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    } else {
                        (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())
                    };
                    model_handles
                        .push(AssetHandlePc {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                header.vdata_num = model_handles.len().conv();
                header.vdata_num_alt = header.vdata_num;
                header.texdata_num = texture_data.len().conv();
                header.asset_handle_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let asset_handles = AssetHandlePc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        model_handles.len() + texture_handles.len(),
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                header.asset_handle_num = asset_handles.len().conv();
                model_handles.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                texture_handles.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                (&mut asset_handles[..model_handles.len()])
                    .write_from(&model_handles)
                    .context("model asset handles")?;
                (&mut asset_handles[model_handles.len()..])
                    .write_from(&texture_handles)
                    .context("texture asset handles")?;
                let strings = self.strings();
                let off = dst.offset;
                header.strings_offset = off.conv();
                header.strings_num = strings.num_strings().conv();
                strings.dump_into(dst).context("strings")?;
                header.strings_size = (dst.offset - off).conv();
                dst.align(2048);
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(
                &self,
                model_data: &[(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                texture_data: &[(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                rad_data: Option<&(u32Pc, u32Pc, impl DumpCompressedData)>,
            ) -> usize {
                let mut size = align_offset(std::mem::size_of::<BinHeaderPc>(), 2048);
                for (_, _, data) in model_data {
                    if let Some(data) = data {
                        size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                    }
                }
                for (_, _, data) in texture_data {
                    if let Some(data) = data {
                        size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                    }
                }
                if let Some((_, _, data)) = rad_data {
                    size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                }
                size
                    += std::mem::size_of::<AssetHandlePc>()
                        * (model_data.len() + texture_data.len()
                            + if rad_data.is_some() { 1 } else { 0 });
                align_offset(size + self.strings().size(), 2048)
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpBinXbox {
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsXbox;
            fn dump(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                model_data: &[(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                texture_data: &[(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                rad_data: Option<&(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, impl DumpCompressedData)>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = BinHeaderXbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                dst.align(2048);
                header.constx06 = 0x6u32.conv();
                if false {
                    header.version = 1u32.conv();
                }
                if true {
                    header.version = 2u32.conv();
                }
                if false {
                    header.version = 3u32.conv();
                }

                        data.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("dump model asset {0}", key),
                                )

                            (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                        } else {
                            (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())

                    };

                        .push(AssetHandleXbox {

                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                let mut texture_handles = Vec::with_capacity(texture_data.len());
                for (key, kind, data) in texture_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let (size, size_comp) = if let Some(data) = data {

                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(

                        if (data.size() == 0) {
                            (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                        } else {
                            (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())

                    } else {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    };
                    texture_handles
                        .push(AssetHandleXbox {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                if let Some((key, kind, data)) = rad_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    data.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("dump radiosity asset {0}", key),
                            )
                        }))?;
                    dst.align(2048);
                    let (size, size_comp) = if (data.size() == 0) {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    } else {
                        (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())
                    };
                    model_handles
                        .push(AssetHandleXbox {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                header.vdata_num = model_handles.len().conv();
                header.vdata_num_alt = header.vdata_num;
                header.texdata_num = texture_data.len().conv();
                header.asset_handle_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let asset_handles = AssetHandleXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        model_handles.len() + texture_handles.len(),
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                header.asset_handle_num = asset_handles.len().conv();
                model_handles.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                texture_handles.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                (&mut asset_handles[..model_handles.len()])
                    .write_from(&model_handles)
                    .context("model asset handles")?;
                (&mut asset_handles[model_handles.len()..])
                    .write_from(&texture_handles)
                    .context("texture asset handles")?;
                let strings = self.strings();
                let off = dst.offset;
                header.strings_offset = off.conv();
                header.strings_num = strings.num_strings().conv();
                strings.dump_into(dst).context("strings")?;
                header.strings_size = (dst.offset - off).conv();
                dst.align(2048);
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(
                &self,
                model_data: &[(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                texture_data: &[(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                rad_data: Option<&(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, impl DumpCompressedData)>,
            ) -> usize {
                let mut size = align_offset(std::mem::size_of::<BinHeaderXbox>(), 2048);
                for (_, _, data) in model_data {
                    if let Some(data) = data {
                        size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                    }
                }
                for (_, _, data) in texture_data {
                    if let Some(data) = data {
                        size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                    }
                }
                if let Some((_, _, data)) = rad_data {
                    size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                }
                size
                    += std::mem::size_of::<AssetHandleXbox>()
                        * (model_data.len() + texture_data.len()
                            + if rad_data.is_some() { 1 } else { 0 });
                align_offset(size + self.strings().size(), 2048)
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpBinPs3 {
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsPs3;
            fn dump(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                model_data: &[(u32Ps3, u32Ps3, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                texture_data: &[(u32Ps3, u32Ps3, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                rad_data: Option<&(u32Ps3, u32Ps3, impl DumpCompressedData)>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = BinHeaderPs3::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                dst.align(2048);
                header.constx06 = 0x6u32.conv();
                if false {
                    header.version = 1u32.conv();
                }
                if false {
                    header.version = 2u32.conv();
                }
                if true {
                    header.version = 3u32.conv();
                }
                let mut model_handles = Vec::with_capacity(model_data.len() + 1);
                for (key, kind, data) in model_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let (size, size_comp) = if let Some(data) = data {
                        data.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("dump model asset {0}", key),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(2048);
                        if (data.size() == 0) {
                            (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                        } else {
                            (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())
                        }
                    } else {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    };
                    model_handles
                        .push(AssetHandlePs3 {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                let mut texture_handles = Vec::with_capacity(texture_data.len());
                for (key, kind, data) in texture_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let (size, size_comp) = if let Some(data) = data {
                        data.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("dump texture asset {0}", key),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(2048);
                        if (data.size() == 0) {
                            (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                        } else {
                            (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())
                        }
                    } else {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    };
                    texture_handles
                        .push(AssetHandlePs3 {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                if let Some((key, kind, data)) = rad_data {
                    let offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    data.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("dump radiosity asset {0}", key),
                            )
                        }))?;
                    dst.align(2048);
                    let (size, size_comp) = if (data.size() == 0) {
                        (0u32.conv(), 0u32.conv())
                    } else {
                        (data.size().conv(), data.size_comp().conv())
                    };
                    model_handles
                        .push(AssetHandlePs3 {
                            key: key.clone(),
                            offset,
                            size,
                            size_comp,
                            kind: kind.clone(),
                        })
                }
                header.vdata_num = model_handles.len().conv();
                header.vdata_num_alt = header.vdata_num;
                header.texdata_num = texture_data.len().conv();
                header.asset_handle_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let asset_handles = AssetHandlePs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        model_handles.len() + texture_handles.len(),
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                header.asset_handle_num = asset_handles.len().conv();
                model_handles.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                texture_handles.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                (&mut asset_handles[..model_handles.len()])
                    .write_from(&model_handles)
                    .context("model asset handles")?;
                (&mut asset_handles[model_handles.len()..])
                    .write_from(&texture_handles)
                    .context("texture asset handles")?;
                let strings = self.strings();
                let off = dst.offset;
                header.strings_offset = off.conv();
                header.strings_num = strings.num_strings().conv();
                strings.dump_into(dst).context("strings")?;
                header.strings_size = (dst.offset - off).conv();
                dst.align(2048);
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(
                &self,
                model_data: &[(u32Ps3, u32Ps3, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                texture_data: &[(u32Ps3, u32Ps3, Option<impl DumpCompressedData>)],
                rad_data: Option<&(u32Ps3, u32Ps3, impl DumpCompressedData)>,
            ) -> usize {
                let mut size = align_offset(std::mem::size_of::<BinHeaderPs3>(), 2048);
                for (_, _, data) in model_data {
                    if let Some(data) = data {
                        size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                    }
                }
                for (_, _, data) in texture_data {
                    if let Some(data) = data {
                        size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                    }
                }
                if let Some((_, _, data)) = rad_data {
                    size = align_offset(size + data.size_comp(), 2048);
                }
                size
                    += std::mem::size_of::<AssetHandlePs3>()
                        * (model_data.len() + texture_data.len()
                            + if rad_data.is_some() { 1 } else { 0 });
                align_offset(size + self.strings().size(), 2048)
            }
        }
        impl DumpBinPc for BinRefPc<'_> {
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsPc {
                &self.strings
            }
        }
        impl DumpBinXbox for BinRefXbox<'_> {
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsXbox {
                &self.strings
            }
        }
        impl DumpBinPs3 for BinRefPs3<'_> {
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsPs3 {
                &self.strings
            }
        }
    }

            impl std::str::FromStr for VertexUsage {
                type Err = anyhow::Error;
                fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
                    let string = s.to_lowercase();
                    let s = string.as_str();
                    match s {
                        "position" => Ok(Self::Position),
                        "normal" => Ok(Self::Normal),
                        "tangent" => Ok(Self::Tangent),
                        "blendweight" => Ok(Self::BlendWeight),
                        "blendindices" => Ok(Self::BlendIndices),
                        "psize" => Ok(Self::PSize),
                        s => {
                            if s.starts_with("color(") {
                                Ok(
                                    s[6..]
                                        .split(')')
                                        .next()
                                        .unwrap()
                                        .parse::<usize>()
                                        .map(|i| Self::Color(i))?,
                                )
                            } else if s.starts_with("texturecoord(") {
                                Ok(
                                    s[13..]
                                        .split(')')
                                        .next()
                                        .unwrap()
                                        .parse::<usize>()
                                        .map(|i| Self::TextureCoord(i))?,
                                )
                            } else if s.starts_with("pad(") {
                                Ok(
                                    s[4..]
                                        .split(')')
                                        .next()
                                        .unwrap()
                                        .parse::<usize>()
                                        .map(|i| Self::Pad(i))?,
                                )
                            } else {
                                Err(
                                    ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                format_args!("unknown vertex usage {0}", s),
                                            )
                                        }),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            fn parse_fmt(
                fmt1: u32,
                fmt2: u32,
            ) -> (usize, IndexMap<VertexUsage, VertexDataIndex>) {
                let mut vals = IndexMap::new();
                let mut s = 0;
                if fmt2 == 0 {
                    let b1: bool = (fmt1 & 0x40000) != 0;
                    if fmt1 & 1 != 0 {
                        if b1 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Position,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 16;
                        } else {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Position,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 12;
                        }
                    }
                    if (fmt1 & 0x400) != 0 {
                        if b1 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Pad(0),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                        } else {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::BlendWeight,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                        }
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if (fmt1 & 0x800) != 0 {
                        if b1 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Pad(1),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                        } else {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::BlendIndices,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                        }
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if (fmt1 & 2) != 0 {
                        let usage = VertexUsage::Normal;
                        if b1 {
                            let mut p = 2;
                            for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                                p += 1;
                            }
                            vals.insert(
                                usage,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 16;
                        } else {
                            vals.insert(
                                usage,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x100 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::Color(0),
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x200 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::Color(1),
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    for i in 0..((fmt1 >> 2) & 0xF) {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::TextureCoord(i as usize),
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: VECTOR2_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 8;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x40 != 0 {
                        let usage = VertexUsage::Tangent;
                        if b1 {
                            let mut p = 5;
                            for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                                p += 1;
                            }
                            vals.insert(
                                usage,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 16;
                        } else {
                            vals.insert(
                                usage,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x80 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::PSize,
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 12;
                    }
                    if b1 {
                        let mut p = 8;
                        for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                            p += 1;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    if fmt1 & 1 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::Position,
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 12;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x400 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::BlendWeight,
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x800 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::BlendIndices,
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 2 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::Normal,
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x100 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::Color(0),
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x200 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::Color(1),
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    let n = (fmt1 >> 2) & 0xf;
                    if n <= 2 {
                        for i in 0..n {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::TextureCoord(i as usize),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR2_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 8;
                        }
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x40 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::Tangent,
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: COLOR_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 4;
                    }
                    if fmt1 & 0x80 != 0 {
                        vals.insert(
                            VertexUsage::PSize,
                            VertexDataIndex {
                                key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                offset: s,
                            },
                        );
                        s += 12;
                    }
                }
                (s, vals)
            }

            pub struct VertexBuffer {
                pub info: VBuffInfo,
                pub vals: IndexMap<VertexUsage, VertexData>,
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::fmt::Debug for VertexBuffer {
                #[inline]
                fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                    ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field2_finish(
                        f,
                        "VertexBuffer",

                        &self.info,
                        "vals",
                        &&self.vals,
                    )
                }
            }

            impl ::core::clone::Clone for VertexBuffer {
                #[inline]
                fn clone(&self) -> VertexBuffer {
                    VertexBuffer {
                        info: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.info),
                        vals: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl VertexBuffer {
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals.first().map(|(_, x)| x.len()).unwrap_or(0)
                }
                pub fn v_size(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.size()).sum::<usize>()
                }
            }
            impl From<&VertexBufferPc> for VertexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &VertexBufferPc) -> Self {
                    let mut vals = IndexMap::with_capacity(val.offsets.len());
                    let val_iter = val.iter();
                    let size = val_iter.len();
                    for (k, v) in val.offsets.iter() {
                        vals.insert(
                            k.clone(),
                            match v.key {
                                INT_KEY => VertexData::Int(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                COLOR_KEY => VertexData::Color(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                VECTOR2_KEY => VertexData::Vector2(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                VECTOR3_KEY => VertexData::Vector3(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                VECTOR4_KEY => VertexData::Vector4(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                k => {
                                    ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                                        format_args!("Unhandled vertex data type {0}", k),
                                    );
                                }
                            },
                        );
                    }
                    for data in val_iter {
                        for (off, val) in val.offsets.values().zip(vals.values_mut()) {
                            match val {
                                VertexData::Int(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_int_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Color(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_color_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Vector2(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_vec2_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Vector3(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_vec3_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Vector4(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_vec4_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Self {
                        info: val.info().conv(),
                        vals,
                    }
                }
            }

            impl From<&IndexBufferPc> for IndexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &IndexBufferPc) -> Self {
                    if val.is_u32 {
                        Self::U32(
                            val.u32().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    } else {
                        Self::U16(
                            val.u16().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&IndexBufferXbox> for IndexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &IndexBufferXbox) -> Self {
                    if val.is_u32 {
                        Self::U32(
                            val.u32().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    } else {
                        Self::U16(
                            val.u16().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&IndexBufferPs3> for IndexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &IndexBufferPs3) -> Self {
                    if val.is_u32 {
                        Self::U32(
                            val.u32().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    } else {
                        Self::U16(
                            val.u16().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            impl IndexBuffer {
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    match self {
                        Self::U16(vals) => vals.len(),
                        Self::U32(vals) => vals.len(),
                    }
                }
            }
            pub struct VertexDataIter<'a> {
                data: &'a [u8],
                size: usize,
                offsets: &'a IndexMap<VertexUsage, VertexDataIndex>,
            }
            impl VertexDataIter<'_> {
                pub fn offsets(&self) -> &IndexMap<VertexUsage, VertexDataIndex> {
                    self.offsets
                }
                pub unsafe fn iter(&self) -> VertexDataIter<'_> {
                    VertexDataIter {
                        data: self.data.as_ref(),
                        size: self.size,
                        offsets: &self.offsets,
                    }
                }
            }
            impl<'a> Iterator for VertexDataIter<'a> {
                type Item = VertexValRef<'a>;
                fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
                    if self.size > self.data.len() {
                        None
                    } else {
                        let (val, data) = unsafe {
                            self.data.split_at_unchecked(self.size)
                        };
                        self.data = data;
                        Some(VertexValRef { data: val })
                    }
                }
                fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
                    let size = self.len();
                    (size, Some(size))
                }
            }
            impl ExactSizeIterator for VertexDataIter<'_> {
                fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.data.len() / self.size
                }
            }
            enum VertexDataIterPc<'a> {
                Int(&'a [u32Pc]),
                Color(&'a [ColorPc]),
                Vector2(&'a [Vector2Pc]),
                Vector3(&'a [Vector3Pc]),
                Vector4(&'a [Vector4Pc]),

            impl<'a> ModelDataRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(
                    src: &'a [u8],
                    info: &'a ModelInfoPc,
                    model_data: &Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    if let Some(model_data) = model_data.get(&info.asset_key.get()) {
                        let data = model_data.get();
                        let infos = BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("buffer infos")?;
                        let vbuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vbuff order")?;
                        let ibuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vbuff order")?;
                        let vbuffs = vbuff_order
                            .iter()
                            .map(|x| Ok((
                                x.get(),
                                VBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                        )
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                        let ibuffs = ibuff_order
                            .iter()
                            .map(|x| Ok((
                                x.get(),
                                IBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                        )
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                        let vertex = vbuffs
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(k, info)| Ok((
                                *k,
                                VertexBufferRefPc::from_data(data, info)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("vertex data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?
                            .into();
                        let index = ibuffs
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(k, info)| Ok((
                                *k,
                                IndexBufferRefPc::from_data(data, info)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("index data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?
                            .into();
                        Ok(Self {
                            infos: infos.into(),
                            vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                            ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                            vertex,
                            index,
                            data: Some(model_data),
                        })
                    } else if info.mat_num.get() == 0 && info.vbuff_num.get() == 0
                        && info.ibuff_num.get() == 0
                    {
                        Ok(Self::default())
                    } else {
                        Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing mesh data"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            impl<'a> ModelDataRefXbox<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(
                    src: &'a [u8],
                    info: &'a ModelInfoXbox,
                    model_data: &Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    if let Some(model_data) = model_data.get(&info.asset_key.get()) {
                        let data = model_data.get();
                        let infos = BufferInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("buffer infos")?;
                        let vbuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vbuff order")?;
                        let ibuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vbuff order")?;
                        let vbuffs = vbuff_order
                            .iter()
                            .map(|x| Ok((
                                x.get(),
                                VBuffInfoXbox::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                        )
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                        let ibuffs = ibuff_order
                            .iter()
                            .map(|x| Ok((
                                x.get(),
                                IBuffInfoXbox::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                        )
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                        let vertex = vbuffs
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(k, info)| Ok((
                                *k,
                                VertexBufferRefXbox::from_data(data, info)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("vertex data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?
                            .into();
                        let index = ibuffs
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(k, info)| Ok((
                                *k,
                                IndexBufferRefXbox::from_data(data, info)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("index data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?
                            .into();
                        Ok(Self {
                            infos: infos.into(),
                            vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                            ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                            vertex,
                            index,
                            data: Some(model_data),
                        })
                    } else if info.mat_num.get() == 0 && info.vbuff_num.get() == 0
                        && info.ibuff_num.get() == 0
                    {
                        Ok(Self::default())
                    } else {
                        Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing mesh data"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            impl ModelDataPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    src_info: &BufType,
                    info: &ModelInfoPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let infos = BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let vbuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src_info[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_order")?;
                    let ibuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src_info[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_order")?;
                    let vertex_offs: IndexMap<_, _> = vbuff_order
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, x)| (x.get(), i))
                        .collect();
                    let index_offs: IndexMap<_, _> = ibuff_order
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, x)| (x.get(), i))
                        .collect();
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        infos: infos.into(),
                        vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                        ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                        vertex: vertex_offs
                            .into_iter()
                            .map(|(k, off)| Ok((
                                k,
                                VertexBufferPc::from_bytes(src, src_info, off)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("vertex data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<_>>()?,
                        index: index_offs
                            .into_iter()
                            .map(|(k, off)| Ok((
                                k,
                                IndexBufferPc::from_bytes(src, src_info, off)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("index data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<_>>()?,
                    })
                }
            }
