            impl TryFrom<&ModelRawPc> for ModelDataPc {
                type Error = anyhow::Error;
                fn try_from(val: &ModelRawPc) -> Result<Self> {
                    let data = val.data.get().context("data")?;
                    let vertex = unsafe { val.vbuff_order.as_ref() }
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| Ok((
                            x.get(),
                            VertexBufferPc::from_bytes(
                                    &data,
                                    &val._ptr,
                                    x.get() as usize,
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("vertex data {0}", x.get()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let index = unsafe { val.ibuff_order.as_ref() }
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| Ok((
                            x.get(),
                            IndexBufferPc::from_bytes(&data, &val._ptr, x.get() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("index data {0}", x.get()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: val._ptr.clone(),
                        infos: val.buffer_infos,
                        vbuff_order: val.vbuff_order,
                        ibuff_order: val.ibuff_order,
                        vertex,
                        index,
                    })
                }
            }

            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::fmt::Debug for ModelData {
                #[inline]
                fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                    ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field2_finish(
                        f,
                        "ModelData",
                        "vertex",
                        &self.vertex,
                        "index",
                        &&self.index,
                    )
                }
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::clone::Clone for ModelData {
                #[inline]
                fn clone(&self) -> ModelData {
                    ModelData {
                        vertex: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vertex),
                        index: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.index),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&ModelDataPc> for ModelData {
                fn from(val: &ModelDataPc) -> Self {
                    Self {
                        vertex: val.vertex.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                        index: val.index.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&ModelDataXbox> for ModelData {
                fn from(val: &ModelDataXbox) -> Self {

                        vertex: val.vertex.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                        index: val.index.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&ModelDataPs3> for ModelData {
                fn from(val: &ModelDataPs3) -> Self {

                        index: val.index.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                    }
                }
            }

            }

            pub trait DumpBufferPc {

                fn has_vbuff_2(&self) -> bool;
                fn has_vbuff_3(&self) -> bool;
            }
            pub trait DumpBufferXbox {

                fn has_vbuff_3(&self) -> bool;
            }
            pub trait DumpBufferPs3 {
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut BufferInfoPs3) -> Result<()>;
                fn has_vbuff_2(&self) -> bool;
                fn has_vbuff_3(&self) -> bool;
            }
            pub trait DumpModelDataPc {
                type Data;
                fn vbuffs(&self) -> &IndexMap<u32, impl DumpVertexBufferPc>;
                fn ibuffs(&self) -> &IndexMap<u32, impl DumpIndexBufferPc>;
                fn buffers(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpBufferPc>;
                fn num_buffers(&self) -> usize;
                fn data(&self) -> Option<Self::Data>;
                fn add_size(
                    &self,
                    mut offset: usize,
                    counts: &mut InfoCounts,
                ) -> (usize, usize) {
                    let vbuff_num = self.vbuffs().len();
                    let ibuff_num = self.ibuffs().len();
                    counts.vbuffs += vbuff_num;
                    counts.ibuffs += ibuff_num;
                    for buffer in self.buffers() {
                        counts.buffers += 1;
                        counts.offsets += 2;
                        if buffer.has_vbuff_2() {
                            counts.offsets += 1;
                        }
                        if buffer.has_vbuff_3() {
                            counts.offsets += 2;
                        }
                    }
                    counts.offsets += vbuff_num + ibuff_num;
                    offset += (vbuff_num * 4);
                    (offset + (ibuff_num * 4), offset)
                }
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<Self::Data>,
                    info: &mut ModelInfoPc,
                ) -> Result<Option<Self::Data>> {
                    let mut buffer_offset = infos.buffers.offset;
                    let buffers = infos.buffers.next_slice(self.num_buffers());
                    let vbuffs = self.vbuffs();
                    let vbuff_offset = infos.vbuffs.offset;
                    let vbuff_infos = infos.vbuffs.next_slice(vbuffs.len());
                    let ibuffs = self.ibuffs();
                    let ibuff_offset = infos.ibuffs.offset;
                    let ibuff_infos = infos.ibuffs.next_slice(ibuffs.len());
                    let vbuff_map = vbuffs
                        .keys()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, x)| (
                            x,
                            (vbuff_offset + (i * std::mem::size_of::<VBuffInfoPc>()))
                                as u32,
                        ))
                        .collect::<IndexMap<_, _>>();
                    let ibuff_map = ibuffs
                        .keys()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, x)| (
                            x,
                            (ibuff_offset + (i * std::mem::size_of::<IBuffInfoPc>()))
                                as u32,
                        ))
                        .collect::<IndexMap<_, _>>();
                    for (info, vbuff) in vbuff_infos.iter_mut().zip(vbuffs.values()) {
                        vbuff.write_info(info).context("write vbuff info")?;
                    }
                    for (info, ibuff) in ibuff_infos.iter_mut().zip(ibuffs.values()) {
                        ibuff.write_info(info).context("write ibuff info")?;
                    }
                    for (info, buffer) in buffers.iter_mut().zip(self.buffers()) {
                        buffer.write_info(info).context("write buffer")?;
                        info.vbuff_info_offset = vbuff_map
                            .get(&info.vbuff_info_offset.get())
                            .copied()
                            .unwrap_or(0)
                            .conv();
                        info.vbuff_info_offset_2 = vbuff_map
                            .get(&info.vbuff_info_offset_2.get())
                            .copied()
                            .unwrap_or(0)
                            .conv();
                        info.vbuff_info_offset_3 = vbuff_map
                            .get(&info.vbuff_info_offset_3.get())
                            .copied()
                            .unwrap_or(0)
                            .conv();
                        info.ibuff_info_offset = ibuff_map
                            .get(&info.ibuff_info_offset.get())
                            .copied()
                            .unwrap_or(0)
                            .conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = (buffer_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(BufferInfoPc, vbuff_info_offset) })
                            .conv();
                        if info.vbuff_info_offset_2.get() != 0 {
                            *infos.offsets.next() = (buffer_offset
                                + {
                                    builtin # offset_of(BufferInfoPc, vbuff_info_offset_2)
                                })
                                .conv();
                        }
                        if info.vbuff_info_offset_3.get() != 0 {
                            *infos.offsets.next() = (buffer_offset
                                + {
                                    builtin # offset_of(BufferInfoPc, vbuff_info_offset_3)
                                })
                                .conv();
                        }
                        *infos.offsets.next() = (buffer_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(BufferInfoPc, ibuff_info_offset) })
                            .conv();
                        buffer_offset += std::mem::size_of::<BufferInfoPc>();
                    }
                    info.vbuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    info.vbuff_num = vbuff_map.len().conv();
                    let mut off = dst.offset;
                    let vbuff_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, vbuffs.len())
                        .context("vbuff_order")?;
                    for (dst, src) in vbuff_order.iter_mut().zip(vbuff_map.keys()) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                        off += 4;
                    }
                    info.ibuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    info.ibuff_num = ibuff_map.len().conv();
                    let mut off = dst.offset;
                    let ibuff_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, ibuffs.len())
                        .context("ibuff_order")?;
                    for (dst, src) in ibuff_order.iter_mut().zip(ibuff_map.keys()) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                        off += 4;
                    }
                    Ok(self.data())
                }
            }

        pub mod mat {
            use anyhow::{Context, Result};
            use std::ptr::NonNull;
            use crate::{
                level::pak::objs::DumpInfosPc, types::{u32Pc, CrcPc, u8Pc, u16Pc, u64Pc},
            };
            use crate::{
                level::pak::objs::DumpInfosXbox,
                types::{u32Xbox, CrcXbox, u8Xbox, u16Xbox, u64Xbox},
            };
            use crate::{
                level::pak::objs::DumpInfosPs3,
                types::{u32Ps3, CrcPs3, u8Ps3, u16Ps3, u64Ps3},
            };
            use crate::types::{
                Crc, RefFromData, OrderedData, OrderedDataStrict, BufType, DumpData,
                DumpCompressedData,
            };
            use crate::level::pak::objs::InfoCounts;
            use lotrc_proc::{make_platforms, OrderedData};
            pub struct MatBase {
                pub unk_0: u32,
                #[ordered_data(skipPS3)]
                pub unk_1: u32,
                pub tex0: Crc,

            impl<'a> MatRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let base = MatBasePc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("base")?;
                    let extra = if base.mat_extra_offset.get() != 0 {
                        Some(
                            MatExtraPc::from_data(
                                    &src[base.mat_extra_offset.get() as usize..],
                                )
                                .context("extra")?,
                        )
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    Ok(
                        match base.kind.get() {
                            0 => {
                                Self::Mat1(
                                    Mat1Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat1")?,
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            1 => {
                                Self::Mat4(
                                    Mat4Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat4")?,
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            2 => {
                                Self::Mat2(
                                    Mat2Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat2")?,
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            3 => {
                                Self::Mat3(
                                    Mat3Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat3")?,
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            _ => {
                                return Err(
                                    ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                format_args!("Unknown Mat Type {0}", base.kind.get()),
                                            )
                                        }),
                                    ),
                                );
                            }
                        },
                    )
                }
            }

                    let base = MatBasePc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("base")?;
                    let extra = if base.mat_extra_offset.get() != 0 {

                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                MatExtraPc::from_data(

                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            1 => {
                                Self::Mat4(
                                    Mat4Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat4")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )

                            3 => {

                            MatRefPc::Mat1(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat2(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPc::Mat2(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat3(mat, extra) => {

                        match base.kind.get() {
                            0 => {
                                Self::Mat1(
                                    Mat1Ps3::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat1")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            1 => {
                                Self::Mat4(
                                    Mat4Ps3::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat4")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            2 => {
                                Self::Mat2(
                                    Mat2Ps3::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat2")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            3 => {
                                Self::Mat3(
                                    Mat3Ps3::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat3")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            _ => {
                                return Err(
                                    ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                format_args!("Unknown Mat Type {0}", base.kind.get()),
                                            )
                                        }),
                                    ),
                                );
                            }
                        },
                    )
                }
                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> MatRefPs3<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Mat1(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPs3::Mat1(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat2(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPs3::Mat2(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat3(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPs3::Mat3(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat4(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPs3::Mat4(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

                    match self {
                        Self::Mat1(info, extra) => {
                            let val = infos.mat1s.offset;
                            let mat = infos.mat1s.next();
                            mat.write_from(info)?;
                            mat.base.mat_extra_offset = extra
                                .map(|_| infos.mat_extras.offset as u32)
                                .unwrap_or_default()
                                .conv();
                            if let Some(extra) = extra {
                                infos.mat_extras.next().write_from(extra)?;
                                *infos.offsets.next() = (val
                                    + { builtin # offset_of(Mat1Pc, base) }
                                    + { builtin # offset_of(MatBasePc, mat_extra_offset) })
                                    .conv();
                            }
                            Ok(val as u32)

            impl<'a> ShapeRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], info: &'a ShapeInfoPc) -> Result<Self> {
                    let extra = if info.kind.get() == 0 {
                        Some(ShapeExtraRefPc::from_data(src, info).context("extra")?)
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    let infos = HkShapeInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.hk_shape_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.hk_shape_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_shape infos")?;
                    let hk_shapes = infos
                        .into_iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, info)| {
                            HkShapeRefPc::from_data(src, info)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                        .into_boxed_slice();
                    Ok(Self {
                        info,
                        extra,
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                    })
                }
            }

            impl ShapePc {
                pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                    let extra = if info.kind.get() == 0 {
                        Some(ShapeExtraPc::from_bytes(src, info).context("extra")?)
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    let off = info.hk_shape_offset.get() as usize;
                    let hk_shapes = (0..info.hk_shape_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkShapePc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    off + i * HkShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        extra,
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                    })
                }
                pub fn get(&self, index: usize) -> Option<HkShapeRefPc<'_>> {
                    self.hk_shapes.get(index).map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() })
                }
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.hk_shapes.len()
                }
            }
            impl ShapeXbox {
                pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeInfoXbox::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                    let extra = if info.kind.get() == 0 {
                        Some(ShapeExtraXbox::from_bytes(src, info).context("extra")?)
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    let off = info.hk_shape_offset.get() as usize;
                    let hk_shapes = (0..info.hk_shape_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkShapeXbox::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    off + i * HkShapeInfoXbox::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        extra,
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                    })
                }
                pub fn get(&self, index: usize) -> Option<HkShapeRefXbox<'_>> {
                    self.hk_shapes.get(index).map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() })
                }
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.hk_shapes.len()
                }
            }

            pub struct ShapeExtraDumpPc<'a> {
                info: &'a mut ShapeExtraInfoPc,
                offs: &'a mut [u32Pc],
                data: &'a mut [u8],
            }
            pub struct ShapeExtraDumpXbox<'a> {
                info: &'a mut ShapeExtraInfoXbox,
                offs: &'a mut [u32Xbox],
                data: &'a mut [u8],
            }
            pub struct ShapeExtraDumpPs3<'a> {
                info: &'a mut ShapeExtraInfoPs3,
                offs: &'a mut [u32Ps3],
                data: &'a mut [u8],
            }
            impl<'a> ShapeExtraDumpPc<'a> {
                fn from_bytes(
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    sizes: (usize, usize),
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeExtraInfoPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("info")?;
                    let offs = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.0).context("offs")?;
                    let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.1).context("data")?;
                    Ok(Self { info, offs, data })
                }
            }
            impl<'a> ShapeExtraDumpXbox<'a> {
                fn from_bytes(
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    sizes: (usize, usize),
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeExtraInfoXbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("info")?;
                    let offs = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.0)
                        .context("offs")?;
                    let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.1).context("data")?;
                    Ok(Self { info, offs, data })
                }
            }
            impl<'a> ShapeExtraDumpPs3<'a> {
                fn from_bytes(
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    sizes: (usize, usize),
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeExtraInfoPs3::mut_from_data(dst).context("info")?;
                    let offs = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.0)
                        .context("offs")?;
                    let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.1).context("data")?;
                    Ok(Self { info, offs, data })
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpShapeExtraPc {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize);
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                    let vals = ShapeExtraDumpPc::from_bytes(dst, self.get_sizes())
                        .context("vals")?;
                    self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize) -> usize {
                    let sizes = self.get_sizes();
                    offset
                        += ShapeExtraInfoPc::size_of() + sizes.0 * u32Pc::size_of()
                            + sizes.1;
                    offset
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpShapeExtraXbox {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize);
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpXbox) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                    let vals = ShapeExtraDumpXbox::from_bytes(dst, self.get_sizes())
                        .context("vals")?;

                }
            }

            impl DumpShapeExtraPc for ShapeExtraRefPc<'_> {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    vals.info.write_from(self.info).context("info")?;
                    vals.offs.write_from(&self.offs[..]).context("offs")?;
                    vals.data.write_from(&self.data[..]).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpShapeExtraXbox for ShapeExtraRefXbox<'_> {

                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }

                    vals.info.write_from(self.info).context("info")?;
                    vals.offs.write_from(&self.offs[..]).context("offs")?;
                    vals.data.write_from(&self.data[..]).context("data")?;

            impl DumpShapeExtraPc for &ShapeExtra {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    *vals.info = (&self.info).conv();
                    for (src, dst) in self.offs.iter().zip(vals.offs) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    vals.data.write_from(&self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpShapeExtraXbox for &ShapeExtra {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {

                    }
                    vals.data.write_from(&self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }

            pub trait DumpShapePc {
                fn extra(&self) -> Option<impl DumpShapeExtraPc>;
                fn has_hk_shapes(&self) -> bool;
                fn hk_shapes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpHkShapePc>;
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut ShapeInfoPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into<D>(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<D>,
                    extra_off: Option<usize>,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    let info_offset = infos.shapes.offset;
                    let info = infos.shapes.next();
                    self.write_info(info).context("info")?;
                    if let Some(off) = extra_off {
                        info.offset = off.conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = (info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(ShapeInfoPc, offset) })
                            .conv();
                    }
                    if self.has_hk_shapes() {
                        info.hk_shape_offset = infos.hk_shapes.offset.conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = (info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(ShapeInfoPc, hk_shape_offset) })
                            .conv();
                    }
                    for (i, shape) in self.hk_shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, infos: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                    infos.shapes += 1;
                    if let Some(extra) = self.extra() {
                        offset = extra.add_size(offset);
                        infos.offsets += 1;
                    }
                    if self.has_hk_shapes() {
                        infos.offsets += 1;
                    }
                    for shape in self.hk_shapes() {
                        offset = shape.add_size(offset, infos);
                    }
                    offset
                }
            }

                pub tree_offset: u32,
                pub vert_num: u32,
                pub verts_offset: u32,
                pub tri_num: u32,
                pub inds_offset: u32,
            }

                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> HkShapeRefPc<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Box(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Sphere(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Capsule(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Cylinder(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, norms, verts } => {
                            HkShapeRefPc::ConvexVertices(ConvexVerticesRefPc {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                norms: norms.as_ref().into(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref().into(),
                            })
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, tree, verts, inds } => {
                            HkShapeRefPc::BVTreeMesh(BVTreeMeshRefPc {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                tree: tree.as_ref().into(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref().into(),
                                inds: inds.as_ref().into(),
                            })
                        }
                        Self::Unknown(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Unknown(info.as_ref()),
                    }
                }
            }

                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> HkShapeRefXbox<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Box(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Sphere(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Capsule(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Cylinder(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, norms, verts } => {
                            HkShapeRefXbox::ConvexVertices(ConvexVerticesRefXbox {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                norms: norms.as_ref().into(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref().into(),
                            })
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, tree, verts, inds } => {
                            HkShapeRefXbox::BVTreeMesh(BVTreeMeshRefXbox {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                tree: tree.as_ref().into(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref().into(),
                                inds: inds.as_ref().into(),
                            })
                        }
                        Self::Unknown(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Unknown(info.as_ref()),
                    }
                }
            }

                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> HkShapeRefPs3<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Box(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Sphere(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Capsule(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Cylinder(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, norms, verts } => {
                            HkShapeRefPs3::ConvexVertices(ConvexVerticesRefPs3 {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                norms: norms.as_ref().into(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref().into(),
                            })
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, tree, verts, inds } => {
                            HkShapeRefPs3::BVTreeMesh(BVTreeMeshRefPs3 {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                tree: tree.as_ref().into(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref().into(),
                                inds: inds.as_ref().into(),
                            })
                        }
                        Self::Unknown(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Unknown(info.as_ref()),
                    }
                }

            pub enum HkShape {
                Box(BoxShape),
                Sphere(SphereShape),
                Capsule(CapsuleShape),
                Cylinder(CylinderShape),
                ConvexVertices {
                    info: ConvexVerticesInfo,
                    norms: Vec<Vector4>,
                    verts: Vec<Vector3>,
                },
                BVTreeMesh {
                    info: BVTreeMeshInfo,
                    tree: Vec<u8>,
                    verts: Vec<Vector3>,
                    inds: Vec<u16>,
                },
                Unknown(HkShapeInfo),
            }

                            BVTreeMeshRefPs3 { info, tree, verts, inds },
                        ) => {
                            HkShape::BVTreeMesh {
                                info: info.conv(),
                                tree: tree.iter().cloned().collect(),
                                verts: verts.iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                                inds: inds.iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                            }
                        }
                        HkShapeRefPs3::Unknown(info) => HkShape::Unknown(info.conv()),
                    }
                }
            }
            pub enum HkShapeDumpPc<'a> {
                ConvexVertices {
                    norms: &'a mut [Vector4Pc],
                    verts: &'a mut [Vector3Pc],
                },
                BVTreeMesh {
                    tree: &'a mut [u8],
                    verts: &'a mut [Vector3Pc],
                    inds: &'a mut [u16Pc],
                },
                None,
            }

                                            if false {
                                                u = unsafe {
                                                    #[allow(
                                                        clippy::useless_transmute,
                                                        clippy::missing_transmute_annotations
                                                    )]
                                                    ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::core_reexport::mem::transmute(
                                                        t,
                                                    )
                                                };
                                            } else {
                                                loop {}
                                            }
                                        };
                                        {
                                            if false {
                                                let align_of: ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::AlignOf<_> = ::core::panicking::panic(
                                                    "internal error: entered unreachable code",
                                                );
                                                t = align_of.into_t();
                                                let mut max_aligns = ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::MaxAlignsOf::new(
                                                    t,
                                                    u,
                                                );
                                                max_aligns = unsafe {
                                                    #[allow(clippy::missing_transmute_annotations)]
                                                    ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::core_reexport::mem::transmute(
                                                        align_of,
                                                    )
                                                };
                                            } else {
                                                loop {}
                                            }
                                        };
                                        &mut u
                                    } else {
                                        let u = unsafe {
                                            ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::transmute_mut(e)
                                        };
                                        ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::must_use(u)
                                    }
                                };
                                info.verts_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                                let verts = Vector3Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.0)
                                    .context("verts")?;
                                info.vert_num = verts.len().conv();
                                info.inds_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                                let inds = u16Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.1)
                                    .context("inds")?;
                                info.tri_num = (inds.len() / 3).conv();
                                dst.align(4);
                                info.tree_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                                let tree = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.2)
                                    .context("tree")?;
                                info.tree_size = tree.len().conv();
                                dst.align(4);
                                Self::BVTreeMesh {
                                    tree,
                                    verts,
                                    inds,
                                }
                            }
                            _ => Self::None,
                        },
                    )
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpHkShapePc {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32;
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize);
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkShapeInfoPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                    counts.hk_shapes += 1;
                    match self.kind() {
                        5 => {
                            counts.offsets += 2;
                            let sizes = self.get_sizes();
                            offset = align_offset(offset, 16);
                            offset += sizes.0 * Vector4Pc::size_of();
                            offset += sizes.1 * Vector3Pc::size_of();
                        }
                        6 => {
                            counts.offsets += 3;
                            let sizes = self.get_sizes();
                            offset += sizes.0 * Vector3Pc::size_of();
                            offset += sizes.1 * u16Pc::size_of();
                            offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                            offset += sizes.2;
                            offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    offset
                }
                fn dump_into<D>(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<D>,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    let info_off = infos.hk_shapes.offset;
                    let info = infos.hk_shapes.next();
                    self.write_info(info).context("write info")?;
                    let vals = HkShapeDumpPc::from_bytes(dst, self.get_sizes(), info)
                        .context("vals")?;
                    self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
                    match self.kind() {
                        5 => {
                            *infos.offsets.next() = ((info_off
                                + {
                                    builtin # offset_of(ConvexVerticesInfoPc, norms_offset)
                                }) as u32)
                                .conv();
                            *infos.offsets.next() = ((info_off
                                + {
                                    builtin # offset_of(ConvexVerticesInfoPc, verts_offset)
                                }) as u32)
                                .conv();
                        }
                        6 => {
                            *infos.offsets.next() = ((info_off
                                + { builtin # offset_of(BVTreeMeshInfoPc, verts_offset) })
                                as u32)
                                .conv();
                            *infos.offsets.next() = ((info_off
                                + { builtin # offset_of(BVTreeMeshInfoPc, inds_offset) })
                                as u32)
                                .conv();
                            *infos.offsets.next() = ((info_off
                                + { builtin # offset_of(BVTreeMeshInfoPc, tree_offset) })
                                as u32)
                                .conv();
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

            impl DumpHkShapePc for &HkShapeRefPc<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShapeRefPc::Box(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPc::Sphere(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPc::Capsule(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPc::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPc::ConvexVertices(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPc::BVTreeMesh(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPc::Unknown(info) => info.kind.get(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShapeRefPc::ConvexVertices(
                            ConvexVerticesRefPc { info, verts, norms },
                        ) => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShapeRefPc::BVTreeMesh(
                            BVTreeMeshRefPc { tree, verts, inds, .. },
                        ) => (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len()),
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                    match self {

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShapeRefPc::ConvexVertices(
                                ConvexVerticesRefPc { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPc::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            HkShapeRefPc::BVTreeMesh(
                                BVTreeMeshRefPc { verts: src1, inds: src2, tree: src3, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPc::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapeXbox for &HkShapeRefXbox<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShapeRefXbox::Box(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefXbox::Sphere(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefXbox::Capsule(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefXbox::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefXbox::ConvexVertices(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefXbox::BVTreeMesh(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefXbox::Unknown(info) => info.kind.get(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShapeRefXbox::ConvexVertices(
                            ConvexVerticesRefXbox { info, verts, norms },
                        ) => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShapeRefXbox::BVTreeMesh(
                            BVTreeMeshRefXbox { tree, verts, inds, .. },
                        ) => (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len()),
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpXbox) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShapeRefXbox::ConvexVertices(
                                ConvexVerticesRefXbox { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            HkShapeRefXbox::BVTreeMesh(
                                BVTreeMeshRefXbox {
                                    verts: src1,
                                    inds: src2,
                                    tree: src3,
                                    ..
                                },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapePs3 for &HkShapeRefPs3<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShapeRefPs3::Box(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPs3::Sphere(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPs3::Capsule(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPs3::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPs3::ConvexVertices(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPs3::BVTreeMesh(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        HkShapeRefPs3::Unknown(info) => info.kind.get(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShapeRefPs3::ConvexVertices(
                            ConvexVerticesRefPs3 { info, verts, norms },
                        ) => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShapeRefPs3::BVTreeMesh(
                            BVTreeMeshRefPs3 { tree, verts, inds, .. },
                        ) => (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len()),
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                                } else {
                                    let u = unsafe {
                                        ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::transmute_ref(e)
                                    };
                                    ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::must_use(u)
                                }
                            })
                        }
                        HkShapeRefPs3::Unknown(src) => info.write_from(src),
                    }
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShapeRefPs3::ConvexVertices(
                                ConvexVerticesRefPs3 { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            HkShapeRefPs3::BVTreeMesh(
                                BVTreeMeshRefPs3 { verts: src1, inds: src2, tree: src3, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => info.kind.get(),

                        Self::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::ConvexVertices(val) => val.info.kind.get(),

                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.get() as usize,

                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())

                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            Self::ConvexVertices(
                                ConvexVerticesRefPc { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPc::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            Self::BVTreeMesh(
                                BVTreeMeshRefPc { verts: src1, inds: src2, tree: src3, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPc::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapeXbox for HkShapeRefXbox<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::ConvexVertices(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        Self::BVTreeMesh(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Unknown(info) => info.kind.get(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        Self::ConvexVertices(
                            ConvexVerticesRefXbox { info, verts, norms },
                        ) => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh(BVTreeMeshRefXbox { tree, verts, inds, .. }) => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                    match self {

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpXbox) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            Self::ConvexVertices(
                                ConvexVerticesRefXbox { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            Self::BVTreeMesh(
                                BVTreeMeshRefXbox {
                                    verts: src1,
                                    inds: src2,
                                    tree: src3,
                                    ..
                                },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapePs3 for HkShapeRefPs3<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.get(),
                        Self::ConvexVertices(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        Self::BVTreeMesh(val) => val.info.kind.get(),
                        Self::Unknown(info) => info.kind.get(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        Self::ConvexVertices(
                            ConvexVerticesRefPs3 { info, verts, norms },
                        ) => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh(BVTreeMeshRefPs3 { tree, verts, inds, .. }) => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            Self::ConvexVertices(
                                ConvexVerticesRefPs3 { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            Self::BVTreeMesh(
                                BVTreeMeshRefPs3 { verts: src1, inds: src2, tree: src3, .. },
                            ),
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapePc for &HkShape {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::Box(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Sphere(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Capsule(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Cylinder(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Unknown(info) => info.kind,
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkShapeInfoPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match self {

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShape::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPc::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                        }
                        (
                            HkShape::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: src1,
                                inds: src2,
                                tree: src3,
                                ..
                            },
                            HkShapeDumpPc::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapeXbox for &HkShape {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::Box(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Sphere(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Capsule(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Cylinder(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Unknown(info) => info.kind,
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpXbox) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShape::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                        }
                        (
                            HkShape::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: src1,
                                inds: src2,
                                tree: src3,
                                ..
                            },
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapePs3 for &HkShape {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::Box(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Sphere(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Capsule(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Cylinder(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Unknown(info) => info.kind,
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShape::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                        }
                        (
                            HkShape::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: src1,
                                inds: src2,
                                tree: src3,
                                ..
                            },
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

            impl<'a> HkConstraintRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = HkConstraintInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..])
                        .context("info")?;
                    if info.kind.get() != 0 {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!(
                                            "Unknown & Unhandled HkConstraint type {0}",
                                            info.kind,
                                        ),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                            "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                    }
                    let bone_parents = i16Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_parents_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_parents_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bone_parents")?;
                    if !(bone_parents[0].get() == -1) {
                        {
                            ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                                format_args!(
                                    "first bone should be root node with no parent",
                                ),
                            );
                        }
                    }
                    let name_offsets = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_names_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_names_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("name_offsets")?;
                    let mut bone_names = Vec::with_capacity(name_offsets.len());
                    for offset_ in name_offsets.iter() {
                        let start = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset_.get() as usize..])
                            .context("start")?;
                        let val_ = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset_.get() as usize + 4..])
                            .context("val_")?;
                        let mut offset = start.get() as usize;
                        while src[offset] != 0 {
                            offset += 1;
                        }
                        bone_names
                            .push((
                                str::from_utf8(&src[start.get() as usize..offset])
                                    .context("string")?
                                    .into(),
                                *start,
                                *val_,
                            ));
                    }
                    let bone_transforms = TRSPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_transforms_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_transforms_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bone_tranforms")?;
                    let bones = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bones_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bones_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let bones_order = Key2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_order_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let vals2 = f32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.vals2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.vals2_num.get() as usize * 42,
                        )
                        .context("vals2")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        info: info,
                        bone_parents: bone_parents.into(),
                        bone_names: bone_names.into_boxed_slice().into(),
                        name_offsets: name_offsets.into(),
                        bone_transforms: bone_transforms.into(),
                        bones: bones.into(),
                        bones_order: bones_order.into(),
                        vals2: vals2.into(),
                    })
                }
            }
