            impl HkConstraintPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = HkConstraintInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..])
                        .context("info")?;
                    if info.kind.get() != 0 {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!(
                                            "Unknown & Unhandled HkConstraint type {0}",
                                            info.kind,
                                        ),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                            "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                    }
                    let bone_parents = i16Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_parents_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_parents_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bone_parents")?;
                    if !(bone_parents[0].get() == -1) {
                        ::core::panicking::panic(
                            "assertion failed: bone_parents[0].get() == -1",
                        )
                    }
                    let name_offsets = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_names_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_names_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("name_offsets")?;
                    let mut bone_names = Vec::with_capacity(name_offsets.len());
                    for offset_ in name_offsets.iter() {
                        let start = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset_.get() as usize..])
                            .context("start")?;
                        let val_ = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset_.get() as usize + 4..])
                            .context("val_")?;
                        let mut offset = start.get() as usize;
                        while src[offset] != 0 {
                            offset += 1;
                        }
                        bone_names
                            .push((
                                NonNull::from_ref(
                                    str::from_utf8(&src[start.get() as usize..offset])
                                        .context("string")?,
                                ),
                                *start,
                                *val_,
                            ));
                    }
                    let bone_transforms = TRSPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_transforms_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_transforms_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bone_tranforms")?;
                    let bones = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bones_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bones_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let bones_order = Key2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.bone_order_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let vals2 = f32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.vals2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.vals2_num.get() as usize * 42,
                        )
                        .context("vals2")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        bone_parents: bone_parents.into(),
                        bone_names: bone_names.into(),
                        name_offsets: name_offsets.into(),
                        bone_transforms: bone_transforms.into(),
                        bones: bones.into(),
                        bones_order: bones_order.into(),
                        vals2: vals2.into(),
                    })
                }
            }

            pub trait DumpHkConstraintPc {
                fn bone_names_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_transforms_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_order_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_parents_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals2_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_names(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str>;
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkConstraintInfoPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_transforms(
                    &self,
                    bone_transforms: &mut [TRSPc],
                ) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_order(&self, bone_order: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_parents(&self, bone_parents: &mut [i16Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_name_vals<'a>(
                    &self,
                    vals: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut u32Pc>,
                );
                fn write_vals2(&self, vals2: &mut [f32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into<D>(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<D>,
                    bones_num: u16,
                    bones_offset: u32,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    let info_off = infos.hk_constraints.offset;
                    let info = infos.hk_constraints.next();
                    self.write_info(info).context("write info")?;
                    info.bones_num = bones_num.conv();
                    info.bones_offset = bones_offset.conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(HkConstraintInfoPc, bones_offset) })
                        .conv();
                    info.bone_names_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(HkConstraintInfoPc, bone_names_offset) })
                        .conv();
                    let mut name_off = dst.offset;
                    let name_offsets = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_names_num(),
                        )
                        .context("name_offsets")?;
                    let mut string_off = dst.offset;
                    let string_offs = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            name_offsets.len() * 2,
                        )
                        .context("string_offs")?;
                    info.bone_names_num = name_offsets.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + {
                            builtin # offset_of(
                                HkConstraintInfoPc, bone_transforms_offset
                            )
                        })
                        .conv();
                    let bone_transforms = TRSPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_transforms_num(),
                        )
                        .context("bone_transforms")?;
                    info.bone_transforms_num = bone_transforms.len().conv();
                    self.write_bone_transforms(bone_transforms)
                        .context("write bone_transforms")?;
                    info.bone_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(HkConstraintInfoPc, bone_order_offset) })
                        .conv();
                    let bone_order = Key2Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_order_num(),
                        )
                        .context("bone_order")?;
                    info.bone_order_num = bone_order.len().conv();
                    self.write_bone_order(bone_order).context("write bone_order")?;
                    info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + {
                            builtin # offset_of(HkConstraintInfoPc, bone_parents_offset)
                        })
                        .conv();
                    let bone_parents = i16Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_parents_num(),
                        )
                        .context("bone_parents")?;
                    info.bone_parents_num = bone_parents.len().conv();
                    self.write_bone_parents(bone_parents).context("write bone_parents")?;
                    dst.align(4);
                    self.write_bone_name_vals(string_offs.iter_mut().skip(1).step_by(2));
                    for (i, string) in self.bone_names().enumerate() {
                        let s = string.as_bytes();
                        let off = string_off + i * 2 * size_of::<u32Pc>();
                        name_offsets[i] = off.conv();
                        string_offs[i * 2] = dst.offset.conv();
                        s.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string: {0}", string))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(4);
                        *infos.offsets.next() = name_off.conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = string_off.conv();
                        name_off += size_of::<u32Pc>();
                        string_off += size_of::<u32Pc>() * 2;
                    }
                    info.vals2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let vals2 = f32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals2_num())
                        .context("vals2")?;
                    self.write_vals2(vals2).context("write vals2")?;
                    if vals2.len() == 0 {
                        info.vals2_offset = 0u32.conv();
                    } else {
                        *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                            + { builtin # offset_of(HkConstraintInfoPc, vals2_offset) })
                            .conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, infos: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                    infos.hk_constraints += 1;
                    infos.offsets += self.bone_names_num() * 2 + 5;
                    if self.vals2_num() != 0 {
                        infos.offsets += 1;
                    }
                    offset += size_of::<u32Pc>() * self.bone_names_num() * 3;
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + size_of::<TRSPc>() * self.bone_transforms_num();
                    offset += size_of::<Key2Pc>() * self.bone_order_num();
                    offset += size_of::<i16Pc>() * self.bone_parents_num();
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                    for string in self.bone_names() {
                        let s = string.as_bytes();
                        offset += s.len();
                        offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                    }
                    offset += size_of::<f32Pc>() * self.vals2_num();
                    offset
                }
            }

            impl DumpHkConstraintPc for HkConstraintRefPc<'_> {
                fn bone_names_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_names.len()
                }
                fn bone_transforms_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_transforms.len()
                }
                fn bone_order_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bones_order.len()
                }
                fn bone_parents_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_parents.len()
                }
                fn vals2_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals2.len()
                }
                fn bone_names(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str> {
                    self.bone_names.iter().map(|x| &*x.0)
                }
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkConstraintInfoPc) -> Result<()> {
                    info.write_from(self.info)
                }
                fn write_bone_transforms(
                    &self,
                    bone_transforms: &mut [TRSPc],
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    bone_transforms.write_from(&self.bone_transforms[..])
                }
                fn write_bone_order(&self, bone_order: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    bone_order.write_from(&self.bones_order[..])
                }
                fn write_bone_parents(&self, bone_parents: &mut [i16Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    bone_parents.write_from(&self.bone_parents[..])
                }
                fn write_bone_name_vals<'a>(
                    &self,
                    vals: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut u32Pc>,
                ) {
                    for (src, dst) in self.bone_names.iter().map(|x| x.2).zip(vals) {
                        *dst = src;
                    }
                }
                fn write_vals2(&self, vals2: &mut [f32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    vals2.write_from(&self.vals2[..])
                }
            }

                    self.bone_transforms.len()
                }
                fn bone_order_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bones_order.len()
                }
                fn bone_parents_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_parents.len()
                }
                fn vals2_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals2.len()
                }
                fn bone_names(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str> {
                    self.bone_names.iter().map(|x| unsafe { x.0.as_ref() })
                }
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkConstraintInfoPc) -> Result<()> {
                    info.write_from(self.info())
                }
                fn write_bone_transforms(
                    &self,
                    bone_transforms: &mut [TRSPc],
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    bone_transforms.write_from(self.bone_transforms())
                }
                fn write_bone_order(&self, bone_order: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()> {

                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())

                Self {
                    center: OrderedData::conv(&val.center),
                    unk_3: OrderedData::conv(&val.unk_3),
                    half_width: OrderedData::conv(&val.half_width),
                    unk_7: OrderedData::conv(&val.unk_7),
                    ..Default::default()
                }
            }
        }

                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, BlockValAPs3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        BlockValAPs3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.vals_b) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(

                                "vals_b",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    slice<'a, BlockValAPs3>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.vals_b),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.vals_b),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, BlockValBPs3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,

                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.vals_c) == false

                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.vals_c),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, u8>>() != 0
                    && <slice<'a, u8> as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.pad)
                        == false
                {

        pub trait DumpBlockPc {
            fn vals_a_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_b_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_c_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn pad_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_info1(&self, info1: &mut BlockHeader1Pc) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_info2(&self, info2: &mut BlockHeader2Pc) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_a(&self, vals_a: &mut [BlockValAPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_b(&self, vals_b: &mut [BlockValAPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_c(&self, vals_c: &mut [BlockValBPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_pad(&self, pad: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()>;
            fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                let info1 = BlockHeader1Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("info1")?;
                self.write_info1(info1).context("write info1")?;
                let info2 = BlockHeader2Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("info2")?;
                self.write_info2(info2).context("write info2")?;
                let vals_a = BlockValAPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_a_num())
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                self.write_vals_a(vals_a).context("write vals_a")?;
                let vals_b = BlockValAPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_b_num())
                    .context("vals_b")?;
                self.write_vals_b(vals_b).context("write vals_b")?;
                let vals_c = BlockValBPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_c_num())
                    .context("vals_c")?;
                self.write_vals_c(vals_c).context("write vals_c")?;
                let pad = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.pad_num()).context("pad")?;
                self.write_pad(pad).context("write pad")?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, offset: usize) -> usize {
                offset + BlockHeader1Pc::size_of() + BlockHeader2Pc::size_of()

                                "parents",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<slice<'a, i32Ps3>>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.parents),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.parents),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, Matrix4x4Ps3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        Matrix4x4Ps3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.transforms) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "transforms",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    slice<'a, Matrix4x4Ps3>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.transforms),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.transforms),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, BoundingBoxPs3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        BoundingBoxPs3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.bounding_boxes)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "bounding_boxes",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    slice<'a, BoundingBoxPs3>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<
                                            ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8,
                                        >(&_it.bounding_boxes),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.bounding_boxes),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                _ret
            }
        }
        impl<'a> BonesRefPc<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], info: &'a ModelInfoPc) -> Result<Self> {
                let size = info.bones_num.get() as usize;
                let parents = i32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_parents_offset.get() as usize..],
                        size,
                    )
                    .context("parents")?;
                if parents[0].get() != -1 {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!(
                                    "first bone should be the root, but parent != -1",
                                ),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    );
                }
                let names_off = info.bones_offset.get() as usize;
                let (names, bounding_boxes) = if names_off != 0 {
                    (
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(&src[names_off..], size)
                            .context("names")?,
                        BoundingBoxPc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.bones_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("bounding_boxes")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let transforms = Matrix4x4Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_transforms_offset.get() as usize..],
                        size,
                    )
                    .context("transforms")?;
                Ok(Self {
                    names: names.into(),
                    parents: parents.into(),
                    transforms: transforms.into(),
                    bounding_boxes: bounding_boxes.into(),
                })
            }
            #[inline(always)]
            pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                self.transforms.len()
            }
        }

        impl BonesPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, info: &ModelInfoPc) -> Result<Self> {
                let size = info.bones_num.get() as usize;
                let parents = i32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_parents_offset.get() as usize..],
                        size,
                    )
                    .context("parents")?;
                if parents[0].get() != -1 {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!(
                                    "first bone should be the root, but parent != -1",
                                ),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    );
                }
                let names_off = info.bones_offset.get() as usize;
                let names = if names_off != 0 {
                    Some(
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(&src[names_off..], size).context("names")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let transforms = Matrix4x4Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_transforms_offset.get() as usize..],
                        size,
                    )
                    .context("transforms")?;
                let bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.bones_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("bounding_boxes")?;
                Ok(Self {
                    names: names.and_then(|x| x.first().map(|x| x.into())),
                    parents: parents.first().map(|x| x.into()),
                    transforms: transforms.first().map(|x| x.into()),
                    bounding_boxes: bounding_boxes.first().map(|x| x.into()),
                    size,
                })
            }
            pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> BonesRefPc<'_> {
                BonesRefPc {
                    names: self
                        .names
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[])
                        .into(),
                    parents: self
                        .parents
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[])
                        .into(),
                    transforms: self
                        .transforms
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[])
                        .into(),
                    bounding_boxes: self
                        .bounding_boxes
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[])
                        .into(),
                }
            }
        }

        #[repr(C)]
        /// # C Layout
        ///
        ///   - [`ModelRefPc_Layout`](#impl-ReprC)
        pub struct ModelRefPc<'a> {
            pub info: &'a ModelInfoPc,
            pub bones: BonesRefPc<'a>,
            pub mat_order: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub mesh_order: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub mesh_bounding_boxes: slice<'a, BoundingBoxPc>,
            pub skin_binds: slice<'a, Matrix4x4Pc>,
            pub vals_j: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub val_k_header: slice<'a, u16Pc>,
            pub vals_k: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub skin_order: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub slots: slice<'a, Key2Pc>,
            pub slot_map: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub block_header: Option<&'a u32Pc>,
            pub block_offsets: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub blocks: box_slice<BlockRefPc<'a>>,
            pub val: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub buffer_infos: slice<'a, BufferInfoPc>,
            pub vbuff_order: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub ibuff_order: slice<'a, u32Pc>,
            pub vbuffs: Map<u32, &'a VBuffInfoPc>,
            pub ibuffs: Map<u32, &'a IBuffInfoPc>,
            pub mats: Map<u32, MatRefPc<'a>>,
            pub hk_constraint: Option<HkConstraintRefPc<'a>>,
            pub hk_constraint_datas: slice<'a, HkConstraintDataPc>,
            pub shapes: box_slice<ShapeRefPc<'a>>,
            pub data: ModelDataRefPc<'a>,
        }

                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.slot_map),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<Option<&'a u32Ps3>>() != 0
                    && <Option<
                        &'a u32Ps3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.block_header)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "block_header",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<Option<&'a u32Ps3>>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.block_header),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.block_header),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, u32Ps3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        u32Ps3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.block_offsets)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "block_offsets",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<slice<'a, u32Ps3>>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<
                                            ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8,
                                        >(&_it.block_offsets),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.block_offsets),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<box_slice<BlockRefPs3<'a>>>() != 0
                    && <box_slice<
                        BlockRefPs3<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.blocks) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "blocks",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    box_slice<BlockRefPs3<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.blocks),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.blocks),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, u32Ps3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        u32Ps3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.val) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",

                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.val),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.val),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, BufferInfoPs3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        BufferInfoPs3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.buffer_infos)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "buffer_infos",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    slice<'a, BufferInfoPs3>,
