                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.buffer_infos),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.buffer_infos),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, u32Ps3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        u32Ps3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.vbuff_order) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "vbuff_order",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<slice<'a, u32Ps3>>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.vbuff_order),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.vbuff_order),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, u32Ps3>>() != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        u32Ps3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.ibuff_order) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "ibuff_order",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<slice<'a, u32Ps3>>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.ibuff_order),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.ibuff_order),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<Map<u32, &'a VBuffInfoPs3>>() != 0
                    && <Map<
                        u32,
                        &'a VBuffInfoPs3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.vbuffs) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "vbuffs",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Map<u32, &'a VBuffInfoPs3>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.vbuffs),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.vbuffs),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<Map<u32, &'a IBuffInfoPs3>>() != 0
                    && <Map<
                        u32,
                        &'a IBuffInfoPs3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.ibuffs) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "ibuffs",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Map<u32, &'a IBuffInfoPs3>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.ibuffs),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.ibuffs),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<Map<u32, MatRefPs3<'a>>>() != 0
                    && <Map<
                        u32,
                        MatRefPs3<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.mats) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "mats",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Map<u32, MatRefPs3<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.mats),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.mats),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<Option<HkConstraintRefPs3<'a>>>()
                    != 0
                    && <Option<
                        HkConstraintRefPs3<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.hk_constraint)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "hk_constraint",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Option<HkConstraintRefPs3<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<
                                            ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8,
                                        >(&_it.hk_constraint),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.hk_constraint),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<slice<'a, HkConstraintDataPs3>>()
                    != 0
                    && <slice<
                        'a,
                        HkConstraintDataPs3,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.hk_constraint_datas)
                        == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "hk_constraint_datas",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    slice<'a, HkConstraintDataPs3>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<
                                            ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8,
                                        >(&_it.hk_constraint_datas),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.hk_constraint_datas),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<box_slice<ShapeRefPs3<'a>>>() != 0
                    && <box_slice<
                        ShapeRefPs3<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.shapes) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "shapes",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    box_slice<ShapeRefPs3<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.shapes),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.shapes),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<ModelDataRefPs3<'a>>() != 0
                    && <ModelDataRefPs3<
                        'a,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.data) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "data",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<ModelDataRefPs3<'a>>(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.data),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.data),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                _ret
            }
        }
        impl<'a> ModelRefPc<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(
                src: &'a [u8],
                info: &'a ModelInfoPc,
                model_data: &Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let bones = BonesRefPc::from_data(src, info).context("bones")?;
                let mat_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mat_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.skin_binds_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let vals_j = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vals_j_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vals_j_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let (val_k_header, vals_k) = if info.vals_k_offset.get() != 0 {
                    (
                        u16Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize..],
                                2,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                                35,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let skin_order = if info.skin_order_offset.get() != 0 {
                    u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.skin_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?
                } else {
                    &[] as _
                };
                let (slots, slot_map) = if info.slots_offset.get() != 0 {
                    if info.slot_map_offset.get() == 0 {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("expected non zero slot_map_offset"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                    let mut i = 0;
                    {
                        while {
                            let val = u32Pc::from_data(
                                    &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize + i * 8..],
                                )
                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.get() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.get() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info.block_offset.get()
                    != 0
                {
                    let block_header = u32Pc::from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize..],
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.get() - info.lod0.skinned_end.get())
                        as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                            n + 1,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                    for i in 0..n {
                        let size = (block_offsets[i + 1].get() - block_offsets[i].get())
                            as usize;
                        let offset = (block_offsets[i].get() + info.block_offset.get())
                            as usize;
                        let block = BlockRefPc::from_data(&src[offset..offset + size])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        blocks.push(block);
                    }
                    (Some(block_header), block_offsets, blocks.into_boxed_slice())
                } else {
                    (None, &[] as _, Box::default())
                };
                let val = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        4,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let hk_constraint = if info.hk_constraint_offset.get() != 0 {
                    Some(
                        HkConstraintRefPc::from_data(
                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let hk_constraint_datas = shape::HkConstraintDataPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                let shape_infos = ShapeInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.shape_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.shape_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("shape_infos")?;
                let shapes = shape_infos
                    .into_iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, info)| {
                        ShapeRefPc::from_data(src, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                    .into_boxed_slice();
                let mats = mat_order
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.get(),
                            MatRefPc::from_data(src, x.get() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let buffer_infos = data::BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;
                let vbuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let ibuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        data::VBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                )
                            }))?,
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        data::IBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                )
                            }))?,
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let data = ModelDataRefPc::from_data(src, info, model_data)
                    .context("model data")?;
                Ok(Self {
                    info: info,
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats: mats.into(),
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    vbuffs: vbuffs.into(),
                    ibuffs: ibuffs.into(),
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
        }
        impl<'a> ModelRefXbox<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(
                src: &'a [u8],
                info: &'a ModelInfoXbox,
                model_data: &Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let bones = BonesRefXbox::from_data(src, info).context("bones")?;
                let mat_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mat_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.skin_binds_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let vals_j = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vals_j_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vals_j_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let (val_k_header, vals_k) = if info.vals_k_offset.get() != 0 {
                    (
                        u16Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize..],
                                2,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                        u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                                35,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let skin_order = if info.skin_order_offset.get() != 0 {
                    u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.skin_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?
                } else {
                    &[] as _
                };
                let (slots, slot_map) = if info.slots_offset.get() != 0 {
                    if info.slot_map_offset.get() == 0 {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("expected non zero slot_map_offset"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                    let mut i = 0;
                    {
                        while {
                            let val = u32Xbox::from_data(
                                    &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize + i * 8..],
                                )
                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.get() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.get() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info.block_offset.get()
                    != 0
                {
                    let block_header = u32Xbox::from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize..],
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.get() - info.lod0.skinned_end.get())
                        as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                            n + 1,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                    for i in 0..n {
                        let size = (block_offsets[i + 1].get() - block_offsets[i].get())
                            as usize;
                        let offset = (block_offsets[i].get() + info.block_offset.get())
                            as usize;
                        let block = BlockRefXbox::from_data(&src[offset..offset + size])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        blocks.push(block);
                    }
                    (Some(block_header), block_offsets, blocks.into_boxed_slice())
                } else {
                    (None, &[] as _, Box::default())
                };
                let val = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        4,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let hk_constraint = if info.hk_constraint_offset.get() != 0 {
                    Some(
                        HkConstraintRefXbox::from_data(
                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let hk_constraint_datas = shape::HkConstraintDataXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                let shape_infos = ShapeInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.shape_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.shape_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("shape_infos")?;
                let shapes = shape_infos
                    .into_iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, info)| {
                        ShapeRefXbox::from_data(src, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                    .into_boxed_slice();
                let mats = mat_order
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.get(),
                            MatRefXbox::from_data(src, x.get() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let buffer_infos = data::BufferInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;
                let vbuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let ibuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        data::VBuffInfoXbox::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                )
                            }))?,
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        data::IBuffInfoXbox::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                )
                            }))?,
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let data = ModelDataRefXbox::from_data(src, info, model_data)
                    .context("model data")?;
                Ok(Self {
                    info: info,
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats: mats.into(),
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    vbuffs: vbuffs.into(),
                    ibuffs: ibuffs.into(),
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
        }
        impl<'a> ModelRefPs3<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(
                src: &'a [u8],
                info: &'a ModelInfoPs3,
                model_data: &Map<u32, &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let bones = BonesRefPs3::from_data(src, info).context("bones")?;
                let mat_order = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mat_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_order = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxPs3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.skin_binds_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let vals_j = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vals_j_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vals_j_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let (val_k_header, vals_k) = if info.vals_k_offset.get() != 0 {
                    (
                        u16Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize..],
                                2,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                        u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                                35,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let skin_order = if info.skin_order_offset.get() != 0 {
                    u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.skin_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?
                } else {
                    &[] as _
                };
                let (slots, slot_map) = if info.slots_offset.get() != 0 {
                    if info.slot_map_offset.get() == 0 {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("expected non zero slot_map_offset"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                    let mut i = 0;
                    {
                        while {
                            let val = u32Ps3::from_data(
                                    &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize + i * 8..],
                                )
                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.get() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.get() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info.block_offset.get()
                    != 0
                {
                    let block_header = u32Ps3::from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize..],
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.get() - info.lod0.skinned_end.get())
                        as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                            n + 1,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                    for i in 0..n {
                        let size = (block_offsets[i + 1].get() - block_offsets[i].get())
                            as usize;
                        let offset = (block_offsets[i].get() + info.block_offset.get())
                            as usize;
                        let block = BlockRefPs3::from_data(&src[offset..offset + size])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        blocks.push(block);
                    }
                    (Some(block_header), block_offsets, blocks.into_boxed_slice())
                } else {
                    (None, &[] as _, Box::default())
                };
                let val = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        4,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let hk_constraint = if info.hk_constraint_offset.get() != 0 {
                    Some(
                        HkConstraintRefPs3::from_data(
                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let hk_constraint_datas = shape::HkConstraintDataPs3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                let shape_infos = ShapeInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.shape_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.shape_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("shape_infos")?;
                let shapes = shape_infos
                    .into_iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, info)| {
                        ShapeRefPs3::from_data(src, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                    .into_boxed_slice();
                let mats = mat_order
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.get(),
                            MatRefPs3::from_data(src, x.get() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let buffer_infos = data::BufferInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;
                let vbuff_order = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let ibuff_order = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        data::VBuffInfoPs3::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                )
                            }))?,
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        data::IBuffInfoPs3::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                )
                            }))?,
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                let data = ModelDataRefPs3::from_data(src, info, model_data)
                    .context("model data")?;
                Ok(Self {
                    info: info,
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats: mats.into(),
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    vbuffs: vbuffs.into(),
                    ibuffs: ibuffs.into(),
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
        }
        pub struct ModelRawPc {
            _ptr: BufType,
            info: NonNull<ModelInfoPc>,
            bones: BonesPc,
            mat_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            mesh_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            mesh_bounding_boxes: NonNull<[BoundingBoxPc]>,
            skin_binds: NonNull<[Matrix4x4Pc]>,
            vals_j: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            val_k_header: NonNull<[u16Pc]>,
            vals_k: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            skin_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            slots: NonNull<[Key2Pc]>,
            slot_map: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            block_header: Option<u32Pc>,
            block_offsets: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            blocks: Box<[BlockPc]>,

            buffer_infos: NonNull<[BufferInfoPc]>,
            vbuff_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            ibuff_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,

            hk_constraint: Option<HkConstraintPc>,

            data: CompressedDataRef,
        }

            mesh_bounding_boxes: NonNull<[BoundingBoxPs3]>,

        impl ModelRawPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                model_data: &IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
                offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let info = ModelInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                let bones = BonesPc::from_bytes(src, info).context("bones")?;
                let mat_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mat_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.skin_binds_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let vals_j = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vals_j_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vals_j_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let (val_k_header, vals_k) = if info.vals_k_offset.get() != 0 {
                    (
                        u16Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize..],
                                2,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                                35,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let skin_order = if info.skin_order_offset.get() != 0 {
                    u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.skin_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?
                } else {
                    &[] as _
                };
                let (slots, slot_map) = if info.slots_offset.get() != 0 {
                    if info.slot_map_offset.get() == 0 {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("expected non zero slot_map_offset"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                    let mut i = 0;
                    {
                        while {
                            let val = u32Pc::from_data(
                                    &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize + i * 8..],
                                )
                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.get() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.get() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info.block_offset.get()
                    != 0
                {
                    let block_header = u32Pc::from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize..],
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.get() - info.lod0.skinned_end.get())
                        as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                            n + 1,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                    for i in 0..n {
                        let size = (block_offsets[i + 1].get() - block_offsets[i].get())
                            as usize;
                        let offset = (block_offsets[i].get() + info.block_offset.get())
                            as usize;
                        let block = BlockPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?;
                        blocks.push(block);
                    }
                    (Some(*block_header), block_offsets, blocks)
                } else {
                    (None, &[] as _, ::alloc::vec::Vec::new())
                };
                let val = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        4,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let hk_constraint = if info.hk_constraint_offset.get() != 0 {
                    Some(
                        shape::HkConstraintPc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let hk_constraint_datas = shape::HkConstraintDataPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                let shapes = (0..info.shape_num.get() as usize)
                    .map(|i| {
                        shape::ShapePc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.shape_offset.get() as usize
                                    + i * shape::ShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                let mats = mat_order
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.get(),
                            mat::MatPc::from_bytes(src, x.get() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let buffer_infos = data::BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;
                let vbuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let ibuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let _vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::VBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let _ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::IBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let data = model_data
                    .get(&info.asset_key.get())
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info: info.into(),
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats,
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    _vbuffs,
                    _ibuffs,
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
            pub fn info(&self) -> &ModelInfoPc {
                unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
            }
        }
        impl ModelRawXbox {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                model_data: &IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
                offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let info = ModelInfoXbox::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                let bones = BonesXbox::from_bytes(src, info).context("bones")?;
                let mat_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mat_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.skin_binds_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let vals_j = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vals_j_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vals_j_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let (val_k_header, vals_k) = if info.vals_k_offset.get() != 0 {
                    (
                        u16Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize..],
                                2,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                        u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                                35,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let skin_order = if info.skin_order_offset.get() != 0 {
                    u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.skin_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.skin_binds_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?
                } else {
                    &[] as _
                };
                let (slots, slot_map) = if info.slots_offset.get() != 0 {
                    if info.slot_map_offset.get() == 0 {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("expected non zero slot_map_offset"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                    let mut i = 0;
                    {
                        while {
                            let val = u32Xbox::from_data(
                                    &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize + i * 8..],
                                )
                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.get() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.get() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.get() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info.block_offset.get()
                    != 0
                {
                    let block_header = u32Xbox::from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize..],
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.get() - info.lod0.skinned_end.get())
                        as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.get() as usize + 4..],
                            n + 1,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                    for i in 0..n {
                        let size = (block_offsets[i + 1].get() - block_offsets[i].get())
                            as usize;
                        let offset = (block_offsets[i].get() + info.block_offset.get())
                            as usize;
                        let block = BlockXbox::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?;
                        blocks.push(block);
                    }
                    (Some(*block_header), block_offsets, blocks)
                } else {
                    (None, &[] as _, ::alloc::vec::Vec::new())
                };
                let val = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.get() as usize..],
                        4,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let hk_constraint = if info.hk_constraint_offset.get() != 0 {
                    Some(
                        shape::HkConstraintXbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let hk_constraint_datas = shape::HkConstraintDataXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                let shapes = (0..info.shape_num.get() as usize)
                    .map(|i| {
                        shape::ShapeXbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.shape_offset.get() as usize
                                    + i * shape::ShapeInfoXbox::size_of(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                let mats = mat_order
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.get(),
                            mat::MatXbox::from_bytes(src, x.get() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let buffer_infos = data::BufferInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;
                let vbuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let ibuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let _vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::VBuffInfoXbox::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let _ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.get(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::IBuffInfoXbox::from_data(&src[x.get() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.get()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let data = model_data
                    .get(&info.asset_key.get())
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info: info.into(),
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats,
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    _vbuffs,
                    _ibuffs,
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
            pub fn info(&self) -> &ModelInfoXbox {
                unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
            }
        }

        pub struct ModelPc {

        pub struct Model {
            pub info: ModelInfo,
            pub bones: Bones,
            pub mat_order: Vec<u32>,
            pub mesh_order: Vec<u32>,
            pub mesh_bounding_boxes: Vec<BoundingBox>,
            pub skin_binds: Vec<Matrix4x4>,
            pub vals_j: Vec<u32>,
            pub val_k_header: Vec<u16>,
            pub vals_k: Vec<u32>,
            pub skin_order: Vec<u32>,
            pub slots: Vec<Key2>,
            pub slot_map: Vec<u32>,
            pub block_header: Option<u32>,
            pub blocks: Vec<Block>,
            pub mats: Vec<mat::Mat>,
            pub hk_constraint: Option<shape::HkConstraint>,
            pub hk_constraint_datas: Vec<shape::HkConstraintData>,
            pub shapes: Vec<shape::Shape>,
            pub data: ModelData,
        }

                    "slot_map",
                    "block_header",
                    "blocks",
                    "mats",
                    "hk_constraint",
                    "hk_constraint_datas",
                    "shapes",
                    "data",
                ];
                let values: &[&dyn ::core::fmt::Debug] = &[
                    &self.info,
                    &self.bones,
                    &self.mat_order,
                    &self.mesh_order,
                    &self.mesh_bounding_boxes,
                    &self.skin_binds,
                    &self.vals_j,
                    &self.val_k_header,
                    &self.vals_k,
                    &self.skin_order,
                    &self.slots,
                    &self.slot_map,
                    &self.block_header,
                    &self.blocks,
                    &self.mats,
                    &self.hk_constraint,
                    &self.hk_constraint_datas,
                    &self.shapes,
                    &&self.data,
                ];
                ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_fields_finish(
                    f,
                    "Model",
                    names,
                    values,
                )
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for Model {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> Model {
                Model {
                    info: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.info),
                    bones: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.bones),
                    mat_order: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.mat_order),
                    mesh_order: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.mesh_order),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.mesh_bounding_boxes,
                    ),
                    skin_binds: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.skin_binds),
                    vals_j: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals_j),
                    val_k_header: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.val_k_header),
                    vals_k: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals_k),
                    skin_order: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.skin_order),
                    slots: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.slots),
                    slot_map: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.slot_map),
                    block_header: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.block_header),
                    blocks: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.blocks),
                    mats: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.mats),
                    hk_constraint: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.hk_constraint),
                    hk_constraint_datas: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.hk_constraint_datas,
                    ),
                    shapes: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.shapes),
                    data: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.data),
                }
            }
        }
        impl From<&ModelPc> for Model {
            fn from(val: &ModelPc) -> Self {
                Self {
                    info: val.info().conv(),
                    bones: val.bones().into(),
                    mat_order: val
                        .mat_order()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| val.mats.get_index_of(&x.get()).unwrap() as u32)
                        .collect(),
                    mesh_order: val.mesh_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: val
                        .mesh_bounding_boxes()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    skin_binds: val.skin_binds().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_j: val.vals_j().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    val_k_header: val.val_k_header().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_k: val.vals_k().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    skin_order: val.skin_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slots: val.slots().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slot_map: val.slot_map().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    block_header: val.block_header().map(|x| x.conv()),
                    blocks: val.blocks.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    mats: val
                        .mats
                        .values()
                        .map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }.into())
                        .collect(),
                    hk_constraint: val.hk_constraint.as_ref().map(|x| x.into()),
                    hk_constraint_datas: val
                        .hk_constraint_datas()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    shapes: val.shapes.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    data: val.data().into(),
                }
            }
        }

        pub enum ModelPatchPc {
            Raw(ModelRawPc),
            Parsed(Model),
        }

            Raw(ModelRawXbox),
            Parsed(Model),
        }
        pub enum ModelPatchPs3 {
            Raw(ModelRawPs3),
            Parsed(Model),
        }
        pub trait DumpModelPc {
            type Data;
            fn key(&self) -> u32;
            fn bone_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_j_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn skin_bind_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_skin_order(&self) -> bool;
            fn mat_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn shape_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn mesh_order_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn buffer_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vbuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn ibuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_vals_k(&self) -> bool;
            fn slot_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn slot_map_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn block_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn hk_constraint_data_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_bones(&self, bones: BonesDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_j(&self, vals_j: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_binds(&self, skin_binds: &mut [Matrix4x4Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_order(&self, skin_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_order(&self, mesh_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_bounding_boxes(
                &self,
                mesh_bboxes: &mut [BoundingBoxPc],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn vbuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn ibuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn write_buffer_infos(
                &self,
                buffer_infos: &mut [BufferInfoPc],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vbuff_infos(&self, vbuff_infos: &mut [VBuffInfoPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_ibuff_infos(&self, ibuff_infos: &mut [IBuffInfoPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_k(
                &self,
                header: &mut [u16Pc],
                vals_k: &mut [u32Pc],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slots(&self, slots: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slot_map(&self, slot_map: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_hk_constraint_datas(
                &self,
                hk_constraint_datas: &mut [HkConstraintDataPc],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn mat_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn mats<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpMatPc + 'a))>;
            fn shapes<'a>(&'a self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpShapePc + 'a)>;
            fn hk_constraint<'a>(&'a self) -> Option<&'a (impl DumpHkConstraintPc + 'a)>;
            fn block_header(&self) -> Option<impl Into<u32Pc>>;
            fn blocks<'a>(&'a self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpBlockPc + 'a)>;
            fn data(&self) -> &impl DumpModelDataPc<Data = Self::Data>;
            fn asset_info(&self) -> (u32Pc, u32Pc);
            fn dump_misc(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<Self::Data>,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPc,
                info_off: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.vals_k_offset = dst.offset.conv();
