                    let vals_k_header = u16Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 2)
                        .context("val_k_header")?;
                    let vals_k = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 35).context("vals_k")?;
                    self.write_vals_k(vals_k_header, vals_k).context("vals_k")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, vals_k_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.vals_k_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    info.slots_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slots = Key2Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_num())
                        .context("slots")?;
                    self.write_slots(slots).context("write slots")?;
                    info.slot_map_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slot_map = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_map_num())
                        .context("slot_map")?;
                    self.write_slot_map(slot_map).context("write slot_map")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, slots_offset) })
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, slot_map_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.slots_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if let Some(block_header) = self.block_header() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    let start = dst.offset;
                    info.block_offset = start.conv();
                    *u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("block_header")? = block_header
                        .into();
                    let block_offsets = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.block_num() + 1,
                        )
                        .context("block_offsets")?;
                    for (i, (block, off)) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_offsets.iter_mut())
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        dst.align(16);
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                        block
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    if let Some(off) = block_offsets.last_mut() {
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, block_offset) })
                        .conv();
                }
                info.hk_constraint_data_num = self.hk_constraint_data_num().conv();
                if info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.hk_constraint_data_offset = infos
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .offset
                        .conv();
                    self.write_hk_constraint_datas(
                            infos
                                .hk_constraint_datas
                                .next_slice(self.hk_constraint_data_num()),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + {
                            builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, hk_constraint_data_offset)
                        })
                        .conv();
                }
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, mat_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, buffer_info_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, mesh_order_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, bone_parents_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, bone_transforms_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, skin_binds_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, vbuff_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, ibuff_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, mesh_bounding_boxes_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, bone_bounding_boxes_offset) })
                    .conv();
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_misc_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16) + 2 * u16Pc::size_of()
                        + 35 * u32Pc::size_of();
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset
                    += Key2Pc::size_of() * self.slot_num()
                        + u32Pc::size_of() * self.slot_map_num();
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    counts.offsets += 2;
                }
                if self.block_header().is_some() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + (2 + self.block_num()) * u32Pc::size_of();
                    for block in self.blocks() {
                        offset = block.add_size(align_offset(offset, 16));
                    }
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                counts.hk_constraint_datas += self.hk_constraint_data_num();
                if self.hk_constraint_data_num() != 0 {
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                counts.offsets += 10;
                offset
            }
            fn dump_mats(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<Self::Data>,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPc,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                info.mat_offset = off.conv();
                let mat_map = self
                    .mats()
                    .map(|(i, mat)| Ok((i, mat.dump_infos(infos)?)))
                    .collect::<Result<HashMap<_, _>>>()
                    .context("mats")?;
                let mat_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mat_num())
                    .context("mat_order")?;
                info.mat_num = mat_order.len().conv();
                for (i, mat) in self.mat_order().zip(mat_order) {
                    *mat = mat_map
                        .get(&i)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("mats is missing item {0}", i),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_mat_counts(&self, counts: &mut InfoCounts) {
                for mat in self.mats() {
                    mat.1.add_counts(counts);
                }
                counts.offsets += self.mat_num();
            }
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<Self::Data>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let info_off = infos.models.offset;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bones = CrcPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.bone_num())
                    .context("bones")?;
                info.bones_num = bones.len().conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, bones_offset) })
                    .conv();
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_bboxes = BoundingBoxPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vals_j_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_j = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_j_num())
                    .context("vals_j")?;
                info.vals_j_num = vals_j.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_j(vals_j).context("write vals_j")?;
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, vals_j_offset) })
                    .conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.get() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.get(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, hk_constraint_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.skin_binds_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.skin_bind_num(),
                    )
                    .context("skin_binds")?;
                info.skin_binds_num = skin_binds.len().conv();
                self.write_skin_binds(skin_binds).context("write skin_binds")?;
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    info.skin_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let skin_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, skin_binds.len())
                        .context("skin_order")?;
                    self.write_skin_order(skin_order).context("write skin_order")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, skin_order_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_parents = i32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_parents")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPc {
                        names: bones,
                        parents: bone_parents,
                        bounding_boxes: bone_bboxes,
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, None)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, shape_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        mesh_order.len(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                let data = self.data().dump_into(dst, infos, info)?;
                let (asset_key, asset_type) = self.asset_info();
                infos.model_data.push((asset_key, asset_type, data));
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info, info_off)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                offset += CrcPc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.vals_j_num();
                counts.offsets += 2;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Pc::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset += i32Pc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Pc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = self.data().add_size(offset, counts).0;
                self.add_misc_size(offset, counts)
            }
            fn dump_terrain_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<Self::Data>,
                indices_offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let bone_bbox_offset = infos.models.offset + 16;
                let info_off = infos.models.offset;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bones_num = self.bone_num().conv();
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = bone_bbox_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_num = 0u32.conv();
                info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.vals_j_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bone_parents_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.get() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.get(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, hk_constraint_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                let mut shape_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(self.shape_num());
                for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        shape_offsets.push(Some(dst.offset));
                        extra
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0} extra", i))
                            }))?;
                    } else {
                        shape_offsets.push(None);
                    }
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.mesh_order_num(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.bone_num(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPc {
                        names: &mut [],
                        parents: &mut [],
                        bounding_boxes: &mut [],
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                let data = self.data().dump_into(dst, infos, info)?;
                let (asset_key, asset_type) = self.asset_info();
                infos.model_data.push((asset_key, asset_type, data));
                let off_dest = info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize + 320;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info, info_off)?;
                if dst.offset < off_dest {
                    dst.split(off_dest - dst.offset);
                }
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for ((i, shape), off) in self.shapes().enumerate().zip(shape_offsets)
                    {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPc, shape_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_terrain_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        offset = extra.add_size(offset);
                    }
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset += Matrix4x4Pc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                let (mut offset, off_dest) = self.data().add_size(offset, counts);
                offset += self.add_misc_size(offset, counts);
                offset = off_dest.max(offset);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpModelXbox {
            type Data;
            fn key(&self) -> u32;
            fn bone_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_j_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn skin_bind_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_skin_order(&self) -> bool;
            fn mat_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn shape_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn mesh_order_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn buffer_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vbuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn ibuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_vals_k(&self) -> bool;
            fn slot_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn slot_map_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn block_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn hk_constraint_data_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_bones(&self, bones: BonesDumpXbox) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_j(&self, vals_j: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_binds(&self, skin_binds: &mut [Matrix4x4Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_order(&self, skin_order: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_order(&self, mesh_order: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_bounding_boxes(
                &self,
                mesh_bboxes: &mut [BoundingBoxXbox],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn vbuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn ibuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn write_buffer_infos(
                &self,
                buffer_infos: &mut [BufferInfoXbox],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vbuff_infos(&self, vbuff_infos: &mut [VBuffInfoXbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_ibuff_infos(&self, ibuff_infos: &mut [IBuffInfoXbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_k(
                &self,
                header: &mut [u16Xbox],
                vals_k: &mut [u32Xbox],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slots(&self, slots: &mut [Key2Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slot_map(&self, slot_map: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_hk_constraint_datas(
                &self,
                hk_constraint_datas: &mut [HkConstraintDataXbox],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn mat_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn mats<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpMatXbox + 'a))>;
            fn shapes<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpShapeXbox + 'a)>;
            fn hk_constraint<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> Option<&'a (impl DumpHkConstraintXbox + 'a)>;
            fn block_header(&self) -> Option<impl Into<u32Xbox>>;
            fn blocks<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpBlockXbox + 'a)>;
            fn data(&self) -> &impl DumpModelDataXbox<Data = Self::Data>;
            fn asset_info(&self) -> (u32Xbox, u32Xbox);
            fn dump_misc(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox<Self::Data>,
                info: &mut ModelInfoXbox,
                info_off: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.vals_k_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let vals_k_header = u16Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 2)
                        .context("val_k_header")?;
                    let vals_k = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 35)
                        .context("vals_k")?;
                    self.write_vals_k(vals_k_header, vals_k).context("vals_k")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, vals_k_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.vals_k_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    info.slots_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slots = Key2Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_num())
                        .context("slots")?;
                    self.write_slots(slots).context("write slots")?;
                    info.slot_map_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slot_map = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_map_num())
                        .context("slot_map")?;
                    self.write_slot_map(slot_map).context("write slot_map")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, slots_offset) })
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, slot_map_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.slots_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if let Some(block_header) = self.block_header() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    let start = dst.offset;
                    info.block_offset = start.conv();
                    *u32Xbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("block_header")? = block_header
                        .into();
                    let block_offsets = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.block_num() + 1,
                        )
                        .context("block_offsets")?;
                    for (i, (block, off)) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_offsets.iter_mut())
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        dst.align(16);
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                        block
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    if let Some(off) = block_offsets.last_mut() {
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, block_offset) })
                        .conv();
                }
                info.hk_constraint_data_num = self.hk_constraint_data_num().conv();
                if info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.hk_constraint_data_offset = infos
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .offset
                        .conv();
                    self.write_hk_constraint_datas(
                            infos
                                .hk_constraint_datas
                                .next_slice(self.hk_constraint_data_num()),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + {
                            builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, hk_constraint_data_offset)
                        })
                        .conv();
                }
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, mat_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, buffer_info_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, mesh_order_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, bone_parents_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, bone_transforms_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, skin_binds_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, vbuff_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, ibuff_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, mesh_bounding_boxes_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, bone_bounding_boxes_offset) })
                    .conv();
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_misc_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16) + 2 * u16Xbox::size_of()
                        + 35 * u32Xbox::size_of();
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset
                    += Key2Xbox::size_of() * self.slot_num()
                        + u32Xbox::size_of() * self.slot_map_num();
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    counts.offsets += 2;
                }
                if self.block_header().is_some() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + (2 + self.block_num()) * u32Xbox::size_of();
                    for block in self.blocks() {
                        offset = block.add_size(align_offset(offset, 16));
                    }
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                counts.hk_constraint_datas += self.hk_constraint_data_num();
                if self.hk_constraint_data_num() != 0 {
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                counts.offsets += 10;
                offset
            }
            fn dump_mats(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox<Self::Data>,
                info: &mut ModelInfoXbox,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                info.mat_offset = off.conv();
                let mat_map = self
                    .mats()
                    .map(|(i, mat)| Ok((i, mat.dump_infos(infos)?)))
                    .collect::<Result<HashMap<_, _>>>()
                    .context("mats")?;
                let mat_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mat_num())
                    .context("mat_order")?;
                info.mat_num = mat_order.len().conv();
                for (i, mat) in self.mat_order().zip(mat_order) {
                    *mat = mat_map
                        .get(&i)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("mats is missing item {0}", i),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_mat_counts(&self, counts: &mut InfoCounts) {
                for mat in self.mats() {
                    mat.1.add_counts(counts);
                }
                counts.offsets += self.mat_num();
            }
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox<Self::Data>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let info_off = infos.models.offset;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bones = CrcXbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.bone_num())
                    .context("bones")?;
                info.bones_num = bones.len().conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, bones_offset) })
                    .conv();
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_bboxes = BoundingBoxXbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vals_j_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_j = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_j_num())
                    .context("vals_j")?;
                info.vals_j_num = vals_j.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_j(vals_j).context("write vals_j")?;
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, vals_j_offset) })
                    .conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.get() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.get(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, hk_constraint_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.skin_binds_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.skin_bind_num(),
                    )
                    .context("skin_binds")?;
                info.skin_binds_num = skin_binds.len().conv();
                self.write_skin_binds(skin_binds).context("write skin_binds")?;
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    info.skin_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let skin_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, skin_binds.len())
                        .context("skin_order")?;
                    self.write_skin_order(skin_order).context("write skin_order")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, skin_order_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_parents = i32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_parents")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        bones.len(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpXbox {
                        names: bones,
                        parents: bone_parents,
                        bounding_boxes: bone_bboxes,
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, None)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, shape_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        mesh_order.len(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                let data = self.data().dump_into(dst, infos, info)?;
                let (asset_key, asset_type) = self.asset_info();
                infos.model_data.push((asset_key, asset_type, data));
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info, info_off)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                offset += CrcXbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxXbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.vals_j_num();
                counts.offsets += 2;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Xbox::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset += i32Xbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Xbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxXbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = self.data().add_size(offset, counts).0;
                self.add_misc_size(offset, counts)
            }
            fn dump_terrain_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox<Self::Data>,
                indices_offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let bone_bbox_offset = infos.models.offset + 16;
                let info_off = infos.models.offset;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bones_num = self.bone_num().conv();
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = bone_bbox_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_num = 0u32.conv();
                info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.vals_j_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bone_parents_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.get() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.get(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, hk_constraint_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                let mut shape_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(self.shape_num());
                for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        shape_offsets.push(Some(dst.offset));
                        extra
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0} extra", i))
                            }))?;
                    } else {
                        shape_offsets.push(None);
                    }
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.mesh_order_num(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.bone_num(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpXbox {
                        names: &mut [],
                        parents: &mut [],
                        bounding_boxes: &mut [],
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                let data = self.data().dump_into(dst, infos, info)?;
                let (asset_key, asset_type) = self.asset_info();
                infos.model_data.push((asset_key, asset_type, data));
                let off_dest = info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize + 320;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info, info_off)?;
                if dst.offset < off_dest {
                    dst.split(off_dest - dst.offset);
                }
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for ((i, shape), off) in self.shapes().enumerate().zip(shape_offsets)
                    {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoXbox, shape_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_terrain_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        offset = extra.add_size(offset);
                    }
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxXbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset += Matrix4x4Xbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                let (mut offset, off_dest) = self.data().add_size(offset, counts);
                offset += self.add_misc_size(offset, counts);
                offset = off_dest.max(offset);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpModelPs3 {
            type Data;
            fn key(&self) -> u32;
            fn bone_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_j_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn skin_bind_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_skin_order(&self) -> bool;
            fn mat_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn shape_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn mesh_order_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn buffer_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vbuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn ibuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_vals_k(&self) -> bool;
            fn slot_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn slot_map_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn block_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn hk_constraint_data_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_bones(&self, bones: BonesDumpPs3) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_j(&self, vals_j: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_binds(&self, skin_binds: &mut [Matrix4x4Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_order(&self, skin_order: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_order(&self, mesh_order: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_bounding_boxes(
                &self,
                mesh_bboxes: &mut [BoundingBoxPs3],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn vbuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn ibuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn write_buffer_infos(
                &self,
                buffer_infos: &mut [BufferInfoPs3],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vbuff_infos(&self, vbuff_infos: &mut [VBuffInfoPs3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_ibuff_infos(&self, ibuff_infos: &mut [IBuffInfoPs3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_k(
                &self,
                header: &mut [u16Ps3],
                vals_k: &mut [u32Ps3],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slots(&self, slots: &mut [Key2Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slot_map(&self, slot_map: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_hk_constraint_datas(
                &self,
                hk_constraint_datas: &mut [HkConstraintDataPs3],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn mat_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn mats<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpMatPs3 + 'a))>;
            fn shapes<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpShapePs3 + 'a)>;
            fn hk_constraint<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> Option<&'a (impl DumpHkConstraintPs3 + 'a)>;
            fn block_header(&self) -> Option<impl Into<u32Ps3>>;
            fn blocks<'a>(
                &'a self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpBlockPs3 + 'a)>;
            fn data(&self) -> &impl DumpModelDataPs3<Data = Self::Data>;
            fn asset_info(&self) -> (u32Ps3, u32Ps3);
            fn dump_misc(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3<Self::Data>,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPs3,
                info_off: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.vals_k_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let vals_k_header = u16Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 2)
                        .context("val_k_header")?;
                    let vals_k = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 35).context("vals_k")?;
                    self.write_vals_k(vals_k_header, vals_k).context("vals_k")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, vals_k_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.vals_k_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    info.slots_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slots = Key2Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_num())
                        .context("slots")?;
                    self.write_slots(slots).context("write slots")?;
                    info.slot_map_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slot_map = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_map_num())
                        .context("slot_map")?;
                    self.write_slot_map(slot_map).context("write slot_map")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, slots_offset) })
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, slot_map_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.slots_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if let Some(block_header) = self.block_header() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    let start = dst.offset;
                    info.block_offset = start.conv();
                    *u32Ps3::mut_from_data(dst).context("block_header")? = block_header
                        .into();
                    let block_offsets = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.block_num() + 1,
                        )
                        .context("block_offsets")?;
                    for (i, (block, off)) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_offsets.iter_mut())
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        dst.align(16);
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                        block
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    if let Some(off) = block_offsets.last_mut() {
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, block_offset) })
                        .conv();
                }
                info.hk_constraint_data_num = self.hk_constraint_data_num().conv();
                if info.hk_constraint_data_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.hk_constraint_data_offset = infos
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .offset
                        .conv();
                    self.write_hk_constraint_datas(
                            infos
                                .hk_constraint_datas
                                .next_slice(self.hk_constraint_data_num()),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + {
                            builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, hk_constraint_data_offset)
                        })
                        .conv();
                }
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, mat_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, buffer_info_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, mesh_order_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, bone_parents_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, bone_transforms_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, skin_binds_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, vbuff_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, ibuff_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, mesh_bounding_boxes_offset) })
                    .conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, bone_bounding_boxes_offset) })
                    .conv();
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_misc_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16) + 2 * u16Ps3::size_of()
                        + 35 * u32Ps3::size_of();
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset
                    += Key2Ps3::size_of() * self.slot_num()
                        + u32Ps3::size_of() * self.slot_map_num();
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    counts.offsets += 2;
                }
                if self.block_header().is_some() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + (2 + self.block_num()) * u32Ps3::size_of();
                    for block in self.blocks() {
                        offset = block.add_size(align_offset(offset, 16));
                    }
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                counts.hk_constraint_datas += self.hk_constraint_data_num();
                if self.hk_constraint_data_num() != 0 {
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                counts.offsets += 10;
                offset
            }
            fn dump_mats(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3<Self::Data>,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPs3,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                info.mat_offset = off.conv();
                let mat_map = self
                    .mats()
                    .map(|(i, mat)| Ok((i, mat.dump_infos(infos)?)))
                    .collect::<Result<HashMap<_, _>>>()
                    .context("mats")?;
                let mat_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mat_num())
                    .context("mat_order")?;
                info.mat_num = mat_order.len().conv();
                for (i, mat) in self.mat_order().zip(mat_order) {
                    *mat = mat_map
                        .get(&i)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("mats is missing item {0}", i),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_mat_counts(&self, counts: &mut InfoCounts) {
                for mat in self.mats() {
                    mat.1.add_counts(counts);
                }
                counts.offsets += self.mat_num();
            }
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3<Self::Data>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let info_off = infos.models.offset;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bones = CrcPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.bone_num())
                    .context("bones")?;
                info.bones_num = bones.len().conv();
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, bones_offset) })
                    .conv();
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_bboxes = BoundingBoxPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vals_j_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_j = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_j_num())
                    .context("vals_j")?;
                info.vals_j_num = vals_j.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_j(vals_j).context("write vals_j")?;
                *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                    + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, vals_j_offset) })
                    .conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.get() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.get(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, hk_constraint_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.skin_binds_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.skin_bind_num(),
                    )
                    .context("skin_binds")?;
                info.skin_binds_num = skin_binds.len().conv();
                self.write_skin_binds(skin_binds).context("write skin_binds")?;
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    info.skin_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let skin_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, skin_binds.len())
                        .context("skin_order")?;
                    self.write_skin_order(skin_order).context("write skin_order")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, skin_order_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_parents = i32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_parents")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPs3 {
                        names: bones,
                        parents: bone_parents,
                        bounding_boxes: bone_bboxes,
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, None)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, shape_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        mesh_order.len(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                let data = self.data().dump_into(dst, infos, info)?;
                let (asset_key, asset_type) = self.asset_info();
                infos.model_data.push((asset_key, asset_type, data));
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info, info_off)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                offset += CrcPs3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPs3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.vals_j_num();
                counts.offsets += 2;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset += i32Ps3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPs3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = self.data().add_size(offset, counts).0;
                self.add_misc_size(offset, counts)
            }
            fn dump_terrain_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3<Self::Data>,
                indices_offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let bone_bbox_offset = infos.models.offset + 16;
                let info_off = infos.models.offset;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bones_num = self.bone_num().conv();
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = bone_bbox_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_num = 0u32.conv();
                info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.vals_j_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bone_parents_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.get() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.get(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, hk_constraint_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                let mut shape_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(self.shape_num());
                for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        shape_offsets.push(Some(dst.offset));
                        extra
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0} extra", i))
                            }))?;
                    } else {
                        shape_offsets.push(None);
                    }
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.mesh_order_num(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.bone_num(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPs3 {
                        names: &mut [],
                        parents: &mut [],
                        bounding_boxes: &mut [],
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                let data = self.data().dump_into(dst, infos, info)?;
                let (asset_key, asset_type) = self.asset_info();
                infos.model_data.push((asset_key, asset_type, data));
                let off_dest = info.ibuff_offset.get() as usize + 320;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info, info_off)?;
                if dst.offset < off_dest {
                    dst.split(off_dest - dst.offset);
                }
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.get() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for ((i, shape), off) in self.shapes().enumerate().zip(shape_offsets)
                    {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (info_off
                        + { builtin # offset_of(ModelInfoPs3, shape_offset) })
                        .conv();
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_terrain_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        offset = extra.add_size(offset);
                    }
                    counts.offsets += 1;
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPs3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset += Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                let (mut offset, off_dest) = self.data().add_size(offset, counts);
                offset += self.add_misc_size(offset, counts);
                offset = off_dest.max(offset);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset
            }
        }
        impl<'a> DumpModelPc for ModelRefPc<'a> {
            type Data = &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>;
            fn key(&self) -> u32 {
                self.info.key.get()
            }
            fn bone_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.bones.len()
            }
            fn vals_j_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.vals_j.len()
            }
            fn skin_bind_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.skin_binds.len()
            }
            fn has_skin_order(&self) -> bool {
                !self.skin_order.is_empty()
            }
            fn mat_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.mats.len()
            }
            fn shape_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.shapes.len()
            }
            fn mesh_order_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.mesh_order.len()
            }
            fn buffer_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.buffer_infos.len()
            }
            fn vbuff_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.vbuff_order.len()
            }
            fn ibuff_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.ibuff_order.len()
            }
            fn has_vals_k(&self) -> bool {
                !self.val_k_header.is_empty()
            }
            fn slot_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.slots.len()
            }
            fn slot_map_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.slot_map.len()
            }
            fn block_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.blocks.len()
            }
            fn hk_constraint_data_num(&self) -> usize {
                self.hk_constraint_datas.len()
            }
            fn write_bones(
                &self,
                BonesDumpPc { names, parents, transforms, bounding_boxes }: BonesDumpPc,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                if names.len() != 0 {
                    names.write_from(&self.bones.names[..])?;
                    parents.write_from(&self.bones.parents[..])?;
                    bounding_boxes.write_from(&self.bones.bounding_boxes[..])?;
                }
                transforms.write_from(&self.bones.transforms[..])
            }
            fn write_vals_j(&self, vals_j: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                vals_j.write_from(&self.vals_j[..])
            }
            fn write_skin_binds(&self, skin_binds: &mut [Matrix4x4Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                skin_binds.write_from(&self.skin_binds[..])
            }
            fn write_skin_order(&self, skin_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                skin_order.write_from(&self.skin_order[..])
            }
            fn write_mesh_order(&self, mesh_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                mesh_order.write_from(&self.mesh_order[..])
            }
            fn write_mesh_bounding_boxes(
                &self,
                mesh_bboxes: &mut [BoundingBoxPc],
            ) -> Result<()> {
                mesh_bboxes.write_from(&self.mesh_bounding_boxes[..])
            }
            fn vbuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32> {
                self.vbuff_order.iter().map(|x| x.get())
            }
            fn ibuff_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32> {
                self.ibuff_order.iter().map(|x| x.get())
            }
            fn write_buffer_infos(
                &self,
                buffer_infos: &mut [BufferInfoPc],
            ) -> Result<()> {
                buffer_infos.write_from(&self.buffer_infos[..])
            }
            fn write_vbuff_infos(&self, vbuff_infos: &mut [VBuffInfoPc]) -> Result<()> {
                for (src, dst) in self.vbuffs.values().zip(vbuff_infos) {
                    dst.write_from(src)?;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn write_ibuff_infos(&self, ibuff_infos: &mut [IBuffInfoPc]) -> Result<()> {
                for (src, dst) in self.ibuffs.values().zip(ibuff_infos) {
                    dst.write_from(src)?;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn write_vals_k(
                &self,
                header: &mut [u16Pc],
                vals_k: &mut [u32Pc],
            ) -> Result<()> {
                header.write_from(&self.val_k_header[..])?;
                vals_k.write_from(&self.vals_k[..])
            }
            fn write_slots(&self, slots: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                slots.write_from(&self.slots[..])
            }
            fn write_slot_map(&self, slot_map: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                slot_map.write_from(&self.slot_map[..])
            }
            fn write_hk_constraint_datas(
                &self,
                hk_constraint_datas: &mut [HkConstraintDataPc],
            ) -> Result<()> {
                hk_constraint_datas.write_from(&self.hk_constraint_datas[..])
            }
            fn mat_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32> {
                self.mat_order.iter().map(|x: &u32Pc| x.get())
            }
            fn mats(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &impl DumpMatPc)> {
                self.mats.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
            }
            fn shapes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpShapePc> {
                self.shapes.iter()
            }
            fn hk_constraint(&self) -> Option<&impl DumpHkConstraintPc> {
                self.hk_constraint.as_ref()
            }
            fn block_header(&self) -> Option<impl Into<u32Pc>> {
                self.block_header.cloned()
            }
            fn blocks(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpBlockPc> {
                self.blocks.iter()
            }
            fn data(&self) -> &impl DumpModelDataPc<Data = Self::Data> {
                &self.data
            }
            fn asset_info(&self) -> (u32Pc, u32Pc) {
                (self.info.asset_key, self.info.asset_type)
            }
        }
