                    src: &BufType,
                    mut offset: usize,
                    flags: u8,
                    kind: u8,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let start = offset;
                    let (s1, s2, data) = if flags & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        let s1 = u16Xbox::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("s1")?;
                        offset += s1.size();
                        let s2 = u8::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("s2")?;
                        offset += s2.size();
                        let data = u8::slice_from_data(
                                &src[offset..],
                                s1.get() as usize + *s2 as usize + 2,
                            )
                            .context("data")?;
                        offset += data.size();
                        (*s1, *s2, data.into())
                    } else {
                        (u16Xbox::from(0), 0, NonNull::from_ref(&[] as &[u8]))
                    };
                    let vals_a = if flags != 0 {
                        offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                        let num = Self::COUNTS[(flags & 7) as usize]
                            + 2 * Self::COUNTS[(((flags >> 4) & !flags) & 7) as usize];
                        let vals_a = f32Xbox::slice_from_data(&src[offset..], num)
                            .context("vals_a")?;
                        offset += vals_a.size();
                        vals_a.into()
                    } else {
                        NonNull::from_ref(&[] as &[f32Xbox])
                    };
                    let vals = if flags & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        offset = align_offset(offset, 2);
                        let num = Self::COUNTS[((flags >> 4) & 7) as usize]
                            * (s1.get() as usize + 1);
                        let vals = AnimVals1Xbox::from_bytes(src, offset, num, kind)
                            .context("vals")?;
                        offset += vals.size();
                        vals
                    } else {
                        AnimVals1Xbox::empty(kind).context("vals")?
                    };
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        flags,
                        data,
                        s1,
                        s2,
                        vals_a,
                        vals,
                        size: offset - start,
                    })
                }
            }

            pub trait DumpObj1Pc {
                fn flags(&self) -> u8;
                fn write_s1(&self, s1: &mut u16Pc) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_s2(&self, s2: &mut u8) -> Result<()>;
                fn data_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals_a_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn write_data(&self, data: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_vals_a(&self, vals_a: &mut [f32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: AnimVals1DumpPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn vals_kind(&self) -> u8;
                fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals_size(&self) -> usize {
                    match self.vals_kind() {
                        0 => self.vals_len(),
                        1 | 2 | 3 => self.vals_len() * u16Pc::size_of(),
                        _ => {
                            ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                                format_args!("Invalid vals kind"),
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
                fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        let s1 = u16Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("s1")?;
                        self.write_s1(s1).context("write s1")?;
                        let s2 = u8::mut_from_data(dst).context("s2")?;
                        self.write_s2(s2).context("write s2")?;
                        let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.data_len())
                            .context("data")?;
                        self.write_data(data).context("write data")?;
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0 {
                        dst.align(4);
                        let vals_a = f32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_a_len())
                            .context("vals_a")?;
                        self.write_vals_a(vals_a).context("write vals_a")?;
                    }
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        dst.align(2);
                        let vals = AnimVals1DumpPc::mut_from_data(
                                dst,
                                self.vals_kind(),
                                self.vals_len(),
                            )
                            .context("vals")?;
                        self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    let mut size = 0;
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        size += u16Pc::size_of();
                        size += u8::size_of();
                        size += self.data_len();
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0 {
                        size = align_offset(size, 4);
                        size += f32Pc::size_of() * self.vals_a_len();
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0xf0 {
                        size = align_offset(size, 2);
                        size += self.vals_size();
                    }
                    size
                }
            }

                                                    kind,
                                                ),
                                            )
                                        }),
                                    ),
                                )?;
                            }
                        },

                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> RotationQuantizationRefPs3<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Polar32(vals) => {
                            RotationQuantizationRefPs3::Polar32(vals.as_ref())
                        }
                        Self::ThreeComp40(vals) => {
                            RotationQuantizationRefPs3::ThreeComp40(vals.as_ref())
                        }
                        Self::ThreeComp48(vals) => {
                            RotationQuantizationRefPs3::ThreeComp48(vals.as_ref())
                        }
                        Self::ThreeComp24(vals) => {
                            RotationQuantizationRefPs3::ThreeComp24(vals.as_ref())
                        }
                        Self::Straight16(vals) => {
                            RotationQuantizationRefPs3::Straight16(vals.as_ref())
                        }
                        Self::Uncompressed(vals) => {
                            RotationQuantizationRefPs3::Uncompressed(vals.as_ref())
                        }
                    }
                }
                pub fn align(kind: u8) -> usize {
                    match kind {
                        0 => 4,
                        1 => 1,
                        2 => 2,
                        3 => 1,
                        4 => 2,
                        5 => 4,
                        _ => 0,
                    }
                }
                pub fn kind(&self) -> u8 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Polar32(_) => 0,
                        Self::ThreeComp40(_) => 1,
                        Self::ThreeComp48(_) => 2,
                        Self::ThreeComp24(_) => 3,
                        Self::Straight16(_) => 4,
                        Self::Uncompressed(_) => 5,
                    }
                }

                        Self::ThreeComp40(vals) => {

            impl<'a> Obj2RefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], flags: u8, kind: u8) -> Result<Self> {
                    let mut offset = 0;
                    let start = offset;
                    let (s1, s2, data) = if flags & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        let s1 = u16Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("s1")?;
                        offset += s1.size();
                        let s2 = u8::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("s2")?;
                        offset += s2.size();
                        let data = u8::slice_from_data(
                                &src[offset..],
                                s1.get() as usize + *s2 as usize + 2,
                            )
                            .context("data")?;
                        offset += data.size();
                        (*s1, *s2, data.into())
                    } else {
                        (u16Pc::from(0), 0, slice::default())
                    };
                    let vals = if flags != 0 {
                        let align = RotationQuantizationRefPc::align(kind);
                        offset = ((offset + align - 1) & !(align - 1)) as usize;
                        let vals = RotationQuantizationRefPc::from_data(
                                &src[offset..],
                                s1.get() as usize + 1,
                                kind,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?;
                        offset += vals.size();
                        vals
                    } else {
                        RotationQuantizationRefPc::empty(kind).context("vals")?
                    };
                    let vals = Box::new(vals).into();
                    Ok(Self {
                        flags,
                        s1,
                        s2,
                        data,
                        vals,
                        size: offset - start,
                    })
                }
            }

                    src: &BufType,
                    mut offset: usize,
                    flags: u8,
                    kind: u8,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let start = offset;
                    let (s1, s2, data) = if flags & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        let s1 = u16Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("s1")?;

                                &src[offset..],

                        offset += data.size();
                        (*s1, *s2, data.into())

                        (u16Pc::from(0), 0, NonNull::from_ref(&[] as &[u8]))

                        vals

                        s2,
                        data,

            pub trait DumpObj2Pc {
                fn flags(&self) -> u8;
                fn data_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals_kind(&self) -> u8;
                fn write_s1(&self, s1: &mut u16Pc) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_s2(&self, s2: &mut u8) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_data(&self, data: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: RotationQuantizationDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn vals_size(&self) -> usize {
                    match self.vals_kind() {
                        0 => self.vals_len() * RotationPolar32Pc::size_of(),
                        1 => self.vals_len() * RotationThreeComp40Pc::size_of(),
                        2 => self.vals_len() * RotationThreeComp48Pc::size_of(),
                        3 => self.vals_len() * RotationThreeComp24Pc::size_of(),
                        4 => self.vals_len() * RotationStraight16Pc::size_of(),
                        5 => self.vals_len() * RotationUncompressedPc::size_of(),
                        _ => {
                            ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                                format_args!("Invalid vals kind"),
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
                fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    let mut size = 0;
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        size += u16Pc::size_of();
                        size += u8::size_of();
                        size += self.data_len();
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0 {
                        size = align_offset(
                            size,
                            RotationQuantizationPc::align(self.vals_kind()),
                        );
                        size += self.vals_size();
                    }
                    size
                }
                fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        let s1 = u16Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("s1")?;
                        self.write_s1(s1).context("write s1")?;
                        let s2 = u8::mut_from_data(dst).context("s2")?;
                        self.write_s2(s2).context("write s2")?;
                        let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.data_len())
                            .context("data")?;
                        self.write_data(data).context("write data")?;
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0 {
                        dst.align(RotationQuantizationPc::align(self.vals_kind()));
                        let vals = RotationQuantizationDumpPc::mut_from_data(
                                dst,
                                self.vals_len(),
                                self.vals_kind(),
                            )
                            .context("vals")?;
                        self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

            impl DumpObj2Pc for Obj2RefPc<'_> {
                fn flags(&self) -> u8 {
                    self.flags
                }
                fn data_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.data.len()
                }
                fn vals_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals.len()
                }
                fn vals_kind(&self) -> u8 {
                    self.vals.kind()
                }
                fn write_s1(&self, s1: &mut u16Pc) -> Result<()> {
                    s1.write_from(&self.s1)
                }
                fn write_s2(&self, s2: &mut u8) -> Result<()> {
                    s2.write_from(&self.s2)
                }
                fn write_data(&self, data: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()> {
                    data.write_from(&self.data[..])
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: RotationQuantizationDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    let vals_ref = &*self.vals;
                    match (vals_ref, vals) {
                        (
                            RotationQuantizationRefPc::Polar32(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::Polar32(dst),
                        ) => dst.write_from(src),
                        (
                            RotationQuantizationRefPc::ThreeComp40(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::ThreeComp40(dst),
                        ) => dst.write_from(src),
                        (
                            RotationQuantizationRefPc::ThreeComp48(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::ThreeComp48(dst),
                        ) => dst.write_from(src),
                        (
                            RotationQuantizationRefPc::ThreeComp24(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::ThreeComp24(dst),
                        ) => dst.write_from(src),
                        (
                            RotationQuantizationRefPc::Straight16(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::Straight16(dst),
                        ) => dst.write_from(src),
                        (
                            RotationQuantizationRefPc::Uncompressed(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::Uncompressed(dst),
                        ) => dst.write_from(src),
                        _ => {
                            Err(
                                ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                    let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "missmatched rotation quantization and dump rotation quantization",
                                        ),
                                    );
                                    error
                                }),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            impl DumpObj2Pc for Obj2 {
                fn flags(&self) -> u8 {
                    self.flags
                }
                fn data_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.data.len()
                }
                fn vals_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals.len()
                }
                fn vals_kind(&self) -> u8 {
                    self.vals.kind()
                }
                fn write_s1(&self, s1: &mut u16Pc) -> Result<()> {
                    *s1 = self.s1.into();
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_s2(&self, s2: &mut u8) -> Result<()> {
                    *s2 = self.s2;
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_data(&self, data: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()> {
                    data.write_from(self.data.as_slice())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: RotationQuantizationDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match (&self.vals, vals) {
                        (
                            RotationQuantization::Polar32(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::Polar32(dst),
                        ) => {
                            Ok(
                                for (src, dst) in src.iter().zip(dst) {
                                    *dst = src.conv();
                                },
                            )
                        }
                        (
                            RotationQuantization::ThreeComp40(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::ThreeComp40(dst),
                        ) => {
                            Ok(
                                for (src, dst) in src.iter().zip(dst) {
                                    *dst = src.conv();
                                },
                            )
                        }
                        (
                            RotationQuantization::ThreeComp48(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::ThreeComp48(dst),
                        ) => {
                            Ok(
                                for (src, dst) in src.iter().zip(dst) {
                                    *dst = src.conv();
                                },
                            )
                        }
                        (
                            RotationQuantization::ThreeComp24(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::ThreeComp24(dst),
                        ) => {
                            Ok(
                                for (src, dst) in src.iter().zip(dst) {
                                    *dst = src.conv();
                                },
                            )
                        }
                        (
                            RotationQuantization::Straight16(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::Straight16(dst),
                        ) => {
                            Ok(
                                for (src, dst) in src.iter().zip(dst) {
                                    *dst = src.conv();
                                },
                            )
                        }
                        (
                            RotationQuantization::Uncompressed(src),
                            RotationQuantizationDumpPc::Uncompressed(dst),
                        ) => {
                            Ok(
                                for (src, dst) in src.iter().zip(dst) {
                                    *dst = src.conv();
                                },
                            )
                        }
                        _ => {
                            Err(
                                ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                    let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "missmatched rotation quantization and dump rotation quantization",
                                        ),
                                    );
                                    error
                                }),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            impl<'a> BlocksRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], info: &AnimationInfoPc) -> Result<Self> {
                    let block_starts = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_starts_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.block_starts_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("block_starts")?;
                    let block_starts2 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_starts2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.block_starts2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("block_starts2")?;
                    let obj_c3 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.obj_c3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj_c3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj_c3")?;
                    let obj_c4 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.obj_c4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj_c4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj_c4")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(block_starts.len());
                    for (start, start2) in block_starts.iter().zip(block_starts2) {
                        let off = (start.get() + info.block_offset.get()) as usize;
                        let flags = FlagsPc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[off..],
                                info.vals_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("flags")?;
                        let flags2 = u8::slice_from_data(
                                &src[off + flags.size()..],
                                info.vals2_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("flags2")?;
                        let mut off = (info.block_offset.get() + start.get()
                            + info.data_offset.get()) as usize;
                        let mut vals_a = Vec::with_capacity(flags.len());
                        let mut vals_b = Vec::with_capacity(flags2.len());
                        for flag in flags {
                            let a = Obj1RefPc::from_data(
                                &src[off..],
                                flag.a,
                                flag.f & 3,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + a.size, 4);
                            let b = Obj2RefPc::from_data(
                                &src[off..],
                                flag.b,
                                (flag.f >> 2) & 0xf,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + b.size, 4);
                            let c = Obj1RefPc::from_data(
                                &src[off..],
                                flag.c,
                                (flag.f >> 6) & 3,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + c.size, 4);
                            vals_a.push(BlockValARefPc { a, b, c });
                        }
                        off = (info.block_offset.get() + start.get() + start2.get())
                            as usize;
                        for flag in flags2 {
                            let d = Obj1RefPc::from_data(
                                &src[off..],
                                flag & 0xf9,
                                (flag >> 1) & 3,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + d.size, 4);
                            vals_b.push(d);
                        }
                        blocks
                            .push(BlockValRefPc {
                                vals_a: vals_a.into_boxed_slice().into(),
                                vals_b: vals_b.into_boxed_slice().into(),
                            });
                    }
                    Ok(Self {
                        block_starts: block_starts.into(),
                        block_starts2: block_starts2.into(),
                        obj_c3: obj_c3.into(),
                        obj_c4: obj_c4.into(),
                        blocks: blocks.into_boxed_slice().into(),
                    })
                }
            }

            impl BlocksPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    offset: usize,
                    info: &AnimationInfoPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let block_starts = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.block_starts_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.block_starts_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("block_starts")?;
                    let block_starts2 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.block_starts2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.block_starts2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("block_starts2")?;
                    let obj_c3 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.obj_c3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj_c3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj_c3")?;
                    let obj_c4 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.obj_c4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj_c4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj_c4")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(block_starts.len());
                    for (start, start2) in block_starts.iter().zip(block_starts2) {
                        let off = (start.get() + info.block_offset.get()) as usize

                        let flags = FlagsPc::slice_from_data(

                                info.vals_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("flags")?;
                        let flags2 = u8::slice_from_data(
                                &src[off + flags.size()..],
                                info.vals2_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("flags2")?;
                        let mut off = (info.block_offset.get() + start.get()
                            + info.data_offset.get()) as usize + offset;
                        let mut vals_a = Vec::with_capacity(flags.len());
                        let mut vals_b = Vec::with_capacity(flags2.len());
                        for flag in flags {
                            let a = Obj1Pc::from_bytes(src, off, flag.a, flag.f & 3)?;
                            off = align_offset(off + a.size(), 4);
                            let b = Obj2Pc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                off,
                                flag.b,
                                (flag.f >> 2) & 0xf,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + b.size(), 4);
                            let c = Obj1Pc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                off,
                                flag.c,
                                (flag.f >> 6) & 3,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + c.size(), 4);
                            vals_a.push((a, b, c));
                        }
                        off = (info.block_offset.get() + start.get() + start2.get())
                            as usize + offset;
                        for flag in flags2 {
                            let d = Obj1Pc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                off,
                                flag & 0xf9,
                                (flag >> 1) & 3,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + d.size(), 4);
                            vals_b.push(d);
                        }
                        blocks
                            .push((
                                vals_a.into_boxed_slice(),
                                vals_b.into_boxed_slice(),
                            ));
                    }
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        block_starts: block_starts.into(),
                        block_starts2: block_starts2.into(),
                        obj_c3: obj_c3.into(),
                        obj_c4: obj_c4.into(),
                        blocks: blocks.into(),
                    })
                }
            }
            impl BlocksXbox {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    offset: usize,
                    info: &AnimationInfoXbox,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let block_starts = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.block_starts_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.block_starts_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("block_starts")?;
                    let block_starts2 = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.block_starts2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.block_starts2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("block_starts2")?;
                    let obj_c3 = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.obj_c3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj_c3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj_c3")?;
                    let obj_c4 = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.obj_c4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj_c4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj_c4")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(block_starts.len());
                    for (start, start2) in block_starts.iter().zip(block_starts2) {
                        let off = (start.get() + info.block_offset.get()) as usize
                            + offset;
                        let flags = FlagsXbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[off..],
                                info.vals_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("flags")?;
                        let flags2 = u8::slice_from_data(
                                &src[off + flags.size()..],
                                info.vals2_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("flags2")?;
                        let mut off = (info.block_offset.get() + start.get()
                            + info.data_offset.get()) as usize + offset;
                        let mut vals_a = Vec::with_capacity(flags.len());
                        let mut vals_b = Vec::with_capacity(flags2.len());
                        for flag in flags {
                            let a = Obj1Xbox::from_bytes(src, off, flag.a, flag.f & 3)?;
                            off = align_offset(off + a.size(), 4);
                            let b = Obj2Xbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                off,
                                flag.b,
                                (flag.f >> 2) & 0xf,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + b.size(), 4);
                            let c = Obj1Xbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                off,
                                flag.c,
                                (flag.f >> 6) & 3,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + c.size(), 4);
                            vals_a.push((a, b, c));
                        }
                        off = (info.block_offset.get() + start.get() + start2.get())
                            as usize + offset;
                        for flag in flags2 {
                            let d = Obj1Xbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                off,
                                flag & 0xf9,
                                (flag >> 1) & 3,
                            )?;
                            off = align_offset(off + d.size(), 4);
                            vals_b.push(d);
                        }
                        blocks
                            .push((
                                vals_a.into_boxed_slice(),
                                vals_b.into_boxed_slice(),
                            ));
                    }
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        block_starts: block_starts.into(),
                        block_starts2: block_starts2.into(),
                        obj_c3: obj_c3.into(),
                        obj_c4: obj_c4.into(),
                        blocks: blocks.into(),
                    })
                }
            }

            impl BlocksPc {
                pub fn block_starts(&self) -> &[u32Pc] {
                    unsafe { self.block_starts.as_ref() }
                }
                pub fn block_starts2(&self) -> &[u32Pc] {
                    unsafe { self.block_starts2.as_ref() }
                }
                pub fn obj_c3(&self) -> &[u32Pc] {
                    unsafe { self.obj_c3.as_ref() }
                }
                pub fn obj_c4(&self) -> &[u32Pc] {
                    unsafe { self.obj_c4.as_ref() }
                }
                pub fn blocks(&self) -> Vec<(&[(Obj1Pc, Obj2Pc, Obj1Pc)], &[Obj1Pc])> {
                    self.blocks.iter().map(|(a, b)| (&a[..], &b[..])).collect()
                }
            }

            pub struct Blocks {
                pub obj_c3: Vec<u32>,
                pub obj_c4: Vec<u32>,
                pub blocks: Vec<(Vec<(Obj1, Obj2, Obj1)>, Vec<Obj1>)>,
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::fmt::Debug for Blocks {
                #[inline]
                fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                    ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field3_finish(
                        f,
                        "Blocks",
                        "obj_c3",
                        &self.obj_c3,
                        "obj_c4",
                        &self.obj_c4,
                        "blocks",
                        &&self.blocks,
                    )
                }
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::clone::Clone for Blocks {
                #[inline]
                fn clone(&self) -> Blocks {
                    Blocks {
                        obj_c3: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.obj_c3),
                        obj_c4: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.obj_c4),
                        blocks: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.blocks),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&BlocksPc> for Blocks {
                fn from(val: &BlocksPc) -> Self {
                    Self {
                        obj_c3: val.obj_c3().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        obj_c4: val.obj_c4().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        blocks: val
                            .blocks
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(a, b)| (
                                a
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|(x, y, z)| (x.into(), y.into(), z.into()))
                                    .collect(),
                                b.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                            ))
                            .collect(),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&BlocksXbox> for Blocks {
                fn from(val: &BlocksXbox) -> Self {
                    Self {
                        obj_c3: val.obj_c3().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        obj_c4: val.obj_c4().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        blocks: val
                            .blocks
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(a, b)| (
                                a
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|(x, y, z)| (x.into(), y.into(), z.into()))
                                    .collect(),
                                b.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                            ))
                            .collect(),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&BlocksPs3> for Blocks {
                fn from(val: &BlocksPs3) -> Self {
                    Self {
                        obj_c3: val.obj_c3().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        obj_c4: val.obj_c4().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        blocks: val
                            .blocks
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(a, b)| (

                                    .map(|(x, y, z)| (x.into(), y.into(), z.into()))
                                    .collect(),
                                b.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                            ))
                            .collect(),
                    }
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpBlocksPc {
                fn blocks_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn block1_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn block2_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj_c3_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj_c4_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn blocks(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (
                        impl Iterator<
                            Item = (&impl DumpObj1Pc, &impl DumpObj2Pc, &impl DumpObj1Pc),
                        >,
                        impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpObj1Pc>,
                    ),
                >;
                fn write_obj_c3(&self, obj_c3: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj_c4(&self, obj_c4: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    info: &mut AnimationInfoPc,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    info.vals_num = self.block1_len().conv();
                    info.vals2_num = self.block2_len().conv();
                    info.data_offset = (self.block1_len() * FlagsPc::size_of()
                        + self.block2_len())
                        .conv();
                    info.block_starts_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let block_starts = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.blocks_len())
                        .context("block_starts")?;
                    info.block_starts_num = block_starts.len().conv();
                    info.block_starts2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let block_starts2 = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.blocks_len(),
                        )
                        .context("block_starts2")?;
                    info.block_starts2_num = block_starts2.len().conv();
                    info.obj_c3_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj_c3 = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj_c3_len())
                        .context("obj_c3")?;
                    self.write_obj_c3(obj_c3).context("write obj_c3")?;
                    info.obj_c3_num = obj_c3.len().conv();
                    info.obj_c4_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj_c4 = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj_c4_len())
                        .context("obj_c4")?;
                    self.write_obj_c4(obj_c4).context("write obj_c4")?;
                    info.obj_c4_num = obj_c4.len().conv();
                    let start_off = dst.offset;
                    for (i, ((vals, vals2), (block_start, block_start2))) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_starts.iter_mut().zip(block_starts2))
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        let start = (dst.offset - start_off);
                        *block_start = start.conv();
                        let flags = FlagsPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.block1_len())
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} flags", i))
                            }))?;
                        let flags2 = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.block2_len())
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} flags2", i))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(4);
                        for (j, ((a, b, c), flag)) in vals.zip(flags).enumerate() {
                            flag.f = (a.vals_kind() | (b.vals_kind() << 2)
                                | (c.vals_kind() << 6));
                            flag.a = a.flags();
                            flag.b = b.flags();
                            flag.c = c.flags();
                            a.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} a {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                            b.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} b {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                            c.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} c {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                        }
                        *block_start2 = (dst.offset - start_off - start).conv();
                        for (j, (d, flag)) in vals2.zip(flags2).enumerate() {
                            *flag = (d.flags() | (d.vals_kind() << 1));
                            d.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} d {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                        }
                        dst.align(4);
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    let mut size = 0;
                    size += u32Pc::size_of() * self.blocks_len() * 2;
                    size += u32Pc::size_of() * (self.obj_c3_len() + self.obj_c4_len());
                    let mut blocks_size = 0;
                    for (vals, vals2) in self.blocks() {
                        blocks_size += FlagsPc::size_of() * self.block1_len();
                        blocks_size += u8::size_of() * self.block2_len();
                        blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size, 4);
                        for (a, b, c) in vals {
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + a.size(), 4);
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + b.size(), 4);
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + c.size(), 4);
                        }
                        for d in vals2 {
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + d.size(), 4);
                        }
                        blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size, 16);
                    }
                    size + blocks_size
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpBlocksXbox {
                fn blocks_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn block1_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn block2_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj_c3_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj_c4_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn blocks(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (
                        impl Iterator<
                            Item = (
                                &impl DumpObj1Xbox,
                                &impl DumpObj2Xbox,
                                &impl DumpObj1Xbox,
                            ),
                        >,
                        impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpObj1Xbox>,
                    ),
                >;
                fn write_obj_c3(&self, obj_c3: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj_c4(&self, obj_c4: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    info: &mut AnimationInfoXbox,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    info.vals_num = self.block1_len().conv();
                    info.vals2_num = self.block2_len().conv();
                    info.data_offset = (self.block1_len() * FlagsXbox::size_of()
                        + self.block2_len())
                        .conv();
                    info.block_starts_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let block_starts = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.blocks_len(),
                        )
                        .context("block_starts")?;
                    info.block_starts_num = block_starts.len().conv();
                    info.block_starts2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let block_starts2 = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.blocks_len(),
                        )
                        .context("block_starts2")?;
                    info.block_starts2_num = block_starts2.len().conv();
                    info.obj_c3_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj_c3 = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj_c3_len())
                        .context("obj_c3")?;
                    self.write_obj_c3(obj_c3).context("write obj_c3")?;
                    info.obj_c3_num = obj_c3.len().conv();
                    info.obj_c4_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj_c4 = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj_c4_len())
                        .context("obj_c4")?;
                    self.write_obj_c4(obj_c4).context("write obj_c4")?;
                    info.obj_c4_num = obj_c4.len().conv();
                    let start_off = dst.offset;
                    for (i, ((vals, vals2), (block_start, block_start2))) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_starts.iter_mut().zip(block_starts2))
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        let start = (dst.offset - start_off);
                        *block_start = start.conv();
                        let flags = FlagsXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                                dst,
                                self.block1_len(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} flags", i))
                            }))?;
                        let flags2 = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.block2_len())
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} flags2", i))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(4);
                        for (j, ((a, b, c), flag)) in vals.zip(flags).enumerate() {
                            flag.f = (a.vals_kind() | (b.vals_kind() << 2)
                                | (c.vals_kind() << 6));
                            flag.a = a.flags();
                            flag.b = b.flags();
                            flag.c = c.flags();
                            a.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} a {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                            b.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} b {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                            c.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} c {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                        }
                        *block_start2 = (dst.offset - start_off - start).conv();
                        for (j, (d, flag)) in vals2.zip(flags2).enumerate() {
                            *flag = (d.flags() | (d.vals_kind() << 1));
                            d.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} d {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                        }
                        dst.align(4);
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    let mut size = 0;
                    size += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.blocks_len() * 2;
                    size += u32Xbox::size_of() * (self.obj_c3_len() + self.obj_c4_len());
                    let mut blocks_size = 0;
                    for (vals, vals2) in self.blocks() {
                        blocks_size += FlagsXbox::size_of() * self.block1_len();
                        blocks_size += u8::size_of() * self.block2_len();
                        blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size, 4);
                        for (a, b, c) in vals {
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + a.size(), 4);
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + b.size(), 4);
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + c.size(), 4);
                        }
                        for d in vals2 {
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + d.size(), 4);
                        }
                        blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size, 16);
                    }
                    size + blocks_size
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpBlocksPs3 {
                fn blocks_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn block1_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn block2_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj_c3_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj_c4_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn blocks(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (
                        impl Iterator<
                            Item = (
                                &impl DumpObj1Ps3,
                                &impl DumpObj2Ps3,
                                &impl DumpObj1Ps3,
                            ),
                        >,
                        impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpObj1Ps3>,
                    ),
                >;
                fn write_obj_c3(&self, obj_c3: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj_c4(&self, obj_c4: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    info: &mut AnimationInfoPs3,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    info.vals_num = self.block1_len().conv();
                    info.vals2_num = self.block2_len().conv();
                    info.data_offset = (self.block1_len() * FlagsPs3::size_of()
                        + self.block2_len())
                        .conv();
                    info.block_starts_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let block_starts = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.blocks_len(),
                        )
                        .context("block_starts")?;
                    info.block_starts_num = block_starts.len().conv();
                    info.block_starts2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let block_starts2 = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.blocks_len(),
                        )
                        .context("block_starts2")?;
                    info.block_starts2_num = block_starts2.len().conv();
                    info.obj_c3_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj_c3 = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj_c3_len())
                        .context("obj_c3")?;
                    self.write_obj_c3(obj_c3).context("write obj_c3")?;
                    info.obj_c3_num = obj_c3.len().conv();
                    info.obj_c4_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj_c4 = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj_c4_len())
                        .context("obj_c4")?;
                    self.write_obj_c4(obj_c4).context("write obj_c4")?;
                    info.obj_c4_num = obj_c4.len().conv();
                    let start_off = dst.offset;
                    for (i, ((vals, vals2), (block_start, block_start2))) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_starts.iter_mut().zip(block_starts2))
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        let start = (dst.offset - start_off);
                        *block_start = start.conv();
                        let flags = FlagsPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.block1_len())
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} flags", i))
                            }))?;
                        let flags2 = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.block2_len())
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} flags2", i))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(4);
                        for (j, ((a, b, c), flag)) in vals.zip(flags).enumerate() {
                            flag.f = (a.vals_kind() | (b.vals_kind() << 2)
                                | (c.vals_kind() << 6));
                            flag.a = a.flags();
                            flag.b = b.flags();
                            flag.c = c.flags();
                            a.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} a {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                            b.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} b {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                            c.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} c {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                        }
                        *block_start2 = (dst.offset - start_off - start).conv();
                        for (j, (d, flag)) in vals2.zip(flags2).enumerate() {
                            *flag = (d.flags() | (d.vals_kind() << 1));
                            d.dump_into(dst)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0} d {1}", i, j))
                                }))?;
                            dst.align(4);
                        }
                        dst.align(4);
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    let mut size = 0;
                    size += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.blocks_len() * 2;
                    size += u32Ps3::size_of() * (self.obj_c3_len() + self.obj_c4_len());
                    let mut blocks_size = 0;
                    for (vals, vals2) in self.blocks() {
                        blocks_size += FlagsPs3::size_of() * self.block1_len();
                        blocks_size += u8::size_of() * self.block2_len();
                        blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size, 4);
                        for (a, b, c) in vals {
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + a.size(), 4);
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + b.size(), 4);
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + c.size(), 4);
                        }
                        for d in vals2 {
                            blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size + d.size(), 4);
                        }
                        blocks_size = align_offset(blocks_size, 16);
                    }
                    size + blocks_size
                }
            }
            impl DumpBlocksPc for BlocksRefPc<'_> {
                fn blocks_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.blocks.len()
                }
                fn block1_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.blocks[0].vals_a.len()
                }
                fn block2_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.blocks[0].vals_b.len()
                }
                fn obj_c3_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.obj_c3.len()
                }
                fn obj_c4_len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.obj_c4.len()
                }
                fn blocks(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (
                        impl Iterator<
                            Item = (&impl DumpObj1Pc, &impl DumpObj2Pc, &impl DumpObj1Pc),
                        >,
                        impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpObj1Pc>,
                    ),
                > {
                    self.blocks
                        .iter()
                        .map(|vals| (
                            vals
                                .vals_a
                                .iter()
                                .map(|BlockValARefPc { a, b, c }| (a, b, c)),
                            vals.vals_b.iter(),
                        ))
                }
                fn write_obj_c3(&self, obj_c3: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    obj_c3.write_from(&self.obj_c3[..])
                }
                fn write_obj_c4(&self, obj_c4: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    obj_c4.write_from(&self.obj_c4[..])
                }
            }

            impl<'a> AnimationRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(
                    src: &'a [u8],
                    info: &'a AnimationInfoPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let obj1 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.obj1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj1_num.get() as usize * 2,
                        )
                        .context("obj1")?;
                    let obj2 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.obj2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj2_num.get() as usize * 4,
                        )
                        .context("obj2")?;
                    let obj3 = Obj3Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.obj3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("Obj3")?;
                    let bones = CrcPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bones_offset.get() as usize..],
                            (info.vals_num.get() + info.obj1_num.get()) as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bones")?;
                    let (obj5_header, obj5_a, obj5_b) = if info.obj5_offset.get() != 0 {
                        let obj5_header = Obj5HeaderPc::from_data(
                                &src[info.obj5_offset.get() as usize..],
                            )
                            .context("obj5_header")?;
                        let obj5_a = Obj5ValPc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[obj5_header.obj_a_offset.get() as usize..],
                                obj5_header.obj_a_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("obj5_a")?;
                        let obj5_b = Obj5ValPc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[obj5_header.obj_b_offset.get() as usize..],
                                obj5_header.obj_b_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("obj5_b")?;
                        (Some(obj5_header.into()), obj5_a, obj5_b)
                    } else {
                        (None, &[] as &_, &[] as &_)
                    };
                    let blocks = if info.kind.get() == 3 {
                        Some(BlocksRefPc::from_data(src, info).context("blocks")?)
                    } else if info.kind.get() < 3 {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!("Unhandled animation type {0}", info.kind),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::pak::animation",
                                            "lotrc::level::pak::animation",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                        None
                    } else {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!("Unknown animation type {0}", info.kind),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::pak::animation",

                                        ),

                                }
                            }

            impl AnimationPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    offset: usize,
                    info_src: &BufType,
                    info_offset: usize,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = AnimationInfoPc::from_data(&info_src[info_offset..])
                        .context("info")?;
                    let obj1 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.obj1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj1_num.get() as usize * 2,
                        )
                        .context("obj1")?;
                    let obj2 = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.obj2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj2_num.get() as usize * 4,
                        )
                        .context("obj2")?;
                    let obj3 = Obj3Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.obj3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            info.obj3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("Obj3")?;
                    let bones = CrcPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset + info.bones_offset.get() as usize..],
                            (info.vals_num.get() + info.obj1_num.get()) as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bones")?;
                    let (obj5_header, obj5_a, obj5_b) = if info.obj5_offset.get() != 0 {
                        let obj5_header = Obj5HeaderPc::from_data(
                                &src[offset + info.obj5_offset.get() as usize..],
                            )
                            .context("obj5_header")?;
                        let obj5_a = Obj5ValPc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[offset + obj5_header.obj_a_offset.get() as usize..],
                                obj5_header.obj_a_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("obj5_a")?;
                        let obj5_b = Obj5ValPc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[offset + obj5_header.obj_b_offset.get() as usize..],
                                obj5_header.obj_b_num.get() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("obj5_b")?;
                        (Some(NonNull::from_ref(obj5_header)), obj5_a, obj5_b)
                    } else {
                        (None, &[] as &_, &[] as &_)
                    };
                    let blocks = if info.kind.get() == 3 {
                        Some(BlocksPc::from_bytes(src, offset, info).context("blocks")?)
                    } else if info.kind.get() < 3 {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!("Unhandled animation type {0}", info.kind),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::pak::animation",
                                            "lotrc::level::pak::animation",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                        None
                    } else {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!("Unknown animation type {0}", info.kind),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::pak::animation",
                                            "lotrc::level::pak::animation",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                        None
                    };
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        _ptr_info: info_src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        obj1: obj1.into(),
                        obj2: obj2.into(),
                        obj3: obj3.into(),
                        bones: bones.into(),
                        obj5_header,
                        obj5_a: obj5_a.into(),
                        obj5_b: obj5_b.into(),
                        blocks,
                        size: info.size.get() as usize,
                    })
                }
            }

            pub trait DumpAnimationPc {
                fn key(&self) -> u32;
                fn gamemodemask(&self) -> i32;
                fn obj1_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj2_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj3_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn bones_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj5_a_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj5_b_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn write_obj1(&self, obj1: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj2(&self, obj2: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj3(&self, obj3: &mut [Obj3Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bones(&self, bones: &mut [CrcPc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj5_a(&self, obj5_a: &mut [Obj5ValPc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj5_b(&self, obj5_b: &mut [Obj5ValPc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn blocks(&self) -> Option<&impl DumpBlocksPc>;
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    info: &mut AnimationInfoPc,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    info.offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let start = dst.offset;
                    info.obj1_offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    let obj1 = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj1_len())
                        .context("obj1")?;
                    info.obj1_num = (obj1.len() / 2).conv();
                    self.write_obj1(obj1).context("write obj1")?;
                    info.obj2_offset = if self.obj2_len() == 0 {
                        0
                    } else {
                        dst.offset - start
                    }
                        .conv();
                    let obj2 = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj2_len())
                        .context("obj2")?;
                    info.obj2_num = (obj2.len() / 4).conv();
                    self.write_obj2(obj2).context("write obj2")?;
                    if let Some(blocks) = self.blocks() {
                        blocks.dump_into(dst, info).context("blocks")?;
                    }
                    info.obj3_offset = if self.obj3_len() == 0 {
                        0
                    } else {
                        dst.offset - start
                    }
                        .conv();
                    let obj3 = Obj3Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj3_len())
                        .context("obj3")?;
                    info.obj3_num = obj3.len().conv();
                    self.write_obj3(obj3).context("write obj3")?;
                    info.bones_offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    let bones = CrcPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.bones_len())
                        .context("bones")?;
                    self.write_bones(bones).context("write bones")?;
                    if self.obj5_a_len() != 0 || self.obj5_b_len() != 0 {
                        let obj5_header = Obj5HeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst)
                            .context("obj5_header")?;
                        obj5_header.obj_a_offset = if self.obj5_a_len() == 0 {
                            0
                        } else {
                            dst.offset - start
                        }
                            .conv();
                        let obj5_a = Obj5ValPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                                dst,
                                self.obj5_a_len(),
                            )
                            .context("obj5_a")?;
                        obj5_header.obj_a_num = obj5_a.len().conv();
                        self.write_obj5_a(obj5_a).context("write obj5_a")?;
                        obj5_header.obj_b_offset = if self.obj5_b_len() == 0 {
                            0
                        } else {
                            dst.offset - start
                        }
                            .conv();
                        let obj5_b = Obj5ValPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                                dst,
                                self.obj5_b_len(),
                            )
                            .context("obj5_b")?;
                        obj5_header.obj_b_num = obj5_b.len().conv();
                        self.write_obj5_b(obj5_b).context("write obj5_b")?;
                    } else {
                        info.obj5_offset = 0usize.conv();
                    }
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.size = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    let mut size = 0;
                    size += (self.obj1_len() + self.obj2_len()) * u32Pc::size_of();
                    if let Some(blocks) = self.blocks() {
                        size += blocks.size();
                    }
                    size += Obj3Pc::size_of() * self.obj3_len();
                    size += CrcPc::size_of() * self.bones_len();
                    if self.obj5_a_len() != 0 || self.obj5_b_len() != 0 {
                        size += Obj5HeaderPc::size_of();
                        size
                            += (self.obj5_a_len() + self.obj5_b_len())
                                * Obj5ValPc::size_of();
                    }
                    align_offset(size, 16)
                }
            }

            pub struct AnimationsRawPc {
                _ptr: BufType,
                _data: Box<[CompressedDataRef]>,
                anim_infos: NonNull<[AnimationInfoPc]>,
                block_infos: NonNull<[AnimationBlockInfoPc]>,
                anim_info_offset: usize,
            }
            pub struct AnimationsRawXbox {
                _ptr: BufType,
                _data: Box<[CompressedDataRef]>,
                anim_infos: NonNull<[AnimationInfoXbox]>,
                block_infos: NonNull<[AnimationBlockInfoXbox]>,
                anim_info_offset: usize,
            }
            pub struct AnimationsRawPs3 {
                _ptr: BufType,
                _data: Box<[CompressedDataRef]>,
                anim_infos: NonNull<[AnimationInfoPs3]>,
                block_infos: NonNull<[AnimationBlockInfoPs3]>,
                anim_info_offset: usize,
            }
            impl AnimationsRawPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
                    info_src: &BufType,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let anim_off = pak_header.animation_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    let anim_infos = AnimationInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &info_src[anim_off..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &info_src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.get()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let _data = block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| CompressedDataRef::from_bytes(
                            src,
                            info.offset.get() as usize,
                            info.size.get() as usize,
                            info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                        ))
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        _data: _data.into(),
                        anim_infos: anim_infos.into(),
                        block_infos: block_infos.into(),
                        anim_info_offset: anim_off,
                    })
                }
                pub fn parse(&self) -> Result<()> {
                    self._data.par_iter().map(|x| x.decomp()).collect()
                }
            }
            impl AnimationsRawXbox {
                pub fn from_bytes(
