            impl<'a> AnimationsRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(
                    anim_infos: &'a [AnimationInfoPc],
                    blocks: &'a [CompressedDataRefAlt<'_>],
                    block_infos: &'a [AnimationBlockInfoPc],
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let mut offsets = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0, blocks.len());
                    let mut animations = MapImpl::with_capacity(anim_infos.len());
                    for info in anim_infos {
                        for (i, (data, offset)) in blocks
                            .iter()
                            .zip(offsets.iter())
                            .enumerate()
                        {
                            if info.gamemodemask.get() >> i & 1 != 0 {
                                let val = AnimationRefPc::from_data(
                                        &data.get()[*offset..],
                                        info,
                                    )
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation {0}", i))
                                    }))?;
                                animations.insert(info.key.get(), val);
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        for (i, offset) in offsets.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            if info.gamemodemask.get() >> i & 1 != 0 {
                                *offset += animations.last().unwrap().1.size();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(Self {
                        animations: animations.into(),
                        block_infos: block_infos.into(),
                    })
                }
            }

            impl TryFrom<AnimationsRawPc> for AnimationsPc {
                type Error = anyhow::Error;
                fn try_from(
                    AnimationsRawPc {
                        _ptr,
                        _data,
                        anim_infos,
                        block_infos,
                        mut anim_info_offset,
                    }: AnimationsRawPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let mut _data = _data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.get().cloned())
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()
                        .context("data")?;
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Animations block data parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let infos = unsafe { anim_infos.as_ref() };
                    let mut offsets = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0, _data.len());
                    let mut animations = IndexMap::with_capacity(anim_infos.len());
                    for info in infos {
                        for (i, (data, offset)) in _data
                            .iter()
                            .zip(offsets.iter())
                            .enumerate()
                        {
                            if info.gamemodemask.get() >> i & 1 != 0 {
                                let val = AnimationPc::from_bytes(
                                        data,
                                        *offset,
                                        &_ptr,
                                        anim_info_offset,
                                    )
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation {0}", i))
                                    }))?;
                                animations.insert(info.key.get(), val);
                                anim_info_offset += AnimationInfoPc::size_of();
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        for (i, offset) in offsets.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            if info.gamemodemask.get() >> i & 1 != 0 {
                                *offset += animations.last().unwrap().1.size();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Animations parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr,
                        _data: _data.into(),
                        animations,
                        block_infos,
                    })
                }
            }

                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation {0}", i))
                                    }))?;
                                animations.insert(info.key.get(), val);
                                anim_info_offset += AnimationInfoXbox::size_of();
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        for (i, offset) in offsets.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            if info.gamemodemask.get() >> i & 1 != 0 {
                                *offset += animations.last().unwrap().1.size();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Animations parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr,
                        _data: _data.into(),
                        animations,
                        block_infos,
                    })
                }
            }
            impl TryFrom<AnimationsRawPs3> for AnimationsPs3 {
                type Error = anyhow::Error;
                fn try_from(
                    AnimationsRawPs3 {
                        _ptr,
                        _data,
                        anim_infos,
                        block_infos,
                        mut anim_info_offset,
                    }: AnimationsRawPs3,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let mut _data = _data
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.get().cloned())
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()
                        .context("data")?;
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Animations block data parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let infos = unsafe { anim_infos.as_ref() };
                    let mut offsets = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0, _data.len());
                    let mut animations = IndexMap::with_capacity(anim_infos.len());
                    for info in infos {
                        for (i, (data, offset)) in _data
                            .iter()
                            .zip(offsets.iter())
                            .enumerate()
                        {
                            if info.gamemodemask.get() >> i & 1 != 0 {
                                let val = AnimationPs3::from_bytes(
                                        data,
                                        *offset,
                                        &_ptr,
                                        anim_info_offset,
                                    )
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation {0}", i))
                                    }))?;
                                animations.insert(info.key.get(), val);
                                anim_info_offset += AnimationInfoPs3::size_of();
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        for (i, offset) in offsets.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            if info.gamemodemask.get() >> i & 1 != 0 {
                                *offset += animations.last().unwrap().1.size();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Animations parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr,
                        _data: _data.into(),
                        animations,
                        block_infos,
                    })
                }
            }

            pub trait DumpAnimationsPc {
                fn animation_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn block_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn animations(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpAnimationPc>;
                fn write_block_infos(
                    &self,
                    infos: &mut [AnimationBlockInfoPc],
                ) -> Result<()>;
                fn info_counts(&self, counts: &mut InfoCounts) {
                    counts.animations = self.animation_num();
                    counts.animation_blocks = self.block_num();
                }
                fn dump<D>(
                    &self,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<D>,
                ) -> Result<Vec<CompressedBlock>> {
                    let mut animations = self.animations().collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    animations.sort_by_key(|x| x.key());
                    let animation_block_infos = infos.animation_blocks.as_ref();
                    let mut block_sizes = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0usize,
                        animation_block_infos.len(),
                    );
                    for animation in animations.iter() {
                        let gamemodemask = animation.gamemodemask();
                        let anim_size = animation.size();
                        for (i, size) in block_sizes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            if gamemodemask >> i & 1 == 0 {
                                continue;
                            }
                            *size += anim_size;
                        }
                    }
                    self.write_block_infos(animation_block_infos)
                        .context("write block_infos")?;
                    for (size, block_info) in block_sizes
                        .iter()
                        .zip(animation_block_infos)
                    {
                        block_info.size = (*size).conv();
                    }
                    let animation_infos = infos.animations.as_ref();
                    let mut blocks = block_sizes
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|size| CompressedBlock::with_capacity(size))
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    let mut data = blocks
                        .iter_mut()
                        .map(|x| x.dump_slice())
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    for (j, (info, animation)) in animation_infos
                        .iter_mut()
                        .zip(animations)
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        let gamemodemask = animation.gamemodemask();
                        let mut anim_dump: Option<NonNull<[u8]>> = None;
                        for (i, dst) in data.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            if gamemodemask >> i & 1 == 0 {
                                continue;
                            }
                            if let Some(val) = anim_dump {
                                unsafe { val.as_ref() }
                                    .dump_into(dst)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("pre-dumped animation {0}", j),
                                        )
                                    }))?;
                            } else {
                                let old_off = dst.offset;
                                let old_ptr = NonNull::from_ref(&dst.vals[0]);
                                animation
                                    .dump_into(dst, info)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation {0}", j))
                                    }))?;
                                anim_dump
                                    .replace(
                                        NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(old_ptr, dst.offset - old_off),
                                    );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(blocks)
                }
            }

            impl<'a> ObjsRefPc<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(
                    src: &'a [u8],
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
                    bin: &BinRefPc<'a>,
                    name: u32,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_infos = ModelInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_infos = ShapeInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_shape_infos = HkShapeInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_infos = HkConstraintInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.get()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.foliage_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_vals_infos = RadiosityValsInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = &bin.texture_data;
                    let textures: MapImpl<_, _> = texture_infos
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, info)| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            TextureRefPc::from_data(info, texture_data)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let model_data = &bin.model_data;
                    let models: MapImpl<_, _> = model_infos
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, info)| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            ModelRefPc::from_data(src, info, model_data)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let effects: MapImpl<_, _> = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            GameObjsRefPc::from_data(
                                &src[info.offset.get()
                                    as usize..info.offset.get() as usize
                                    + info.size.get() as usize],
                                info.gamemodemask.get(),
                            )?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let gfxs: MapImpl<_, _> = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| (
                            info.key.get(),
                            (&src[info.offset.get()
                                as usize..(info.offset.get() + info.size.get()) as usize])
                                .into(),
                        ))
                        .collect();
                    let mut foliages = IndexMap::<
                        u32,
                        Vec<FoliageRefPc>,
                    >::with_capacity(foliage_infos.len());
                    for (i, info) in foliage_infos.iter().enumerate() {
                        let foliage = FoliageRefPc::from_data(src, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        foliages
                            .entry(foliage.info.key.get())
                            .or_default()
                            .push(foliage);
                    }
                    let foliages: MapImpl<_, _> = foliages
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into_boxed_slice().into()))
                        .collect();
                    let radiosity_name = hash_string(b"_radiosity", Some(name));
                    let ind = model_data.get_index_of(&radiosity_name);
                    let data = ind
                        .and_then(|x| model_data.get_index(x))
                        .map(|(_, x)| x)
                        .copied();
                    let usage = ind
                        .map(|x| bin.model_handles()[x].kind.get())
                        .unwrap_or_default();
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRefPc::from_data(
                            src,
                            radiosity_vals_infos,
                            data,
                            usage,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        model_infos: model_infos.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        shape_infos: shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_shape_infos: hk_shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_infos: hk_constraint_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        foliage_infos: foliage_infos.into(),
                        radiosity_vals_infos: radiosity_vals_infos.into(),
                        textures: textures.into(),
                        models: models.into(),
                        effects: effects.into(),
                        gfxs: gfxs.into(),
                        foliages: foliages.into(),
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            impl<'a> ObjsRefXbox<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(
                    src: &'a [u8],
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderXbox,
                    bin: &BinRefXbox<'a>,
                    name: u32,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_infos = ModelInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_infos = ShapeInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_shape_infos = HkShapeInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_infos = HkConstraintInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.get()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.foliage_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_vals_infos = RadiosityValsInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = &bin.texture_data;
                    let textures: MapImpl<_, _> = texture_infos
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, info)| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            TextureRefXbox::from_data(info, texture_data)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let model_data = &bin.model_data;
                    let models: MapImpl<_, _> = model_infos
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, info)| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            ModelRefXbox::from_data(src, info, model_data)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let effects: MapImpl<_, _> = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            GameObjsRefXbox::from_data(
                                &src[info.offset.get()
                                    as usize..info.offset.get() as usize
                                    + info.size.get() as usize],
                                info.gamemodemask.get(),
                            )?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let gfxs: MapImpl<_, _> = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| (
                            info.key.get(),
                            (&src[info.offset.get()
                                as usize..(info.offset.get() + info.size.get()) as usize])
                                .into(),
                        ))
                        .collect();
                    let mut foliages = IndexMap::<
                        u32,
                        Vec<FoliageRefXbox>,
                    >::with_capacity(foliage_infos.len());
                    for (i, info) in foliage_infos.iter().enumerate() {
                        let foliage = FoliageRefXbox::from_data(src, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        foliages
                            .entry(foliage.info.key.get())
                            .or_default()
                            .push(foliage);
                    }
                    let foliages: MapImpl<_, _> = foliages
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into_boxed_slice().into()))
                        .collect();
                    let radiosity_name = hash_string(b"_radiosity", Some(name));
                    let ind = model_data.get_index_of(&radiosity_name);
                    let data = ind
                        .and_then(|x| model_data.get_index(x))
                        .map(|(_, x)| x)
                        .copied();
                    let usage = ind
                        .map(|x| bin.model_handles()[x].kind.get())
                        .unwrap_or_default();
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRefXbox::from_data(
                            src,
                            radiosity_vals_infos,
                            data,
                            usage,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        model_infos: model_infos.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        shape_infos: shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_shape_infos: hk_shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_infos: hk_constraint_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        foliage_infos: foliage_infos.into(),
                        radiosity_vals_infos: radiosity_vals_infos.into(),
                        textures: textures.into(),
                        models: models.into(),
                        effects: effects.into(),
                        gfxs: gfxs.into(),
                        foliages: foliages.into(),
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            impl<'a> ObjsRefPs3<'a> {
                pub fn from_data(
                    src: &'a [u8],
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderPs3,
                    bin: &BinRefPs3<'a>,
                    name: u32,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_infos = ModelInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_infos = ShapeInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_shape_infos = HkShapeInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_infos = HkConstraintInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.get()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.foliage_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_vals_infos = RadiosityValsInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = &bin.texture_data;
                    let textures: MapImpl<_, _> = texture_infos
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, info)| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            TextureRefPs3::from_data(info, texture_data)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let model_data = &bin.model_data;
                    let models: MapImpl<_, _> = model_infos
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, info)| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            ModelRefPs3::from_data(src, info, model_data)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let effects: MapImpl<_, _> = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            GameObjsRefPs3::from_data(
                                &src[info.offset.get()
                                    as usize..info.offset.get() as usize
                                    + info.size.get() as usize],
                                info.gamemodemask.get(),
                            )?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let gfxs: MapImpl<_, _> = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| (
                            info.key.get(),
                            (&src[info.offset.get()
                                as usize..(info.offset.get() + info.size.get()) as usize])
                                .into(),
                        ))
                        .collect();
                    let mut foliages = IndexMap::<
                        u32,
                        Vec<FoliageRefPs3>,
                    >::with_capacity(foliage_infos.len());
                    for (i, info) in foliage_infos.iter().enumerate() {
                        let foliage = FoliageRefPs3::from_data(src, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        foliages
                            .entry(foliage.info.key.get())
                            .or_default()
                            .push(foliage);
                    }
                    let foliages: MapImpl<_, _> = foliages
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into_boxed_slice().into()))
                        .collect();
                    let radiosity_name = hash_string(b"_radiosity", Some(name));
                    let ind = model_data.get_index_of(&radiosity_name);
                    let data = ind
                        .and_then(|x| model_data.get_index(x))
                        .map(|(_, x)| x)
                        .copied();
                    let usage = ind
                        .map(|x| bin.model_handles()[x].kind.get())
                        .unwrap_or_default();
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRefPs3::from_data(
                            src,
                            radiosity_vals_infos,
                            data,
                            usage,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        model_infos: model_infos.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        shape_infos: shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_shape_infos: hk_shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_infos: hk_constraint_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        foliage_infos: foliage_infos.into(),
                        radiosity_vals_infos: radiosity_vals_infos.into(),
                        textures: textures.into(),
                        models: models.into(),
                        effects: effects.into(),
                        gfxs: gfxs.into(),
                        foliages: foliages.into(),
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            pub struct ObjsRawPc {
                _ptr: BufType,
                objas: NonNull<[ObjAPc]>,
                obj0s: NonNull<[Obj0Pc]>,
                model_infos: NonNull<[ModelInfoPc]>,
                buffer_infos: NonNull<[BufferInfoPc]>,
                mat1s: NonNull<[Mat1Pc]>,
                mat2s: NonNull<[Mat2Pc]>,

                gfxs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<[u8]>>,

            }

            pub struct ObjsRawPs3 {
                _ptr: BufType,
                objas: NonNull<[ObjAPs3]>,
                obj0s: NonNull<[Obj0Ps3]>,
                model_infos: NonNull<[ModelInfoPs3]>,
                buffer_infos: NonNull<[BufferInfoPs3]>,
                mat1s: NonNull<[Mat1Ps3]>,
                mat2s: NonNull<[Mat2Ps3]>,
                mat3s: NonNull<[Mat3Ps3]>,
                mat4s: NonNull<[Mat4Ps3]>,
                mat_extras: NonNull<[MatExtraPs3]>,
                shape_infos: NonNull<[ShapeInfoPs3]>,
                hk_shape_infos: NonNull<[HkShapeInfoPs3]>,
                hk_constraint_datas: NonNull<[HkConstraintDataPs3]>,
                vbuff_infos: NonNull<[VBuffInfoPs3]>,
                ibuff_infos: NonNull<[IBuffInfoPs3]>,

                radiosity_vals_infos: NonNull<[RadiosityValsInfoPs3]>,

                models: IndexMap<u32, ModelRawPs3>,
                effects: IndexMap<u32, GameObjsPs3>,
                foliages: IndexMap<u32, Box<[FoliagePs3]>>,
                gfxs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<[u8]>>,
                radiosity: RadiosityRawPs3,
