            impl ObjsRawPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    bin: &BinPc,
                    sub_blocks: &SubBlocksPc,
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_infos = ModelInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_infos = ShapeInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_shape_infos = HkShapeInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_infos = HkConstraintInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.get()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.foliage_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_vals_infos = RadiosityValsInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = bin.texture_data();
                    let texture_off = pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    let textures = (0..pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            TextureRawPc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    texture_data,
                                    texture_off + i * TextureInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().key.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let model_data = bin.model_data();
                    let model_off = pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    let models = (0..pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            ModelRawPc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    model_data,
                                    model_off + i * ModelInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().key.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let effects = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            GameObjsPc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.offset.get() as usize,
                                info.size.get() as usize,
                                info.gamemodemask.get(),
                            )?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let gfxs = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| (
                            info.key.get(),
                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                &src[info.offset.get()
                                    as usize..(info.offset.get() + info.size.get()) as usize],
                            ),
                        ))
                        .collect();
                    let mut foliages = IndexMap::<u32, Vec<FoliagePc>>::new();
                    let foliage_off = pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    for i in 0..foliage_infos.len() {
                        let foliage = FoliagePc::from_bytes(src, foliage_off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        foliages
                            .entry(foliage.info().key.get())
                            .or_default()
                            .push(foliage);
                    }
                    let foliages = foliages
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into()))
                        .collect();
                    let level = sub_blocks
                        .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing level sub_block"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                        .level()
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("incorrect level type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?;
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRawPc::from_bytes(
                            src,
                            bin,
                            level,
                            pak_header,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        model_infos: model_infos.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        shape_infos: shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_shape_infos: hk_shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_infos: hk_constraint_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        foliage_infos: foliage_infos.into(),
                        radiosity_vals_infos: radiosity_vals_infos.into(),
                        textures,
                        models,
                        effects,
                        gfxs,
                        foliages,
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            impl ObjsRawXbox {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    bin: &BinXbox,
                    sub_blocks: &SubBlocksXbox,
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderXbox,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_infos = ModelInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_infos = ShapeInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_shape_infos = HkShapeInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_infos = HkConstraintInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.get()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.foliage_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_vals_infos = RadiosityValsInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = bin.texture_data();
                    let texture_off = pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    let textures = (0..pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            TextureRawXbox::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    texture_data,
                                    texture_off + i * TextureInfoXbox::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().key.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let model_data = bin.model_data();
                    let model_off = pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    let models = (0..pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            ModelRawXbox::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    model_data,
                                    model_off + i * ModelInfoXbox::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().key.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let effects = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            GameObjsXbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.offset.get() as usize,
                                info.size.get() as usize,
                                info.gamemodemask.get(),
                            )?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let gfxs = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| (
                            info.key.get(),
                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                &src[info.offset.get()
                                    as usize..(info.offset.get() + info.size.get()) as usize],
                            ),
                        ))
                        .collect();
                    let mut foliages = IndexMap::<u32, Vec<FoliageXbox>>::new();
                    let foliage_off = pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    for i in 0..foliage_infos.len() {
                        let foliage = FoliageXbox::from_bytes(src, foliage_off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        foliages
                            .entry(foliage.info().key.get())
                            .or_default()
                            .push(foliage);
                    }
                    let foliages = foliages
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into()))
                        .collect();
                    let level = sub_blocks
                        .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing level sub_block"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                        .level()
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("incorrect level type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?;
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRawXbox::from_bytes(
                            src,
                            bin,
                            level,
                            pak_header,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        model_infos: model_infos.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        shape_infos: shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_shape_infos: hk_shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_infos: hk_constraint_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        foliage_infos: foliage_infos.into(),
                        radiosity_vals_infos: radiosity_vals_infos.into(),
                        textures,
                        models,
                        effects,
                        gfxs,
                        foliages,
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            impl ObjsRawPs3 {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &BufType,
                    bin: &BinPs3,
                    sub_blocks: &SubBlocksPs3,
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderPs3,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_infos = ModelInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_infos = ShapeInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_shape_infos = HkShapeInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let hk_constraint_infos = HkConstraintInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.get()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.foliage_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_vals_infos = RadiosityValsInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = bin.texture_data();
                    let texture_off = pak_header.texture_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    let textures = (0..pak_header.texture_info_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            TextureRawPs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    texture_data,
                                    texture_off + i * TextureInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().key.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let model_data = bin.model_data();
                    let model_off = pak_header.model_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    let models = (0..pak_header.model_info_num.get() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            ModelRawPs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    model_data,
                                    model_off + i * ModelInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().key.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let effects = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| Ok((
                            info.key.get(),
                            GameObjsPs3::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.offset.get() as usize,
                                info.size.get() as usize,
                                info.gamemodemask.get(),
                            )?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let gfxs = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| (
                            info.key.get(),
                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                &src[info.offset.get()
                                    as usize..(info.offset.get() + info.size.get()) as usize],
                            ),
                        ))
                        .collect();
                    let mut foliages = IndexMap::<u32, Vec<FoliagePs3>>::new();
                    let foliage_off = pak_header.foliage_info_offset.get() as usize;
                    for i in 0..foliage_infos.len() {
                        let foliage = FoliagePs3::from_bytes(src, foliage_off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                        foliages
                            .entry(foliage.info().key.get())
                            .or_default()
                            .push(foliage);
                    }
                    let foliages = foliages
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into()))
                        .collect();
                    let level = sub_blocks
                        .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing level sub_block"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                        .level()
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("incorrect level type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?;
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRawPs3::from_bytes(
                            src,
                            bin,
                            level,
                            pak_header,
                        )
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        model_infos: model_infos.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        shape_infos: shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_shape_infos: hk_shape_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        hk_constraint_infos: hk_constraint_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        foliage_infos: foliage_infos.into(),
                        radiosity_vals_infos: radiosity_vals_infos.into(),
                        textures,
                        models,
                        effects,
                        gfxs,
                        foliages,
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            pub struct ObjsPc {
                _ptr: BufType,
                objas: NonNull<[ObjAPc]>,
                obj0s: NonNull<[Obj0Pc]>,
                model_infos: NonNull<[ModelInfoPc]>,
                buffer_infos: NonNull<[BufferInfoPc]>,
                mat1s: NonNull<[Mat1Pc]>,
                mat2s: NonNull<[Mat2Pc]>,
                mat3s: NonNull<[Mat3Pc]>,
                mat4s: NonNull<[Mat4Pc]>,
                mat_extras: NonNull<[MatExtraPc]>,
                shape_infos: NonNull<[ShapeInfoPc]>,
                hk_shape_infos: NonNull<[HkShapeInfoPc]>,
                hk_constraint_datas: NonNull<[HkConstraintDataPc]>,
                vbuff_infos: NonNull<[VBuffInfoPc]>,
                ibuff_infos: NonNull<[IBuffInfoPc]>,
                texture_infos: NonNull<[TextureInfoPc]>,
                animation_infos: NonNull<[AnimationInfoPc]>,
                hk_constraint_infos: NonNull<[HkConstraintInfoPc]>,
                effect_infos: NonNull<[EffectInfoPc]>,
                pfield_infos: NonNull<[PFieldInfoPc]>,
                gfx_block_infos: NonNull<[GFXBlockInfoPc]>,
                animation_block_infos: NonNull<[AnimationBlockInfoPc]>,
                foliage_infos: NonNull<[FoliageInfoPc]>,
                radiosity_vals_infos: NonNull<[RadiosityValsInfoPc]>,
                textures: IndexMap<u32, TexturePc>,
                models: IndexMap<u32, ModelPc>,
                shapes: Box<[ShapePc]>,
                hk_shapes: Box<[HkShapePc]>,
                hk_constraints: Box<[HkConstraintPc]>,
                effects: IndexMap<u32, GameObjsPc>,
                gfxs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<[u8]>>,
                radiosity_vals: IndexMap<u32, RadiosityValsPc>,
                foliages: IndexMap<u32, Box<[FoliagePc]>>,
                radiosity: RadiosityPc,
            }

            impl TryFrom<ObjsRawPc> for ObjsPc {
                type Error = anyhow::Error;
                fn try_from(
                    ObjsRawPc {
                        _ptr,
                        objas,
                        obj0s,
                        model_infos,
                        buffer_infos,
                        mat1s,
                        mat2s,
                        mat3s,
                        mat4s,
                        mat_extras,
                        shape_infos,
                        hk_shape_infos,
                        hk_constraint_datas,
                        vbuff_infos,
                        ibuff_infos,
                        texture_infos,
                        animation_infos,
                        hk_constraint_infos,
                        effect_infos,
                        pfield_infos,
                        gfx_block_infos,
                        animation_block_infos,
                        foliage_infos,
                        radiosity_vals_infos,
                        textures,
                        models,
                        effects,
                        gfxs,
                        foliages,
                        radiosity,
                    }: ObjsRawPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let shape_off = shape_infos.addr().get() - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let shapes = (0..shape_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            ShapePc::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    shape_off + i * ShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_shape_off = hk_shape_infos.addr().get()
                        - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let hk_shapes = (0..hk_shape_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkShapePc::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    hk_shape_off + i * HkShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_constraint_off = hk_constraint_infos.addr().get()
                        - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let hk_constraints = (0..hk_constraint_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkConstraintPc::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    hk_constraint_off + i * HkConstraintInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_constraint {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let radiosity_val_off = radiosity_vals_infos.addr().get()
                        - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let radiosity_vals = (0..radiosity_vals_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            RadiosityValsPc::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    radiosity_val_off + i * RadiosityValsInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().guid.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("radiosity_vals {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let textures = textures
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| Ok((k, v.try_into()?)))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()
                        .context("textures")?;
                    let models = models
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| Ok((k, v.try_into()?)))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()
                        .context("models")?;
                    let radiosity = radiosity.try_into().context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr,
                        objas,
                        obj0s,
                        model_infos,
                        buffer_infos,
                        mat1s,
                        mat2s,
                        mat3s,
                        mat4s,
                        mat_extras,
                        shape_infos,
                        hk_shape_infos,
                        hk_constraint_datas,
                        vbuff_infos,
                        ibuff_infos,
                        texture_infos,
                        animation_infos,
                        hk_constraint_infos,
                        effect_infos,
                        pfield_infos,
                        gfx_block_infos,
                        animation_block_infos,
                        foliage_infos,
                        radiosity_vals_infos,
                        textures,
                        models,
                        shapes: shapes.into(),
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                        hk_constraints: hk_constraints.into(),
                        effects,
                        gfxs,
                        radiosity_vals,
                        foliages,
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }

                        mat3s,
                        mat4s,
                        mat_extras,
                        shape_infos,
                        hk_shape_infos,
                        hk_constraint_datas,
                        vbuff_infos,
                        ibuff_infos,
                        texture_infos,
                        animation_infos,
                        hk_constraint_infos,
                        effect_infos,
                        pfield_infos,
                        gfx_block_infos,
                        animation_block_infos,
                        foliage_infos,
                        radiosity_vals_infos,
                        textures,
                        models,
                        effects,
                        gfxs,
                        foliages,
                        radiosity,
                    }: ObjsRawPs3,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let shape_off = shape_infos.addr().get() - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let shapes = (0..shape_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            ShapePs3::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    shape_off + i * ShapeInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_shape_off = hk_shape_infos.addr().get()
                        - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let hk_shapes = (0..hk_shape_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkShapePs3::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    hk_shape_off + i * HkShapeInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_constraint_off = hk_constraint_infos.addr().get()
                        - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let hk_constraints = (0..hk_constraint_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkConstraintPs3::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    hk_constraint_off + i * HkConstraintInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_constraint {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let radiosity_val_off = radiosity_vals_infos.addr().get()
                        - _ptr.as_ptr().addr();
                    let radiosity_vals = (0..radiosity_vals_infos.len())
                        .map(|i| {
                            RadiosityValsPs3::from_bytes(
                                    &_ptr,
                                    radiosity_val_off + i * RadiosityValsInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .map(|x| (x.info().guid.get(), x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("radiosity_vals {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let textures = textures
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| Ok((k, v.try_into()?)))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()
                        .context("textures")?;
                    let models = models
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| Ok((k, v.try_into()?)))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()
                        .context("models")?;
                    let radiosity = radiosity.try_into().context("radiosity")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr,
                        objas,
                        obj0s,
                        model_infos,
                        buffer_infos,
                        mat1s,
                        mat2s,
                        mat3s,
                        mat4s,
                        mat_extras,
                        shape_infos,
                        hk_shape_infos,
                        hk_constraint_datas,
                        vbuff_infos,
                        ibuff_infos,
                        texture_infos,
                        animation_infos,
                        hk_constraint_infos,
                        effect_infos,
                        pfield_infos,
                        gfx_block_infos,
                        animation_block_infos,
                        foliage_infos,
                        radiosity_vals_infos,
                        textures,
                        models,
                        shapes: shapes.into(),
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                        hk_constraints: hk_constraints.into(),
                        effects,
                        gfxs,
                        radiosity_vals,
                        foliages,
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }

            pub struct DumpInfo<'a, T: RefFromData> {
                pub vals: &'a mut [T],
                pub ind: usize,
                pub offset: usize,
            }
            impl<'a, T: RefFromData> Default for DumpInfo<'a, T> {
                fn default() -> Self {
                    Self {
                        vals: &mut [],
                        ind: 0,
                        offset: 0,
                    }
                }
            }
            impl<'a, T: RefFromData> DumpInfo<'a, T> {
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals.len()
                }
                pub fn as_ref(&mut self) -> &mut [T] {
                    self.vals
                }
                pub fn take(&mut self) -> &mut [T] {
                    let val = std::mem::take(self);
                    val.vals
                }
                pub fn ref_from(src: &mut DumpSlice<'a>, size: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let offset = src.offset;
                    let vals = T::mut_slice_from_data(src, size)?;
                    let ind = 0;
                    Ok(Self { vals, ind, offset })
                }
                pub fn next(&mut self) -> &'a mut T {
                    let Self { vals, mut ind, mut offset } = std::mem::take(self);
                    let (val, vals) = vals.split_first_mut().unwrap();
                    ind += 1;
                    offset += val.size();
                    *self = Self { vals, ind, offset };
                    val
                }
                pub fn next_slice(&mut self, num: usize) -> &'a mut [T] {
                    let Self { vals, mut ind, mut offset } = std::mem::take(self);
                    let (val, vals) = vals.split_at_mut(num);
                    ind += 1;
                    offset += val.size();
                    *self = Self { vals, ind, offset };
                    val
                }
            }
            pub struct DumpInfosPc<'a, D> {
                pub models: DumpInfo<'a, ModelInfoPc>,
                pub buffers: DumpInfo<'a, BufferInfoPc>,
                pub mat1s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat1Pc>,
                pub mat2s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat2Pc>,
                pub mat3s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat3Pc>,
                pub mat4s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat4Pc>,
                pub mat_extras: DumpInfo<'a, MatExtraPc>,
                pub shapes: DumpInfo<'a, ShapeInfoPc>,
                pub hk_shapes: DumpInfo<'a, HkShapeInfoPc>,
                pub hk_constraint_datas: DumpInfo<'a, HkConstraintDataPc>,
                pub vbuffs: DumpInfo<'a, VBuffInfoPc>,
                pub ibuffs: DumpInfo<'a, IBuffInfoPc>,
                pub textures: DumpInfo<'a, TextureInfoPc>,
                pub animations: DumpInfo<'a, AnimationInfoPc>,
                pub hk_constraints: DumpInfo<'a, HkConstraintInfoPc>,
                pub animation_blocks: DumpInfo<'a, AnimationBlockInfoPc>,
                pub radiosity_vals: DumpInfo<'a, RadiosityValsInfoPc>,
                pub offsets: DumpInfo<'a, u32Pc>,
                pub model_data: Vec<(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<D>)>,
                pub texture_data: Vec<(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<D>)>,
            }
            pub struct DumpInfosXbox<'a, D> {
                pub models: DumpInfo<'a, ModelInfoXbox>,
                pub buffers: DumpInfo<'a, BufferInfoXbox>,
                pub mat1s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat1Xbox>,
                pub mat2s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat2Xbox>,
                pub mat3s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat3Xbox>,
                pub mat4s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat4Xbox>,
                pub mat_extras: DumpInfo<'a, MatExtraXbox>,
                pub shapes: DumpInfo<'a, ShapeInfoXbox>,
                pub hk_shapes: DumpInfo<'a, HkShapeInfoXbox>,
                pub hk_constraint_datas: DumpInfo<'a, HkConstraintDataXbox>,
                pub vbuffs: DumpInfo<'a, VBuffInfoXbox>,
                pub ibuffs: DumpInfo<'a, IBuffInfoXbox>,
                pub textures: DumpInfo<'a, TextureInfoXbox>,
                pub animations: DumpInfo<'a, AnimationInfoXbox>,
                pub hk_constraints: DumpInfo<'a, HkConstraintInfoXbox>,
                pub animation_blocks: DumpInfo<'a, AnimationBlockInfoXbox>,
                pub radiosity_vals: DumpInfo<'a, RadiosityValsInfoXbox>,
                pub offsets: DumpInfo<'a, u32Xbox>,
                pub model_data: Vec<(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<D>)>,
                pub texture_data: Vec<(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<D>)>,
            }
            pub struct DumpInfosPs3<'a, D> {
                pub models: DumpInfo<'a, ModelInfoPs3>,
                pub buffers: DumpInfo<'a, BufferInfoPs3>,
                pub mat1s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat1Ps3>,
                pub mat2s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat2Ps3>,
                pub mat3s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat3Ps3>,
                pub mat4s: DumpInfo<'a, Mat4Ps3>,
                pub mat_extras: DumpInfo<'a, MatExtraPs3>,
                pub shapes: DumpInfo<'a, ShapeInfoPs3>,
                pub hk_shapes: DumpInfo<'a, HkShapeInfoPs3>,
                pub hk_constraint_datas: DumpInfo<'a, HkConstraintDataPs3>,
                pub vbuffs: DumpInfo<'a, VBuffInfoPs3>,
                pub ibuffs: DumpInfo<'a, IBuffInfoPs3>,
                pub textures: DumpInfo<'a, TextureInfoPs3>,
                pub animations: DumpInfo<'a, AnimationInfoPs3>,
                pub hk_constraints: DumpInfo<'a, HkConstraintInfoPs3>,
                pub animation_blocks: DumpInfo<'a, AnimationBlockInfoPs3>,
                pub radiosity_vals: DumpInfo<'a, RadiosityValsInfoPs3>,
                pub offsets: DumpInfo<'a, u32Ps3>,

                pub texture_data: Vec<(u32Ps3, u32Ps3, Option<D>)>,
            }
            struct Key<T>(u32, T);
            impl<T> Ord for Key<T> {
                fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
                    self.0.cmp(&other.0)
                }
            }
            impl<T> PartialOrd for Key<T> {
                fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<std::cmp::Ordering> {
                    Some(self.0.cmp(&other.0))
                }
            }
            impl<T> PartialEq for Key<T> {
                fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
                    self.0 == other.0
                }
            }
            impl<T> Eq for Key<T> {}
            pub trait DumpObjsPc {
                type Data;
                fn obja_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj0_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn effect_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn foliage_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn pfield_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn gfx_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn write_objas(&self, objas: &mut [ObjAPc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj0s(&self, obj0s: &mut [Obj0Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn effects<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpGameObjsPc + 'a))>;
                fn models<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpModelPc<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)),
                >;
                fn foliages<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpFoliagePc + 'a)>;
                fn gfxs<'a>(&'a self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a [u8])>;
                fn radiosity(&self) -> &impl DumpRadiosityPc<Data = Self::Data>;
                fn textures<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpTexturePc<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)),
                >;
                fn group_models<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> (
                    impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpModelPc<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)>,
                    impl ExactSizeIterator<
                        Item = &'a (impl DumpModelPc<Data = Self::Data> + 'a),
                    >,
                    Option<&'a (impl DumpModelPc<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)>,
                ) {
                    let mut normal = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut collision_road = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut terrain = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut occluder = None;
                    for (key, model) in self.models() {
                        if key == hash_string(b"occluder", None) {
                            occluder.replace(model);
                        } else if let Some(name) = get_str(&key) {
                            if name.starts_with("Terrain") {
                                terrain
                                    .push(
                                        std::cmp::Reverse(
                                            Key(
                                                name
                                                    .split("_")
                                                    .last()
                                                    .and_then(|x| x.parse::<u32>().ok())
                                                    .unwrap_or_default(),
                                                model,
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                            } else if name.contains("_Road_")
                                || name.contains("_Collision_")
                            {
                                collision_road
                                    .push(
                                        std::cmp::Reverse(
                                            Key(
                                                name
                                                    .split("_")
                                                    .last()
                                                    .and_then(|x| x.parse::<u32>().ok())
                                                    .unwrap_or_default(),
                                                model,
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                            } else {
                                normal.push(std::cmp::Reverse(Key(key, model)));
                            }
                        } else {
                            normal.push(std::cmp::Reverse(Key(key, model)));
                        }
                    }
                    (
                        normal.into_iter().chain(collision_road).map(|x| x.0.1),
                        terrain.into_iter().map(|x| x.0.1),
                        occluder,
                    )
                }
                fn dump_into<'a>(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    offsets: &'a mut [u32Pc],
                    counts: &InfoCounts,
                    pak_header: &mut PakHeaderPc,
                    type_infos: &[TypeInfos],
                ) -> Result<DumpInfosPc<'a, Self::Data>> {
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.obja_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let objas = ObjAPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obja_num())
                        .context("objas")?;
                    pak_header.obja_num = objas.len().conv();
                    self.write_objas(objas).context("write objas")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.obj0_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj0s = Obj0Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj0_num())
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    pak_header.obj0_num = obj0s.len().conv();
                    self.write_obj0s(obj0s).context("write obj0s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.model_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.model_info_num = counts.models.conv();
                    let models = DumpInfo::<ModelInfoPc>::ref_from(dst, counts.models)
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.buffer_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.buffer_info_num = counts.buffers.conv();
                    let buffers = DumpInfo::<BufferInfoPc>::ref_from(dst, counts.buffers)
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat1_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat1_num = counts.mat1s.conv();
                    let mat1s = DumpInfo::<Mat1Pc>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat1s)
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat2_num = counts.mat2s.conv();
                    let mat2s = DumpInfo::<Mat2Pc>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat2s)
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat3_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat3_num = counts.mat3s.conv();
                    let mat3s = DumpInfo::<Mat3Pc>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat3s)
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat4_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat4_num = counts.mat4s.conv();
                    let mat4s = DumpInfo::<Mat4Pc>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat4s)
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat_extra_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat_extra_num = counts.mat_extras.conv();
                    let mat_extras = DumpInfo::<
                        MatExtraPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.mat_extras)
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.shape_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.shape_info_num = counts.shapes.conv();
                    let shapes = DumpInfo::<ShapeInfoPc>::ref_from(dst, counts.shapes)
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_shape_info_num = counts.hk_shapes.conv();
                    let hk_shapes = DumpInfo::<
                        HkShapeInfoPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_shapes)
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num = counts
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .conv();
                    let hk_constraint_datas = DumpInfo::<
                        HkConstraintDataPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_constraint_datas)
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.vbuff_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.vbuff_info_num = counts.vbuffs.conv();
                    let vbuffs = DumpInfo::<VBuffInfoPc>::ref_from(dst, counts.vbuffs)
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.ibuff_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.ibuff_info_num = counts.ibuffs.conv();
                    let ibuffs = DumpInfo::<IBuffInfoPc>::ref_from(dst, counts.ibuffs)
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.texture_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.texture_info_num = counts.textures.conv();
                    let textures = DumpInfo::<
                        TextureInfoPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.textures)
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.animation_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.animation_info_num = counts.animations.conv();
                    let animations = DumpInfo::<
                        AnimationInfoPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.animations)
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num = counts.hk_constraints.conv();
                    let hk_constraints = DumpInfo::<
                        HkConstraintInfoPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_constraints)
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut effect_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.effect_info_offset = effect_info_offset.conv();
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.effect_num(),
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    pak_header.effect_info_num = effect_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut foliage_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.foliage_info_offset = foliage_info_offset.conv();
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.foliage_num(),
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    pak_header.foliage_info_num = foliage_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.pfield_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.pfield_num(),
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    pak_header.pfield_info_num = pfield_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut gfx_block_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset = gfx_block_info_offset.conv();
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.gfx_num(),
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    pak_header.gfx_block_info_num = gfx_block_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let radiosity = self.radiosity();
                    pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num = counts.radiosity_vals.conv();
                    let radiosity_vals = DumpInfo::<
                        RadiosityValsInfoPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.radiosity_vals)
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.animation_block_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.animation_block_info_num = counts.animation_blocks.conv();
                    let animation_blocks = DumpInfo::<
                        AnimationBlockInfoPc,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.animation_blocks)
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = Vec::with_capacity(textures.len() * 2);
                    let model_data = Vec::with_capacity(models.len() + 1);
                    let mut dump_infos = DumpInfosPc {
                        models,
                        buffers,
                        mat1s,
                        mat2s,
                        mat3s,
                        mat4s,
                        mat_extras,
                        shapes,
                        hk_shapes,
                        hk_constraint_datas,
                        vbuffs,
                        ibuffs,
                        textures,
                        animations,
                        hk_constraints,
                        animation_blocks,
                        radiosity_vals,
                        texture_data,
                        model_data,
                        offsets: DumpInfo {
                            vals: offsets,
                            ind: 0,
                            offset: 0,
                        },
                    };
                    dst.align(16);
                    for (((key, effect), info), type_infos) in self
                        .effects()
                        .sorted_by_key(|x| x.0)
                        .zip(effect_infos)
                        .zip(type_infos)
                    {
                        info.key = key.conv();
                        info.gamemodemask = effect.gamemodemask().conv();
                        let off = dst.offset;
                        effect
                            .dump_into(dst, type_infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("effect {0}", key))
                            }))?;
                        info.size = (dst.offset - off).conv();
                        info.offset = off.conv();
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (effect_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(EffectInfoPc, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        effect_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<EffectInfoPc>();
                    }
                    let (normal, terrain, occluder) = self.group_models();
                    let mut model_count = 0;
                    for model in normal {
                        model
                            .dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("model({0}) {1}", model_count, model.key()),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        model_count += 1;
                    }
                    let terrain_offset = dst.offset;
                    if terrain.len() != 0 {
                        *<[u8; 16]>::mut_from_data(dst).context("terrain indices")? = [0xFFu8; 16];
                    }
                    for model in terrain {
                        model
                            .dump_terrain_into(dst, &mut dump_infos, terrain_offset)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "terrain model({0}) {1}",
                                        model_count,
                                        model.key(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        model_count += 1;
                    }
                    dst.align(16);
                    for (foliage, info) in self.foliages().zip(foliage_infos) {
                        foliage
                            .dump_into(dst, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", info.key))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (foliage_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(FoliageInfoPc, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        foliage_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<FoliageInfoPc>();
                    }
                    if let Some(model) = occluder {
                        model.dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos).context("model occluder")?;
                        dst.align(16);
                    }
                    for ((key, gfx), info) in self.gfxs().zip(gfx_block_infos) {
                        info.key = key.conv();
                        info.offset = dst.offset.conv();
                        gfx.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("gfx {0}", key))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (gfx_block_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(GFXBlockInfoPc, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        gfx_block_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<GFXBlockInfoPc>();
                    }
                    radiosity.dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos).context("radiosity")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    Ok(dump_infos)
                }
                fn add_size(
