                    &self,
                    mut offset: usize,
                    counts: &mut InfoCounts,
                ) -> (usize, Vec<TypeInfos>) {
                    let mut objs_size = 0;
                    let mut type_infos = self
                        .effects()
                        .sorted_by_key(|x| x.0)
                        .map(|(_, effect)| {
                            let (size, type_infos) = effect.size();
                            objs_size += size;
                            type_infos
                        })
                        .collect();
                    let (normal, terrain, occluder) = self.group_models();
                    for model in normal {
                        objs_size = align_offset(model.add_size(objs_size, counts), 16);
                    }
                    if terrain.len() != 0 {
                        objs_size += 16;
                    }
                    for model in terrain {
                        objs_size = model.add_terrain_size(objs_size, counts);
                    }
                    objs_size = align_offset(objs_size, 16);
                    for foliage in self.foliages() {
                        objs_size += align_offset(foliage.add_size(objs_size), 16);
                    }
                    if let Some(model) = occluder {
                        objs_size = align_offset(model.add_size(objs_size, counts), 16);
                    }
                    for (_, gfx) in self.gfxs() {
                        objs_size = align_offset(objs_size + gfx.len(), 16);
                    }
                    objs_size = align_offset(
                        self.radiosity().add_size(objs_size, counts),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16);
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obja_num() * std::mem::size_of::<ObjAPc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obja_num() * std::mem::size_of::<ObjAPc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obj0_num() * std::mem::size_of::<Obj0Pc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.models
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<ModelInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.buffers
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<BufferInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat1s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat1Pc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat2s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat2Pc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat3s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat3Pc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat4s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat4Pc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.mat_extras
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<MatExtraPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.shapes
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<ShapeInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_shapes
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkShapeInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_constraint_datas
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkConstraintDataPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.vbuffs
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<VBuffInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.ibuffs
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<IBuffInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.textures
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<TextureInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.animations
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<AnimationInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_constraints
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkConstraintInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.effect_num() * std::mem::size_of::<EffectInfoPc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.foliage_num() * std::mem::size_of::<FoliageInfoPc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.pfield_num() * std::mem::size_of::<PFieldInfoPc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.gfx_num() * std::mem::size_of::<GFXBlockInfoPc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.radiosity_vals
                                * std::mem::size_of::<RadiosityValsInfoPc>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.animation_blocks
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<AnimationBlockInfoPc>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    counts.offsets
                        += self.effect_num() + self.gfx_num() + self.foliage_num();
                    (offset + objs_size, type_infos)
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpObjsXbox {
                type Data;
                fn obja_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj0_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn effect_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn foliage_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn pfield_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn gfx_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn write_objas(&self, objas: &mut [ObjAXbox]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj0s(&self, obj0s: &mut [Obj0Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
                fn effects<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpGameObjsXbox + 'a))>;
                fn models<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpModelXbox<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)),
                >;
                fn foliages<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpFoliageXbox + 'a)>;
                fn gfxs<'a>(&'a self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a [u8])>;
                fn radiosity(&self) -> &impl DumpRadiosityXbox<Data = Self::Data>;
                fn textures<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpTextureXbox<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)),
                >;
                fn group_models<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> (
                    impl Iterator<
                        Item = &'a (impl DumpModelXbox<Data = Self::Data> + 'a),
                    >,
                    impl ExactSizeIterator<
                        Item = &'a (impl DumpModelXbox<Data = Self::Data> + 'a),
                    >,
                    Option<&'a (impl DumpModelXbox<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)>,
                ) {
                    let mut normal = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut collision_road = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut terrain = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut occluder = None;
                    for (key, model) in self.models() {
                        if key == hash_string(b"occluder", None) {
                            occluder.replace(model);
                        } else if let Some(name) = get_str(&key) {
                            if name.starts_with("Terrain") {
                                terrain
                                    .push(
                                        std::cmp::Reverse(
                                            Key(
                                                name
                                                    .split("_")
                                                    .last()
                                                    .and_then(|x| x.parse::<u32>().ok())
                                                    .unwrap_or_default(),
                                                model,
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                            } else if name.contains("_Road_")
                                || name.contains("_Collision_")
                            {
                                collision_road
                                    .push(
                                        std::cmp::Reverse(
                                            Key(
                                                name
                                                    .split("_")
                                                    .last()
                                                    .and_then(|x| x.parse::<u32>().ok())
                                                    .unwrap_or_default(),
                                                model,
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                            } else {
                                normal.push(std::cmp::Reverse(Key(key, model)));
                            }
                        } else {
                            normal.push(std::cmp::Reverse(Key(key, model)));
                        }
                    }
                    (
                        normal.into_iter().chain(collision_road).map(|x| x.0.1),
                        terrain.into_iter().map(|x| x.0.1),
                        occluder,
                    )
                }
                fn dump_into<'a>(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    offsets: &'a mut [u32Xbox],
                    counts: &InfoCounts,
                    pak_header: &mut PakHeaderXbox,
                    type_infos: &[TypeInfos],
                ) -> Result<DumpInfosXbox<'a, Self::Data>> {
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.obja_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let objas = ObjAXbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obja_num())
                        .context("objas")?;
                    pak_header.obja_num = objas.len().conv();
                    self.write_objas(objas).context("write objas")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.obj0_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj0s = Obj0Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj0_num())
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    pak_header.obj0_num = obj0s.len().conv();
                    self.write_obj0s(obj0s).context("write obj0s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.model_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.model_info_num = counts.models.conv();
                    let models = DumpInfo::<ModelInfoXbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.models)
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.buffer_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.buffer_info_num = counts.buffers.conv();
                    let buffers = DumpInfo::<
                        BufferInfoXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.buffers)
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat1_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat1_num = counts.mat1s.conv();
                    let mat1s = DumpInfo::<Mat1Xbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat1s)
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat2_num = counts.mat2s.conv();
                    let mat2s = DumpInfo::<Mat2Xbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat2s)
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat3_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat3_num = counts.mat3s.conv();
                    let mat3s = DumpInfo::<Mat3Xbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat3s)
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat4_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat4_num = counts.mat4s.conv();
                    let mat4s = DumpInfo::<Mat4Xbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat4s)
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat_extra_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat_extra_num = counts.mat_extras.conv();
                    let mat_extras = DumpInfo::<
                        MatExtraXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.mat_extras)
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.shape_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.shape_info_num = counts.shapes.conv();
                    let shapes = DumpInfo::<ShapeInfoXbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.shapes)
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_shape_info_num = counts.hk_shapes.conv();
                    let hk_shapes = DumpInfo::<
                        HkShapeInfoXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_shapes)
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num = counts
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .conv();
                    let hk_constraint_datas = DumpInfo::<
                        HkConstraintDataXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_constraint_datas)
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.vbuff_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.vbuff_info_num = counts.vbuffs.conv();
                    let vbuffs = DumpInfo::<VBuffInfoXbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.vbuffs)
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.ibuff_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.ibuff_info_num = counts.ibuffs.conv();
                    let ibuffs = DumpInfo::<IBuffInfoXbox>::ref_from(dst, counts.ibuffs)
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.texture_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.texture_info_num = counts.textures.conv();
                    let textures = DumpInfo::<
                        TextureInfoXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.textures)
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.animation_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.animation_info_num = counts.animations.conv();
                    let animations = DumpInfo::<
                        AnimationInfoXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.animations)
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num = counts.hk_constraints.conv();
                    let hk_constraints = DumpInfo::<
                        HkConstraintInfoXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_constraints)
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut effect_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.effect_info_offset = effect_info_offset.conv();
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.effect_num(),
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    pak_header.effect_info_num = effect_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut foliage_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.foliage_info_offset = foliage_info_offset.conv();
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.foliage_num(),
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    pak_header.foliage_info_num = foliage_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.pfield_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.pfield_num(),
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    pak_header.pfield_info_num = pfield_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut gfx_block_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset = gfx_block_info_offset.conv();
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.gfx_num(),
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    pak_header.gfx_block_info_num = gfx_block_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let radiosity = self.radiosity();
                    pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num = counts.radiosity_vals.conv();
                    let radiosity_vals = DumpInfo::<
                        RadiosityValsInfoXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.radiosity_vals)
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.animation_block_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.animation_block_info_num = counts.animation_blocks.conv();
                    let animation_blocks = DumpInfo::<
                        AnimationBlockInfoXbox,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.animation_blocks)
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = Vec::with_capacity(textures.len() * 2);
                    let model_data = Vec::with_capacity(models.len() + 1);
                    let mut dump_infos = DumpInfosXbox {
                        models,
                        buffers,
                        mat1s,
                        mat2s,
                        mat3s,
                        mat4s,
                        mat_extras,
                        shapes,
                        hk_shapes,
                        hk_constraint_datas,
                        vbuffs,
                        ibuffs,
                        textures,
                        animations,
                        hk_constraints,
                        animation_blocks,
                        radiosity_vals,
                        texture_data,
                        model_data,
                        offsets: DumpInfo {
                            vals: offsets,
                            ind: 0,
                            offset: 0,
                        },
                    };
                    dst.align(16);
                    for (((key, effect), info), type_infos) in self
                        .effects()
                        .sorted_by_key(|x| x.0)
                        .zip(effect_infos)
                        .zip(type_infos)
                    {
                        info.key = key.conv();
                        info.gamemodemask = effect.gamemodemask().conv();
                        let off = dst.offset;
                        effect
                            .dump_into(dst, type_infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("effect {0}", key))
                            }))?;
                        info.size = (dst.offset - off).conv();
                        info.offset = off.conv();
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (effect_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(EffectInfoXbox, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        effect_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<EffectInfoXbox>();
                    }
                    let (normal, terrain, occluder) = self.group_models();
                    let mut model_count = 0;
                    for model in normal {
                        model
                            .dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("model({0}) {1}", model_count, model.key()),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        model_count += 1;
                    }
                    let terrain_offset = dst.offset;
                    if terrain.len() != 0 {
                        *<[u8; 16]>::mut_from_data(dst).context("terrain indices")? = [0xFFu8; 16];
                    }
                    for model in terrain {
                        model
                            .dump_terrain_into(dst, &mut dump_infos, terrain_offset)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "terrain model({0}) {1}",
                                        model_count,
                                        model.key(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        model_count += 1;
                    }
                    dst.align(16);
                    for (foliage, info) in self.foliages().zip(foliage_infos) {
                        foliage
                            .dump_into(dst, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", info.key))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (foliage_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(FoliageInfoXbox, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        foliage_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<FoliageInfoXbox>();
                    }
                    if let Some(model) = occluder {
                        model.dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos).context("model occluder")?;
                        dst.align(16);
                    }
                    for ((key, gfx), info) in self.gfxs().zip(gfx_block_infos) {
                        info.key = key.conv();
                        info.offset = dst.offset.conv();
                        gfx.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("gfx {0}", key))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (gfx_block_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(GFXBlockInfoXbox, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        gfx_block_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<GFXBlockInfoXbox>();
                    }
                    radiosity.dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos).context("radiosity")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    Ok(dump_infos)
                }
                fn add_size(
                    &self,
                    mut offset: usize,
                    counts: &mut InfoCounts,
                ) -> (usize, Vec<TypeInfos>) {
                    let mut objs_size = 0;
                    let mut type_infos = self
                        .effects()
                        .sorted_by_key(|x| x.0)
                        .map(|(_, effect)| {
                            let (size, type_infos) = effect.size();
                            objs_size += size;
                            type_infos
                        })
                        .collect();
                    let (normal, terrain, occluder) = self.group_models();
                    for model in normal {
                        objs_size = align_offset(model.add_size(objs_size, counts), 16);
                    }
                    if terrain.len() != 0 {
                        objs_size += 16;
                    }
                    for model in terrain {
                        objs_size = model.add_terrain_size(objs_size, counts);
                    }
                    objs_size = align_offset(objs_size, 16);
                    for foliage in self.foliages() {
                        objs_size += align_offset(foliage.add_size(objs_size), 16);
                    }
                    if let Some(model) = occluder {
                        objs_size = align_offset(model.add_size(objs_size, counts), 16);
                    }
                    for (_, gfx) in self.gfxs() {
                        objs_size = align_offset(objs_size + gfx.len(), 16);
                    }
                    objs_size = align_offset(
                        self.radiosity().add_size(objs_size, counts),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16);
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obja_num() * std::mem::size_of::<ObjAXbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obja_num() * std::mem::size_of::<ObjAXbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obj0_num() * std::mem::size_of::<Obj0Xbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.models
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<ModelInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.buffers
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<BufferInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.mat1s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat1Xbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.mat2s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat2Xbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.mat3s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat3Xbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.mat4s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat4Xbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.mat_extras
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<MatExtraXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.shapes
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<ShapeInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_shapes
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkShapeInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_constraint_datas
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkConstraintDataXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.vbuffs
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<VBuffInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.ibuffs
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<IBuffInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.textures
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<TextureInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.animations
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<AnimationInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_constraints
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkConstraintInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.effect_num() * std::mem::size_of::<EffectInfoXbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.foliage_num()
                                * std::mem::size_of::<FoliageInfoXbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.pfield_num() * std::mem::size_of::<PFieldInfoXbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.gfx_num() * std::mem::size_of::<GFXBlockInfoXbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.radiosity_vals
                                * std::mem::size_of::<RadiosityValsInfoXbox>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.animation_blocks
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<AnimationBlockInfoXbox>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    counts.offsets
                        += self.effect_num() + self.gfx_num() + self.foliage_num();
                    (offset + objs_size, type_infos)
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpObjsPs3 {
                type Data;
                fn obja_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn obj0_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn effect_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn foliage_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn pfield_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn gfx_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn write_objas(&self, objas: &mut [ObjAPs3]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_obj0s(&self, obj0s: &mut [Obj0Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
                fn effects<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpGameObjsPs3 + 'a))>;
                fn models<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpModelPs3<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)),
                >;
                fn foliages<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a (impl DumpFoliagePs3 + 'a)>;
                fn gfxs<'a>(&'a self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &'a [u8])>;
                fn radiosity(&self) -> &impl DumpRadiosityPs3<Data = Self::Data>;
                fn textures<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &'a (impl DumpTexturePs3<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)),
                >;
                fn group_models<'a>(
                    &'a self,
                ) -> (
                    impl Iterator<
                        Item = &'a (impl DumpModelPs3<Data = Self::Data> + 'a),
                    >,
                    impl ExactSizeIterator<
                        Item = &'a (impl DumpModelPs3<Data = Self::Data> + 'a),
                    >,
                    Option<&'a (impl DumpModelPs3<Data = Self::Data> + 'a)>,
                ) {
                    let mut normal = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut collision_road = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut terrain = BinaryHeap::new();
                    let mut occluder = None;
                    for (key, model) in self.models() {
                        if key == hash_string(b"occluder", None) {
                            occluder.replace(model);
                        } else if let Some(name) = get_str(&key) {
                            if name.starts_with("Terrain") {
                                terrain
                                    .push(
                                        std::cmp::Reverse(
                                            Key(
                                                name
                                                    .split("_")
                                                    .last()
                                                    .and_then(|x| x.parse::<u32>().ok())
                                                    .unwrap_or_default(),
                                                model,
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                            } else if name.contains("_Road_")
                                || name.contains("_Collision_")
                            {
                                collision_road
                                    .push(
                                        std::cmp::Reverse(
                                            Key(
                                                name
                                                    .split("_")
                                                    .last()
                                                    .and_then(|x| x.parse::<u32>().ok())
                                                    .unwrap_or_default(),
                                                model,
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                            } else {
                                normal.push(std::cmp::Reverse(Key(key, model)));
                            }
                        } else {
                            normal.push(std::cmp::Reverse(Key(key, model)));
                        }
                    }
                    (
                        normal.into_iter().chain(collision_road).map(|x| x.0.1),
                        terrain.into_iter().map(|x| x.0.1),
                        occluder,
                    )
                }
                fn dump_into<'a>(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    offsets: &'a mut [u32Ps3],
                    counts: &InfoCounts,
                    pak_header: &mut PakHeaderPs3,
                    type_infos: &[TypeInfos],
                ) -> Result<DumpInfosPs3<'a, Self::Data>> {
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.obja_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let objas = ObjAPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obja_num())
                        .context("objas")?;
                    pak_header.obja_num = objas.len().conv();
                    self.write_objas(objas).context("write objas")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.obj0_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let obj0s = Obj0Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.obj0_num())
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    pak_header.obj0_num = obj0s.len().conv();
                    self.write_obj0s(obj0s).context("write obj0s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.model_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.model_info_num = counts.models.conv();
                    let models = DumpInfo::<ModelInfoPs3>::ref_from(dst, counts.models)
                        .context("model_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.buffer_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.buffer_info_num = counts.buffers.conv();
                    let buffers = DumpInfo::<
                        BufferInfoPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.buffers)
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat1_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat1_num = counts.mat1s.conv();
                    let mat1s = DumpInfo::<Mat1Ps3>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat1s)
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat2_num = counts.mat2s.conv();
                    let mat2s = DumpInfo::<Mat2Ps3>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat2s)
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat3_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat3_num = counts.mat3s.conv();
                    let mat3s = DumpInfo::<Mat3Ps3>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat3s)
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat4_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat4_num = counts.mat4s.conv();
                    let mat4s = DumpInfo::<Mat4Ps3>::ref_from(dst, counts.mat4s)
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.mat_extra_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.mat_extra_num = counts.mat_extras.conv();
                    let mat_extras = DumpInfo::<
                        MatExtraPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.mat_extras)
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.shape_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.shape_info_num = counts.shapes.conv();
                    let shapes = DumpInfo::<ShapeInfoPs3>::ref_from(dst, counts.shapes)
                        .context("shape_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_shape_info_num = counts.hk_shapes.conv();
                    let hk_shapes = DumpInfo::<
                        HkShapeInfoPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_shapes)
                        .context("hk_shape_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num = counts
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .conv();
                    let hk_constraint_datas = DumpInfo::<
                        HkConstraintDataPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_constraint_datas)
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.vbuff_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.vbuff_info_num = counts.vbuffs.conv();
                    let vbuffs = DumpInfo::<VBuffInfoPs3>::ref_from(dst, counts.vbuffs)
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.ibuff_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.ibuff_info_num = counts.ibuffs.conv();
                    let ibuffs = DumpInfo::<IBuffInfoPs3>::ref_from(dst, counts.ibuffs)
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.texture_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.texture_info_num = counts.textures.conv();
                    let textures = DumpInfo::<
                        TextureInfoPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.textures)
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.animation_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.animation_info_num = counts.animations.conv();
                    let animations = DumpInfo::<
                        AnimationInfoPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.animations)
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.hk_constraint_info_num = counts.hk_constraints.conv();
                    let hk_constraints = DumpInfo::<
                        HkConstraintInfoPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.hk_constraints)
                        .context("hk_constraint_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut effect_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.effect_info_offset = effect_info_offset.conv();
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.effect_num(),
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    pak_header.effect_info_num = effect_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut foliage_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.foliage_info_offset = foliage_info_offset.conv();
                    let foliage_infos = FoliageInfoPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.foliage_num(),
                        )
                        .context("foliage_infos")?;
                    pak_header.foliage_info_num = foliage_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.pfield_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.pfield_num(),
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    pak_header.pfield_info_num = pfield_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let mut gfx_block_info_offset = dst.offset;
                    pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset = gfx_block_info_offset.conv();
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.gfx_num(),
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    pak_header.gfx_block_info_num = gfx_block_infos.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    let radiosity = self.radiosity();
                    pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num = counts.radiosity_vals.conv();
                    let radiosity_vals = DumpInfo::<
                        RadiosityValsInfoPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.radiosity_vals)
                        .context("radiosity_vals_infos")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    pak_header.animation_block_info_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    pak_header.animation_block_info_num = counts.animation_blocks.conv();
                    let animation_blocks = DumpInfo::<
                        AnimationBlockInfoPs3,
                    >::ref_from(dst, counts.animation_blocks)
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let texture_data = Vec::with_capacity(textures.len() * 2);
                    let model_data = Vec::with_capacity(models.len() + 1);
                    let mut dump_infos = DumpInfosPs3 {
                        models,
                        buffers,
                        mat1s,
                        mat2s,
                        mat3s,
                        mat4s,
                        mat_extras,
                        shapes,
                        hk_shapes,
                        hk_constraint_datas,
                        vbuffs,
                        ibuffs,
                        textures,
                        animations,
                        hk_constraints,
                        animation_blocks,
                        radiosity_vals,
                        texture_data,
                        model_data,
                        offsets: DumpInfo {
                            vals: offsets,
                            ind: 0,
                            offset: 0,
                        },
                    };
                    dst.align(16);
                    for (((key, effect), info), type_infos) in self
                        .effects()
                        .sorted_by_key(|x| x.0)
                        .zip(effect_infos)
                        .zip(type_infos)
                    {
                        info.key = key.conv();
                        info.gamemodemask = effect.gamemodemask().conv();
                        let off = dst.offset;
                        effect
                            .dump_into(dst, type_infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("effect {0}", key))
                            }))?;
                        info.size = (dst.offset - off).conv();
                        info.offset = off.conv();
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (effect_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(EffectInfoPs3, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        effect_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<EffectInfoPs3>();
                    }
                    let (normal, terrain, occluder) = self.group_models();
                    let mut model_count = 0;
                    for model in normal {
                        model
                            .dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("model({0}) {1}", model_count, model.key()),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        model_count += 1;
                    }
                    let terrain_offset = dst.offset;
                    if terrain.len() != 0 {
                        *<[u8; 16]>::mut_from_data(dst).context("terrain indices")? = [0xFFu8; 16];
                    }
                    for model in terrain {
                        model
                            .dump_terrain_into(dst, &mut dump_infos, terrain_offset)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "terrain model({0}) {1}",
                                        model_count,
                                        model.key(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }))?;
                        model_count += 1;
                    }
                    dst.align(16);
                    for (foliage, info) in self.foliages().zip(foliage_infos) {
                        foliage
                            .dump_into(dst, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", info.key))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (foliage_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(FoliageInfoPs3, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        foliage_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<FoliageInfoPs3>();
                    }
                    if let Some(model) = occluder {
                        model.dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos).context("model occluder")?;
                        dst.align(16);
                    }
                    for ((key, gfx), info) in self.gfxs().zip(gfx_block_infos) {
                        info.key = key.conv();
                        info.offset = dst.offset.conv();
                        gfx.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("gfx {0}", key))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(16);
                        *dump_infos.offsets.next() = (gfx_block_info_offset
                            + { builtin # offset_of(GFXBlockInfoPs3, offset) })
                            .conv();
                        gfx_block_info_offset += std::mem::size_of::<GFXBlockInfoPs3>();
                    }
                    radiosity.dump_into(dst, &mut dump_infos).context("radiosity")?;
                    dst.align(16);
                    Ok(dump_infos)
                }
                fn add_size(
                    &self,
                    mut offset: usize,
                    counts: &mut InfoCounts,
                ) -> (usize, Vec<TypeInfos>) {
                    let mut objs_size = 0;
                    let mut type_infos = self
                        .effects()
                        .sorted_by_key(|x| x.0)
                        .map(|(_, effect)| {
                            let (size, type_infos) = effect.size();
                            objs_size += size;
                            type_infos
                        })
                        .collect();
                    let (normal, terrain, occluder) = self.group_models();
                    for model in normal {
                        objs_size = align_offset(model.add_size(objs_size, counts), 16);
                    }
                    if terrain.len() != 0 {
                        objs_size += 16;
                    }
                    for model in terrain {
                        objs_size = model.add_terrain_size(objs_size, counts);
                    }
                    objs_size = align_offset(objs_size, 16);
                    for foliage in self.foliages() {
                        objs_size += align_offset(foliage.add_size(objs_size), 16);
                    }
                    if let Some(model) = occluder {
                        objs_size = align_offset(model.add_size(objs_size, counts), 16);
                    }
                    for (_, gfx) in self.gfxs() {
                        objs_size = align_offset(objs_size + gfx.len(), 16);
                    }
                    objs_size = align_offset(
                        self.radiosity().add_size(objs_size, counts),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16);
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obja_num() * std::mem::size_of::<ObjAPs3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obja_num() * std::mem::size_of::<ObjAPs3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.obj0_num() * std::mem::size_of::<Obj0Ps3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.models
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<ModelInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.buffers
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<BufferInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat1s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat1Ps3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat2s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat2Ps3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat3s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat3Ps3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + counts.mat4s * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<Mat4Ps3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.mat_extras
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<MatExtraPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.shapes
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<ShapeInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_shapes
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkShapeInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_constraint_datas
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkConstraintDataPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.vbuffs
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<VBuffInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.ibuffs
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<IBuffInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.textures
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<TextureInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.animations
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<AnimationInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.hk_constraints
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<HkConstraintInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.effect_num() * std::mem::size_of::<EffectInfoPs3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.foliage_num() * std::mem::size_of::<FoliageInfoPs3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + self.pfield_num() * std::mem::size_of::<PFieldInfoPs3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset + self.gfx_num() * std::mem::size_of::<GFXBlockInfoPs3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.radiosity_vals
                                * std::mem::size_of::<RadiosityValsInfoPs3>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    offset = align_offset(
                        offset
                            + counts.animation_blocks
                                * std::mem::size_of::<DumpInfo<AnimationBlockInfoPs3>>(),
                        16,
                    );
                    counts.offsets
                        += self.effect_num() + self.gfx_num() + self.foliage_num();
                    (offset + objs_size, type_infos)
                }
            }
            impl<'a> DumpObjsPc for ObjsRefPc<'a> {
                type Data = &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>;
                fn obja_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.objas.len()
                }
                fn obj0_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.obj0s.len()
                }
                fn effect_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.effects.len()
                }
                fn foliage_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.foliages.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.len()).sum::<usize>()
                }
                fn pfield_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.pfield_infos.len()
                }
                fn gfx_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.gfxs.len()
                }
                fn write_objas(&self, objas: &mut [ObjAPc]) -> Result<()> {
                    objas.write_from(&self.objas[..])
                }
                fn write_obj0s(&self, obj0s: &mut [Obj0Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    obj0s.write_from(&self.obj0s[..])
                }
                fn effects(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &impl DumpGameObjsPc)> {
                    self.effects.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                }
                fn models(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &impl DumpModelPc<Data = Self::Data>)> {
                    self.models.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                }
                fn textures(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &impl DumpTexturePc<Data = Self::Data>),
                > {
                    self.textures.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                }
                fn foliages(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpFoliagePc> {
                    self.foliages.iter().flat_map(|(_, x)| x.iter())
                }
                fn gfxs(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &[u8])> {
                    self.gfxs.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, &v[..]))
                }
                fn radiosity(&self) -> &impl DumpRadiosityPc<Data = Self::Data> {
                    &self.radiosity
                }
            }
            impl<'a> DumpObjsXbox for ObjsRefXbox<'a> {
                type Data = &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>;
                fn obja_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.objas.len()
                }
                fn obj0_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.obj0s.len()
                }
                fn effect_num(&self) -> usize {

                fn foliage_num(&self) -> usize {

                fn pfield_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.pfield_infos.len()

                fn gfx_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.gfxs.len()
                }
                fn write_objas(&self, objas: &mut [ObjAXbox]) -> Result<()> {

                }
                fn write_obj0s(&self, obj0s: &mut [Obj0Xbox]) -> Result<()> {

                }
                fn effects(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &impl DumpGameObjsXbox)> {

                fn models(

                fn foliages(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpFoliageXbox> {
                    self.foliages.iter().flat_map(|(_, x)| x.iter())

                fn radiosity(&self) -> &impl DumpRadiosityXbox<Data = Self::Data> {

            }

                    &self,

                }
                fn textures(
                    &self,
                ) -> impl Iterator<
                    Item = (u32, &impl DumpTexturePs3<Data = Self::Data>),
                > {
                    self.textures.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
                }
                fn foliages(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpFoliagePs3> {

                }
                fn gfxs(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &[u8])> {
                    self.gfxs.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, &v[..]))
                }
                fn radiosity(&self) -> &impl DumpRadiosityPs3<Data = Self::Data> {
                    &self.radiosity
                }
            }
        }
        pub struct PakHeader {
            #[ordered_data(Pc)]
            pub block_a_num: u32,
            #[ordered_data(Pc)]
            pub block_a_offset: u32,
            pub constx13: u32,
            pub version: u32,
            pub strings_offset: u32,
            pub strings_size: u32,
            pub strings_num: u32,
            pub block1_offset: u32,
            pub block1_size: u32,
            pub block1_size_comp: u32,
            pub sub_blocks1_offset: u32,
            pub block2_offset: u32,
            pub block2_size: u32,
            pub block2_size_comp: u32,
            pub sub_blocks2_offset: u32,
            pub string_keys_offset: u32,
            pub unk_16: u32,
            pub obja_size: u32,
            pub obj0_size: u32,
            pub model_info_size: u32,
            pub buffer_info_size: u32,
            pub mat1_size: u32,
            pub mat2_size: u32,
            pub mat3_size: u32,
            pub mat4_size: u32,
            pub mat_extra_size: u32,
            pub unk_26: u32,
            pub shape_info_size: u32,
            pub hk_shape_info_size: u32,
            pub hk_constraint_data_size: u32,
            pub vbuff_info_size: u32,
            pub ibuff_info_size: u32,
            pub texture_info_size: u32,
            pub animation_info_size: u32,
            pub hk_constraint_info_size: u32,
            pub effect_info_size: u32,
            pub pfield_info_size: u32,
            pub gfx_block_info_size: u32,
            pub animation_block_info_size: u32,
            pub foliage_info_size: u32,
            pub radiosity_vals_info_size: u32,

        impl<'a> Block1RefPc<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(
                src: &'a [u8],
                pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
                bin: &BinRefPc<'a>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let sub_blocks = SubBlocksRefPc::from_data(
                        &src[pak_header.sub_blocks1_offset.get() as usize..],
                    )
                    .context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 sub_blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let level = sub_blocks
                    .blocks
                    .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("level block missing"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )
                    .and_then(|x| match x {
                        SubBlockRefPc::Level(val) => Ok(val),
                        _ => {
                            Err(
                                ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                    let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                        format_args!("level block wrong format"),
                                    );
                                    error
                                }),
                            )
                        }
                    })?;
                let field = level
                    .objs
                    .values()
                    .find(|v| v.header.key.get() == hash_string(b"templateLevel", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel not found"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?
                    .fields
                    .get(&hash_string(b"name", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel missing name field"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?;
                let name = field
                    .crc()
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateObject name field is not a crc"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?
                    .get();
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let objs = ObjsRefPc::from_data(src, pak_header, bin, name)
                    .context("objs")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 objs parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let string_keys = StringKeysRefPc::from_data(
                        &src[pak_header.string_keys_offset.get() as usize..],
                    )
                    .context("string_keys")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 string_keys parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    objs,
                    sub_blocks,
                    string_keys,
                })
            }
        }

                    .get();
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let objs = ObjsRefXbox::from_data(src, pak_header, bin, name)
                    .context("objs")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 objs parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let string_keys = StringKeysRefXbox::from_data(
                        &src[pak_header.string_keys_offset.get() as usize..],
                    )
                    .context("string_keys")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 string_keys parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    objs,
                    sub_blocks,
                    string_keys,
                })
            }
        }
        impl<'a> Block1RefPs3<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(
                src: &'a [u8],
                pak_header: &PakHeaderPs3,
                bin: &BinRefPs3<'a>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let sub_blocks = SubBlocksRefPs3::from_data(
                        &src[pak_header.sub_blocks1_offset.get() as usize..],
                    )
                    .context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 sub_blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let level = sub_blocks
                    .blocks
                    .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("level block missing"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )
                    .and_then(|x| match x {
                        SubBlockRefPs3::Level(val) => Ok(val),
                        _ => {
                            Err(
                                ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                    let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                        format_args!("level block wrong format"),
                                    );
                                    error
                                }),
                            )
                        }
                    })?;
                let field = level
                    .objs
                    .values()
                    .find(|v| v.header.key.get() == hash_string(b"templateLevel", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel not found"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?
                    .fields
                    .get(&hash_string(b"name", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel missing name field"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?;
                let name = field
                    .crc()
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateObject name field is not a crc"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?
                    .get();
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let objs = ObjsRefPs3::from_data(src, pak_header, bin, name)
                    .context("objs")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 objs parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let string_keys = StringKeysRefPs3::from_data(
                        &src[pak_header.string_keys_offset.get() as usize..],
                    )
                    .context("string_keys")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 string_keys parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    objs,
                    sub_blocks,
                    string_keys,
                })
            }
        }

        impl Block1Pc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                bin: &BinPc,
                pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let data = decompress_block(
                        &src[pak_header.block1_offset.get() as usize..],
                        pak_header.block1_size_comp.get() as usize,
                        pak_header.block1_size.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("compressed_data")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let sub_blocks = sub_blocks::SubBlocksPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        pak_header.sub_blocks1_offset.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 sub_blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let objs = objs::ObjsRawPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        bin,
                        &sub_blocks,
                        pak_header,
                    )
                    .and_then(|x| objs::ObjsPc::try_from(x))
                    .context("objs")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 objs parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let string_keys = types::StringKeysPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        pak_header.string_keys_offset.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("string_keys")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 string_keys parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: data,
                    objs,
                    sub_blocks,
                    string_keys,
                })
            }
        }
