        pub struct Block1 {
            pub objs: objs::Objs,
            pub sub_blocks: sub_blocks::SubBlocks,
            pub strings_keys: types::StringKeys,
        }
        pub trait DumpBlock1Pc {
            type Data;
            fn objs(&self) -> &impl DumpObjsPc<Data = Self::Data>;
            fn sub_blocks(&self) -> &impl DumpSubBlocksPc;
            fn string_keys(&self) -> &impl DumpStringKeysPc;
            fn dump<'a>(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                offsets: &'a mut [u32Pc],
                counts: &InfoCounts,
                pak_header: &mut PakHeaderPc,
                type_infos: (&TypeInfos, &[TypeInfos]),
            ) -> Result<DumpInfosPc<'a, Self::Data>> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let infos = self
                    .objs()
                    .dump_into(dst, offsets, counts, pak_header, type_infos.1)
                    .context("objs")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("objs dumped in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                pak_header.sub_blocks1_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                self.sub_blocks().dump_into(dst, type_infos.0).context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "sub_blocks1 dumped in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                pak_header.string_keys_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                self.string_keys().dump_into(dst).context("string_keys")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "string keys dumped in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(infos)
            }
            fn size(
                &self,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> (usize, (TypeInfos, Vec<TypeInfos>)) {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let (mut size, obj_infos) = self.objs().add_size(0, counts);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("objs size in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut infos = None;
                size += self.sub_blocks().size(&mut infos);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "sub_blocks1 size in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                size += self.string_keys().size();
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "string keys size in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                (size, (infos.expect("sub_blocks1 level block missing"), obj_infos))
            }
        }

        impl Block2Pc {
            pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, pak_header: &PakHeaderPc) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let data = decompress_block(
                        &src[pak_header.block2_offset.get() as usize..],
                        pak_header.block2_size_comp.get() as usize,
                        pak_header.block2_size.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("compressed_data")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let sub_blocks = sub_blocks::SubBlocksPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        pak_header.sub_blocks2_offset.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 sub_blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let offsets = NonNull::from_ref(
                    u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &data[pak_header.block2_offsets_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.block2_offsets_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("offsets")?,
                );
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 offsets parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),

        impl Block2Xbox {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                pak_header: &PakHeaderXbox,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let data = decompress_block(
                        &src[pak_header.block2_offset.get() as usize..],
                        pak_header.block2_size_comp.get() as usize,
                        pak_header.block2_size.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("compressed_data")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let sub_blocks = sub_blocks::SubBlocksXbox::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        pak_header.sub_blocks2_offset.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 sub_blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let offsets = NonNull::from_ref(
                    u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &data[pak_header.block2_offsets_offset.get() as usize..],
                            pak_header.block2_offsets_num.get() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("offsets")?,
                );
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 offsets parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: data,
                    sub_blocks,
                    offsets,
                })
            }
        }

        pub trait DumpBlock2Pc {
            fn sub_blocks(&self) -> &impl DumpSubBlocksPc;
            fn dump<'a>(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                offset_num: usize,
            ) -> Result<&'a mut [u32Pc]> {
                let type_infos = Default::default();
                self.sub_blocks().dump_into(dst, &type_infos).context("sub_blocks")?;
                let offsets = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, offset_num)
                    .context("offsets")?;
                Ok(offsets)
            }
            fn size(&self, offset_num: usize) -> usize {
                let mut type_infos = None;
                self.sub_blocks().size(&mut type_infos)
                    + offset_num * std::mem::size_of::<u32Pc>()
            }
        }

        impl Default for PakRefPs3<'_> {

        impl<'a> PakRefPc<'a> {
            pub fn from_data<'b: 'a, 'c: 'b>(
                src: &'c [u8],
                data: &'a mut PakCompressedData<'b>,
                bin: &BinRefPc<'a>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = PakHeaderPc::from_data(&src[..]).context("header")?;
                let strings = StringsRefPc::from_data(
                        &src[header.strings_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.strings_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak headers parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let vals_a = BlockAValPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[header.block_a_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.block_a_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak vals_a parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                data.block1 = CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                    &src[header.block1_offset.get() as usize..],
                    header.block1_size_comp.get() as usize,
                    header.block1_size.get() as usize,
                );
                data.block2 = CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                    &src[header.block2_offset.get() as usize..],
                    header.block2_size_comp.get() as usize,
                    header.block2_size.get() as usize,
                );
                rayon::iter::once(&mut data.block1)
                    .chain(rayon::iter::once(&mut data.block2))
                    .try_for_each(|data| data.decompress())
                    .context("blocks")?;
                let block1 = Block1RefPc::from_data(&data.block1.get(), header, bin)
                    .context("block1")?;
                let block2 = Block2RefPc::from_data(&data.block2.get(), header)
                    .context("block2")?;
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                data.animations = block1
                    .objs
                    .animation_block_infos
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                        &src[info.offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                        info.size.get() as usize,
                    ))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .into_boxed_slice()
                    .into();
                data.animations
                    .par_iter_mut()
                    .try_for_each(|data| data.decompress())
                    .context("animation blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak animation_data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let animations = AnimationsRefPc::from_data(
                        block1.objs.animation_infos.as_slice(),
                        &data.animations[..],
                        block1.objs.animation_block_infos.as_slice(),
                    )
                    .context("animations")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak animations parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(PakRefPc {
                    header,
                    strings,
                    block1,
                    block2,
                    animations,
                    vals_a: vals_a.into(),
                })
            }
        }
        impl<'a> PakRefXbox<'a> {

                    .context("animation blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak animation_data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let animations = AnimationsRefXbox::from_data(
                        block1.objs.animation_infos.as_slice(),
                        &data.animations[..],
                        block1.objs.animation_block_infos.as_slice(),
                    )
                    .context("animations")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak animations parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(PakRefXbox {
                    header,
                    strings,
                    block1,
                    block2,
                    animations,
                    vals_a: vals_a.into(),
                })
            }
        }
        impl<'a> PakRefPs3<'a> {
            pub fn from_data<'b: 'a, 'c: 'b>(
                src: &'c [u8],
                data: &'a mut PakCompressedData<'b>,
                bin: &BinRefPs3<'a>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = PakHeaderPs3::from_data(&src[..]).context("header")?;
                let strings = StringsRefPs3::from_data(
                        &src[header.strings_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.strings_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak headers parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let vals_a = BlockAValPs3::slice_from_data(
                        &src[header.block_a_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.block_a_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak vals_a parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                data.block1 = CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                    &src[header.block1_offset.get() as usize..],
                    header.block1_size_comp.get() as usize,
                    header.block1_size.get() as usize,
                );
                data.block2 = CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                    &src[header.block2_offset.get() as usize..],
                    header.block2_size_comp.get() as usize,
                    header.block2_size.get() as usize,
                );
                rayon::iter::once(&mut data.block1)
                    .chain(rayon::iter::once(&mut data.block2))
                    .try_for_each(|data| data.decompress())
                    .context("blocks")?;
                let block1 = Block1RefPs3::from_data(&data.block1.get(), header, bin)
                    .context("block1")?;
                let block2 = Block2RefPs3::from_data(&data.block2.get(), header)
                    .context("block2")?;
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                data.animations = block1
                    .objs
                    .animation_block_infos
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| CompressedDataRefAlt::from_data(
                        &src[info.offset.get() as usize..],
                        info.size_comp.get() as usize,
                        info.size.get() as usize,
                    ))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .into_boxed_slice()
                    .into();
                data.animations
                    .par_iter_mut()
                    .try_for_each(|data| data.decompress())
                    .context("animation blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak animation_data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let animations = AnimationsRefPs3::from_data(
                        block1.objs.animation_infos.as_slice(),
                        &data.animations[..],
                        block1.objs.animation_block_infos.as_slice(),
                    )
                    .context("animations")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak animations parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(PakRefPs3 {
                    header,
                    strings,
                    block1,
                    block2,
                    animations,
                    vals_a: vals_a.into(),
                })
            }
        }

        impl PakPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(data: BufType) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = PakHeaderPc::from_data(&data[..]).context("header")?;
                let strings = types::StringsPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        header.strings_offset.get() as usize,
                        header.strings_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak headers parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let vals_a = BlockAValPc::slice_from_data(
                        &data[header.block_a_offset.get() as usize..],
                        header.block_a_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak vals_a parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let header = NonNull::from_ref(header);
                let vals_a = NonNull::from_ref(vals_a);
                Ok(Self {
                    data,
                    header,
                    strings,
                    block1: None,
                    block2: None,
                    animation_blocks: None,
                    vals_a,
                })
            }
        }

        impl PakPc {
            pub fn parse_block1(&mut self, bin: &BinPc) -> Result<()> {
                if self.block1.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    self.block1
                        .replace(Block1Pc::from_bytes(&self.data, bin, self.header())?);
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak block1 parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse_block2(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
                if self.block2.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    self.block2
                        .replace(Block2Pc::from_bytes(&self.data, self.header())?);
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak block2 parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse_animation_blocks(&mut self, bin: &BinPc) -> Result<()> {
                self.parse_block1(bin).context("block1")?;
                if self.animation_blocks.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let block1 = self.block1.as_ref().unwrap();
                    self.animation_blocks
                        .replace(
                            AnimationsRawPc::from_bytes(
                                    &self.data,
                                    self.header(),
                                    &block1._ptr,
                                )
                                .and_then(|x| AnimationsPc::try_from(x))
                                .context("animation_blocks")?,
                        );
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak animation blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse(&mut self, bin: &BinPc) -> Result<()> {
                self.parse_block2().context("block2")?;
                self.parse_animation_blocks(bin)
            }
            pub fn header(&self) -> &PakHeaderPc {
                unsafe { self.header.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn strings(&self) -> &types::StringsPc {
                &self.strings
            }
            pub fn block1(&self) -> Option<&Block1Pc> {
                self.block1.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn block2(&self) -> Option<&Block2Pc> {
                self.block2.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn animation_blocks(&self) -> Option<&AnimationsPc> {
                self.animation_blocks.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn vals_a(&self) -> &[BlockAValPc] {
                unsafe { self.vals_a.as_ref() }
            }
        }

        pub trait DumpPakPc {
            type Data;
            fn vals_a_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_vals_a(&self, vals_a: &mut [BlockAValPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn block1(&self) -> &impl DumpBlock1Pc<Data = Self::Data>;
            fn block2(&self) -> &impl DumpBlock2Pc;
            fn animations(&self) -> &impl DumpAnimationsPc;
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsPc;
            fn dump(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                in_header: PakHeaderPc,
                block1: CompressedBlock,
                block2: CompressedBlock,
                animations: Vec<CompressedBlock>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = PakHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                header.write_from(&in_header).context("write header")?;
                for (i, animation) in animations.into_iter().enumerate() {
                    dst.align(4096);
                    animation
                        .compressed
                        .dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation block {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                }
                dst.align(4096);
                block1.compressed.dump_into(dst).context("block1")?;
                dst.align(4096);
                block2.compressed.dump_into(dst).context("block2")?;
                dst.align(4096);
                let start = dst.offset;
                let strings = self.strings();
                header.strings_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                header.strings_num = strings.num_strings().conv();
                strings.dump_into(dst).context("strings")?;
                header.strings_size = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                header.block_a_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_a = BlockAValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_a_num())
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                header.block_a_num = vals_a.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_a(vals_a).context("write vals_a")?;
                dst.align(2048);
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(
                &self,
            ) -> Result<
                (
                    usize,
                    PakHeaderPc,
                    CompressedBlock,
                    CompressedBlock,
                    Vec<CompressedBlock>,
                    Vec<(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<Self::Data>)>,
                    Vec<(u32Pc, u32Pc, Option<Self::Data>)>,
                    Option<(u32Pc, u32Pc, Self::Data)>,
                ),
            > {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let mut size = std::mem::size_of::<PakHeaderPc>();
                let mut header = PakHeaderPc::default();
                let block1 = self.block1();
                let block2 = self.block2();
                let animations = self.animations();
                let mut counts = InfoCounts::default();
                animations.info_counts(&mut counts);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "animation counts in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let (block1_size, type_infos) = block1.size(&mut counts);
                let mut block1_data = CompressedBlock::with_capacity(block1_size);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("block1 size in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut block2_data = CompressedBlock::with_capacity(
                    block2.size(counts.offsets),
                );
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("block2 size in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let offsets = {
                    let mut dst = block2_data.dump_slice();
                    block2.dump(&mut dst, counts.offsets).context("block2")
                }?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("dumped block2 in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut infos = {
                    let mut dst = block1_data.dump_slice();
                    block1
                        .dump(
                            &mut dst,
                            offsets,
                            &counts,
                            &mut header,
                            (&type_infos.0, &type_infos.1),
                        )
                        .context("block1")
                }?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("dumped block1 in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut animation_blocks = animations
                    .dump(&mut infos)
                    .context("animations")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "dumped animations in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                animation_blocks
                    .par_iter_mut()
                    .try_for_each(|x| x.compress())
                    .context("compressed data")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "compressed animations in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                for (block, info) in animation_blocks
                    .iter()
                    .zip(infos.animation_blocks.take())
                {
                    size = align_offset(size, 4096) + block.compressed.len();
                    info.offset = size.conv();
                    info.size_comp = block.compressed.len().conv();
                }
                let model_data = infos.model_data;
                let texture_data = infos.texture_data;
                let radiosity = block1.objs().radiosity();
                let rad_data = if let Some(data) = radiosity.data() {
                    let radiosity_name = hash_string(
                        b"_radiosity",
                        Some(block1.sub_blocks().level_name()?),
                    );
                    Some((radiosity_name.into(), radiosity.usage(), data))
                } else {
                    None
                };
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "dumped radiosity in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                rayon::iter::once(&mut block1_data)
                    .chain(rayon::iter::once(&mut block2_data))
                    .try_for_each(|x| x.compress())
                    .context("compressed blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "compressed blocks in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                size = align_offset(size, 4096) + block1_data.compressed.len();
                header.block1_offset = size.conv();
                header.block1_size = block1_data.data.len().conv();
                header.block1_size_comp = block1_data.compressed.len().conv();
                size = align_offset(size, 4096) + block2_data.compressed.len();
                header.block2_offset = size.conv();
                header.block2_size = block2_data.data.len().conv();
                header.block2_size_comp = block2_data.compressed.len().conv();
                size = align_offset(size, 4096) + self.strings().size()
                    + self.vals_a_num() * std::mem::size_of::<BlockAValPc>();
                size = align_offset(size, 2048);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("misc sizes in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                Ok((
                    size,
                    header,
                    block1_data,
                    block2_data,
                    animation_blocks,
                    model_data,
                    texture_data,
                    rad_data,
                ))
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpPakXbox {
            type Data;
            fn vals_a_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_vals_a(&self, vals_a: &mut [BlockAValXbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn block1(&self) -> &impl DumpBlock1Xbox<Data = Self::Data>;
            fn block2(&self) -> &impl DumpBlock2Xbox;
            fn animations(&self) -> &impl DumpAnimationsXbox;
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsXbox;
            fn dump(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                in_header: PakHeaderXbox,
                block1: CompressedBlock,
                block2: CompressedBlock,
                animations: Vec<CompressedBlock>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = PakHeaderXbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                header.write_from(&in_header).context("write header")?;
                for (i, animation) in animations.into_iter().enumerate() {
                    dst.align(4096);
                    animation
                        .compressed
                        .dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation block {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                }
                dst.align(4096);
                block1.compressed.dump_into(dst).context("block1")?;
                dst.align(4096);
                block2.compressed.dump_into(dst).context("block2")?;
                dst.align(4096);
                let start = dst.offset;
                let strings = self.strings();
                header.strings_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                header.strings_num = strings.num_strings().conv();
                strings.dump_into(dst).context("strings")?;
                header.strings_size = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                header.block_a_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_a = BlockAValXbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_a_num())
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                header.block_a_num = vals_a.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_a(vals_a).context("write vals_a")?;
                dst.align(2048);
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(
                &self,
            ) -> Result<
                (
                    usize,
                    PakHeaderXbox,
                    CompressedBlock,
                    CompressedBlock,
                    Vec<CompressedBlock>,
                    Vec<(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<Self::Data>)>,
                    Vec<(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Option<Self::Data>)>,
                    Option<(u32Xbox, u32Xbox, Self::Data)>,
                ),
            > {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let mut size = std::mem::size_of::<PakHeaderXbox>();
                let mut header = PakHeaderXbox::default();
                let block1 = self.block1();
                let block2 = self.block2();
                let animations = self.animations();
                let mut counts = InfoCounts::default();
                animations.info_counts(&mut counts);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "animation counts in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let (block1_size, type_infos) = block1.size(&mut counts);
                let mut block1_data = CompressedBlock::with_capacity(block1_size);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("block1 size in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut block2_data = CompressedBlock::with_capacity(
                    block2.size(counts.offsets),
                );
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("block2 size in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let offsets = {
                    let mut dst = block2_data.dump_slice();
                    block2.dump(&mut dst, counts.offsets).context("block2")
                }?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("dumped block2 in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut infos = {
                    let mut dst = block1_data.dump_slice();
                    block1
                        .dump(
                            &mut dst,
                            offsets,
                            &counts,
                            &mut header,
                            (&type_infos.0, &type_infos.1),
                        )
                        .context("block1")
                }?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("dumped block1 in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut animation_blocks = animations
                    .dump(&mut infos)
                    .context("animations")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "dumped animations in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                animation_blocks
                    .par_iter_mut()
                    .try_for_each(|x| x.compress())
                    .context("compressed data")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "compressed animations in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                for (block, info) in animation_blocks
                    .iter()
                    .zip(infos.animation_blocks.take())
                {
                    size = align_offset(size, 4096) + block.compressed.len();
                    info.offset = size.conv();
                    info.size_comp = block.compressed.len().conv();
                }
                let model_data = infos.model_data;
                let texture_data = infos.texture_data;
                let radiosity = block1.objs().radiosity();
                let rad_data = if let Some(data) = radiosity.data() {
                    let radiosity_name = hash_string(
                        b"_radiosity",
                        Some(block1.sub_blocks().level_name()?),
                    );
                    Some((radiosity_name.into(), radiosity.usage(), data))
                } else {
                    None
                };
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "dumped radiosity in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                rayon::iter::once(&mut block1_data)
                    .chain(rayon::iter::once(&mut block2_data))
                    .try_for_each(|x| x.compress())
                    .context("compressed blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "compressed blocks in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                size = align_offset(size, 4096) + block1_data.compressed.len();
                header.block1_offset = size.conv();
                header.block1_size = block1_data.data.len().conv();
                header.block1_size_comp = block1_data.compressed.len().conv();
                size = align_offset(size, 4096) + block2_data.compressed.len();
                header.block2_offset = size.conv();
                header.block2_size = block2_data.data.len().conv();
                header.block2_size_comp = block2_data.compressed.len().conv();
                size = align_offset(size, 4096) + self.strings().size()
                    + self.vals_a_num() * std::mem::size_of::<BlockAValXbox>();
                size = align_offset(size, 2048);
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("misc sizes in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                Ok((
                    size,
                    header,
                    block1_data,
                    block2_data,
                    animation_blocks,
                    model_data,
                    texture_data,
                    rad_data,
                ))
            }

        pub trait DumpPakPs3 {
            type Data;
            fn vals_a_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_vals_a(&self, vals_a: &mut [BlockAValPs3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn block1(&self) -> &impl DumpBlock1Ps3<Data = Self::Data>;
            fn block2(&self) -> &impl DumpBlock2Ps3;
            fn animations(&self) -> &impl DumpAnimationsPs3;
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsPs3;
            fn dump(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                in_header: PakHeaderPs3,
                block1: CompressedBlock,
                block2: CompressedBlock,
                animations: Vec<CompressedBlock>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = PakHeaderPs3::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                header.write_from(&in_header).context("write header")?;
                for (i, animation) in animations.into_iter().enumerate() {

                    animation
                        .compressed
                        .dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("animation block {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                }
                dst.align(4096);
                block1.compressed.dump_into(dst).context("block1")?;
                dst.align(4096);
                block2.compressed.dump_into(dst).context("block2")?;
                dst.align(4096);
                let start = dst.offset;
                let strings = self.strings();
                header.strings_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                header.strings_num = strings.num_strings().conv();
                strings.dump_into(dst).context("strings")?;
                header.strings_size = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                header.block_a_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_a = BlockAValPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_a_num())
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                header.block_a_num = vals_a.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_a(vals_a).context("write vals_a")?;
                dst.align(2048);
                Ok(())
            }

                    texture_data,
                    rad_data,
                ))

                &self.block1
            }
            fn block2(&self) -> &impl DumpBlock2Pc {

            fn animations(&self) -> &impl DumpAnimationsPc {
                &self.animations
            }
            fn strings(&self) -> &impl DumpStringsPc {
                &self.strings
            }
        }

        #[repr(C)]

        pub trait DumpRadiosityValsPc {
            fn off_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_offs(&self, offs: &mut [i32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                info: &mut RadiosityValsInfoPc,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                info.offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let offs = i32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.off_num())
                    .context("offs")?;
                info.num = offs.len().conv();
                self.write_offs(offs).context("write offs")?;
                dst.align(16);
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, offset: usize) -> usize {
                align_offset(offset + self.off_num() * std::mem::size_of::<i32Pc>(), 16)
            }
        }

                infos: &'a [RadiosityValsInfoPs3],
                data: Option<&'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                usage: u32,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let vals = infos
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|info| Ok((
                        info.guid.get(),
                        RadiosityValsRefPs3::from_data(src, info)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("radiosity {0}", info.guid.get()),
                                )
                            }))?,
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<MapImpl<_, _>>>()?;
                Ok(Self {
                    data,
                    vals: vals.into(),
                    usage,
                })
            }
        }

        impl RadiosityRawPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                bin: &BinPc,
                level: &GameObjsPc,
                pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let infos = RadiosityValsInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.get() as usize..],
                        pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("infos")?;
                let offs = infos
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| Ok(
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            i32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.offset.get() as usize..],
                                info.num.get() as usize,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    ))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()
                    .context("offs")?;
                let field = level
                    .objs()
                    .iter()
                    .find(|(_, v)| {
                        v.header().key.get() == hash_string(b"templateLevel", None)
                    })
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel not found"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?
                    .1
                    .get(&hash_string(b"name", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel missing name field"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?;
                let name = field
                    .crc()
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateObject name field is not a crc"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?;
                let radiosity_name = hash_string(b"_radiosity", Some(name.get()));
                let model_data = bin.model_data();
                let ind = model_data.get_index_of(&radiosity_name);
                let data = ind
                    .map(|x| model_data.get_index(x).unwrap().1.clone())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let usage = ind
                    .map(|x| bin.model_handles()[x].kind.get())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    data,
                    infos: infos.into(),
                    offs: offs.into(),
                    usage,
                })
            }
        }

        impl TryFrom<RadiosityRawPc> for RadiosityPc {
            type Error = anyhow::Error;
            fn try_from(
                RadiosityRawPc { _ptr, data, infos, offs, usage }: RadiosityRawPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let _data = data.get()?.clone();
                if _data.len() % 4 != 0 {
                    {
                        {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!("Radiosity length is incorrect?"),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::level::radiosity",
                                        "lotrc::level::radiosity",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                let vals = NonNull::from_ref(
                    if _data.len() == 0 {
                        &[] as _
                    } else {
                        ColorPc::slice_from_data(&_data[..], _data.len() / 4)
                            .context("vals")?
                    },
                );
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr,
                    _data,
                    infos,
                    offs,
                    vals,
                    usage,
                })
            }
        }

        pub enum RadiosityVal {
            Radiosity(Vec<Color>),
            NoRadiosity(u32),
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for RadiosityVal {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                match self {
                    RadiosityVal::Radiosity(__self_0) => {
                        ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                            f,
                            "Radiosity",
                            &__self_0,
                        )
                    }
                    RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(__self_0) => {
                        ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                            f,
                            "NoRadiosity",
                            &__self_0,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for RadiosityVal {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> RadiosityVal {
                match self {
                    RadiosityVal::Radiosity(__self_0) => {
                        RadiosityVal::Radiosity(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                    }
                    RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(__self_0) => {
                        RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        impl Radiosity {
            pub fn from_pc(val: &RadiosityPc, block1: &Block1Pc) -> Result<Self> {
                let gameobjs = block1
                    .sub_blocks()
                    .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("level block missing"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )
                    .and_then(|x| {
                        x
                            .level()
                            .ok_or(
                                ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                    let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                        format_args!("level block wrong format"),
                                    );
                                    error
                                }),
                            )
                    })?;
                let models = block1.objs().models();
                let mut off: usize = 0;
                Ok(Radiosity {
                    vals: val
                        .offs
                        .iter()
                        .zip(val.infos())
                        .map(|(vals, info)| {
                            let obj = gameobjs.objs().get(&info.guid.get()).unwrap();
                            let model = obj
                                .get(&hash_string(b"mesh", None))
                                .ok_or(
                                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                            format_args!("missing mesh field"),
                                        );
                                        error
                                    }),
                                )
                                .and_then(|field| {
                                    field
                                        .crc()
                                        .map(|x| x.get())
                                        .ok_or(
                                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                                    format_args!("mesh field not crc"),
                                                );
                                                error
                                            }),
                                        )
                                })
                                .and_then(|mesh| {
                                    models
                                        .get(&mesh)
                                        .ok_or_else(|| ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                    format_args!("model {0} missing", mesh),
                                                )
                                            }),
                                        ))
                                })
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("obj {0}", info.guid.get()),
                                    )
                                }))?;
                            Ok((
                                info.guid.get(),
                                model
                                    .data()
                                    .infos()
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|x| (x.vbuff_size.get() / x.v_size.get()) as usize)
                                    .zip(unsafe { vals.as_ref() })
                                    .map(|(offset, size)| {
                                        if offset != off {
                                            RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(offset as u32)
                                        } else {
                                            off += size.get() as usize;
                                            RadiosityVal::Radiosity(
                                                val
                                                    .vals()[offset..offset + size.get() as usize]
                                                    .iter()
                                                    .map(|x| x.conv())
                                                    .collect(),
                                            )
                                        }
                                    })
                                    .collect(),
                            ))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?,
                    usage: val.usage,
                })
            }

        pub trait DumpRadiosityPc {
            type Data;
            fn vals(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, &impl DumpRadiosityValsPc)>;
            fn dump_into<D>(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc<D>,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                for (guid, vals) in self.vals() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = (infos.radiosity_vals.offset
                        + { builtin # offset_of(RadiosityValsInfoPc, offset) })
                        .conv();
                    let info = infos.radiosity_vals.next();
                    vals.dump_into(dst, info)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("vals {0}", guid))
                        }))?;
                    info.guid = guid.conv();
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                for (_, vals) in self.vals() {
                    counts.radiosity_vals += 1;
                    offset = vals.add_size(offset);
                }
                offset
            }
            fn data(&self) -> Option<Self::Data>;
            fn usage(&self) -> u32Pc;
        }

            type Data = &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>;

                self.vals.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, v))
            }
            fn data(&self) -> Option<Self::Data> {
                self.data

                self.usage.conv()
            }

        pub const fn get_stride_width(format: u32) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
            match format {
                10 | 0xb | 0xc | 0x11 => Some((4, 16)),
                7 | 8 | 13 => Some((4, 8)),
                3 | 4 => Some((1, 4)),
                6 => Some((1, 1)),
                _ => None,
            }
        }
        pub fn conv_img_a8(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 4) {
                let off = (j & 3) + ((j >> 1) & !3);
                let x = (off % w) << 5;
                let y = ((off / w) << 5) + ((j << 2) & 16);
                for i in 0..512 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 4) & 16) + (i >> 3)) & 24) + (i & 7);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 5) & 8) + ((i >> 3) & 4) + ((i >> 2) & 2)
                        + ((i >> 4) & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let k = (y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off);
                    dst[k] = data[i + (j << 9)];
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_argb8(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys * 4);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 5) {
                let x = (j % w) << 5;
                let y = (j / w) << 5;
                for i in 0..1024 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 4) & 16) + (i >> 1)) & 24) + ((i >> 1) & 4)
                        + (i & 3);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 5) & 8) + (((i >> 5) & 16)) + ((i >> 5) & 6)
                        + ((i >> 2) & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let i = (i << 2) + (j << 12);
                    let j = ((y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off)) << 2;
                    dst[j] = data[i + 3];
                    dst[j + 1] = data[i + 2];
                    dst[j + 2] = data[i + 1];
                    dst[j + 3] = data[i];
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_dxt1(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys * 8);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 5) {
                let x = (j % w) << 5;
                let y = (j / w) << 5;
                for i in 0..1024 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 5) & 16) + i) & 24) + ((i >> 3) & 4)
                        + ((i >> 1) & 2) + (i & 1);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 6) & 8) + (((i >> 4) & 16)) + ((i >> 5) & 6)
                        + ((i >> 1) & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut i = (i << 3) + (j << 13);
                    let mut j = ((y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off)) << 3;
                    for _ in 0..4 {
                        dst[j] = data[i + 1];
                        dst[j + 1] = data[i];
                        j += 2;
                        i += 2;
                    }
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_dxt5(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys * 16);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 5) {
                let x = (j % w) << 5;
                let y = (j / w) << 5;
                for i in 0..1024 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 5) & 16) + (i << 1)) & 24) + ((i >> 3) & 6)
                        + ((i >> 1) & 1);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 6) & 8) + (((i >> 3) & 16)) + ((i >> 6) & 4)
                        + ((i >> 5) & 2) + (i & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut i = (i << 4) + (j << 14);
                    let mut j = ((y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off)) << 4;
                    for _ in 0..8 {
                        dst[j] = data[i + 1];
                        dst[j + 1] = data[i];
                        j += 2;
                        i += 2;
                    }
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_slice(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
            d: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            match d {
                16 => conv_img_dxt5(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
                8 => conv_img_dxt1(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
                4 => conv_img_argb8(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
                _ => conv_img_a8(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
            }
        }
        fn bin_mip(arr: &[u8], w: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
            arr.chunks(w).step_by(2).flat_map(|x| x.iter().step_by(2)).cloned().collect()
        }
        fn decomp_bc4(arr: &[u8], w: usize, h: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
            bcndecode::decode(
                    arr,
                    w,
                    h,
                    bcndecode::BcnEncoding::Bc4,
                    bcndecode::BcnDecoderFormat::LUM,
                )
                .unwrap()
        }

                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.info),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.info),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<
                    Option<&'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                >() != 0
                    && <Option<
                        &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.data0) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "data0",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Option<&'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.data0),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.data0),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                if ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of::<
                    Option<&'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                >() != 0
                    && <Option<
                        &'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>,
                    > as ::safer_ffi::layout::ReprC>::is_valid(&_it.data1) == false
                {
                    {
                        ::std::io::_eprint(
                            format_args!(
                                "Encountered invalid bit-pattern for field `.{0}` of type `{1}`: got `{2:02x?}`\n",
                                "data1",
                                ::safer_ffi::ඞ::any::type_name::<
                                    Option<&'a CompressedDataRefAlt<'a>>,
                                >(),
                                unsafe {
                                    ::safer_ffi::ඞ::slice::from_raw_parts(
                                        <*const _>::cast::<::safer_ffi::ඞ::u8>(&_it.data1),
                                        ::safer_ffi::ඞ::mem::size_of_val(&_it.data1),
                                    )
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                    _ret = false;
                }
                _ret
            }
        }

        impl TextureRawPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                texture_data: &IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
                offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let info = TextureInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                let data0 = texture_data
                    .get(&info.asset_key.get())
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let data1 = texture_data
                    .get(&hash_string(b"*", Some(info.asset_key.get())))
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info: info.into(),
                    data0,
                    data1,
                })
            }
            pub fn info(&self) -> &TextureInfoPc {
                unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
            }
        }

        impl TryFrom<TextureRawPc> for TexturePc {
            type Error = anyhow::Error;
            fn try_from(
                TextureRawPc { _ptr, info, data0, data1 }: TextureRawPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let _data0 = data0.get().context("data0")?.clone();
                let _data1 = data1.get().context("data1")?.clone();
                let info_ref = unsafe { info.as_ref() };
                let data = match info_ref.kind.get() {
                    0 | 7 | 8 => {
                        parse_texture_pc(info_ref, &_data0, &_data1)
                            .context("texture data")?
                    }
                    1 | 9 => {
                        parse_cube_pc(info_ref, &_data0, &_data1).context("cube data")?
                    }
                    _ => {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!(
                                            "Unsupported Texture Type {0} for texture {1:?}",
                                            info_ref.kind,
                                            info_ref.key,
                                        ),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::texture",
                                            "lotrc::level::texture",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                        <[_]>::into_vec(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_new([
                                    NonNull::from_ref(&_data0[..]),
                                    NonNull::from_ref(&_data1[..]),
                                ]),
                            )
                            .into()
                    }
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr,
                    info,
                    _data0,
                    _data1,
                    data,
                })
            }
        }
