        impl<'a> BaseTypeRefPs3<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], kind: u32) -> Result<Self> {
                Ok(
                    match kind {
                        keys::CRC_KEY => {
                            Self::Crc(CrcPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into())
                        }
                        keys::GUID_KEY => {
                            Self::GUID(u32Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into())
                        }
                        keys::COLOR_KEY => {
                            Self::Color(u32Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into())
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR2_KEY => {
                            Self::Vector2(
                                Vector2Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR3_KEY => {
                            Self::Vector3(
                                Vector3Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR4_KEY => {
                            Self::Vector4(
                                Vector4Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => {
                            Self::Matrix4x4(
                                Matrix4x4Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::FLOAT_KEY => {
                            Self::Float(f32Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into())
                        }
                        keys::INT_KEY => {
                            Self::Int(i32Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into())
                        }
                        keys::BOOL_KEY => {
                            Self::Bool(u32Ps3::from_data(src).context("val")?.into())
                        }
                        keys::STRING_KEY => {
                            Self::String({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                let off = val.offset.get() as usize + val.size();
                                core::str::from_utf8(
                                        &src[off..off + val.num.get() as usize],
                                    )?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => {
                            Self::StringList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                let vals = ListPs3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("list info")?;
                                vals.iter()
                                    .enumerate()
                                    .map(|(i, v)| {
                                        Ok({
                                            let off = (val.offset.get() + v.offset.get()) as usize
                                                + val.size() * (i + 2);
                                            let s_data = &src[off..off + v.num.get() as usize];
                                            let s = std::str::from_utf8(s_data)
                                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("string {0}, {1:?}", i, s_data),
                                                    )
                                                }))?;
                                            str_ref::from(s)
                                        })
                                    })
                                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => {
                            Self::ObjectList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                U32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::NODELIST_KEY => {
                            Self::NodeList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                Vector4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::INTLIST_KEY => {
                            Self::IntList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                i32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::CRCLIST_KEY => {
                            Self::CrcList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                U32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                            Self::WeightList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                WeightPs3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                            Self::MatrixList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(src).context("val")?;
                                Matrix4x4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        _ => {
                            return Err(
                                ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                        )
                                    }),
                                ),
                            );
                        }
                    },
                )
            }
        }
        impl BaseTypePc {

                        keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => {

            pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> BaseTypeRefPc<'_> {
                match self {
                    BaseTypePc::Crc(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Crc(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::GUID(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::GUID(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Color(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Color(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Vector2(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Vector2(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Vector3(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Vector3(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Vector4(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Vector4(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Matrix4x4(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Matrix4x4(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Float(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Float(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Int(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Int(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Bool(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Bool(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::String(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::String(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::StringList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::StringList(
                            vals.iter().map(|x| x.as_ref().into()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                    BaseTypePc::ObjectList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::ObjectList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePc::NodeList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPc::NodeList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::IntList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPc::IntList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::CrcList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPc::CrcList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::WeightList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::WeightList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePc::MatrixList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::MatrixList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                }
            }
            pub fn size(kind: u32) -> usize {
                match kind {
                    keys::CRC_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::GUID_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::COLOR_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR2_KEY => Vector2Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR3_KEY => Vector3Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR4_KEY => Vector4Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => Matrix4x4Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::FLOAT_KEY => f32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::INT_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::BOOL_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::STRING_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    _ => 0,
                }
            }
        }

            pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> BaseTypeRefXbox<'_> {
                match self {
                    BaseTypeXbox::Crc(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Crc(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::GUID(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::GUID(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::Color(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Color(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::Vector2(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Vector2(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::Vector3(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Vector3(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::Vector4(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Vector4(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::Matrix4x4(val) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::Matrix4x4(val.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypeXbox::Float(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Float(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::Int(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Int(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::Bool(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::Bool(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::String(val) => BaseTypeRefXbox::String(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypeXbox::StringList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::StringList(
                            vals.iter().map(|x| x.as_ref().into()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                    BaseTypeXbox::ObjectList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::ObjectList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypeXbox::NodeList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::NodeList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypeXbox::IntList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::IntList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypeXbox::CrcList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::CrcList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypeXbox::WeightList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::WeightList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypeXbox::MatrixList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefXbox::MatrixList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                }
            }
            pub fn size(kind: u32) -> usize {
                match kind {
                    keys::CRC_KEY => u32Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::GUID_KEY => u32Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::COLOR_KEY => u32Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR2_KEY => Vector2Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR3_KEY => Vector3Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR4_KEY => Vector4Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => Matrix4x4Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::FLOAT_KEY => f32Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::INT_KEY => u32Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::BOOL_KEY => u32Xbox::size_of(),
                    keys::STRING_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => ListXbox::size_of(),
                    _ => 0,
                }
            }
        }
        impl BaseTypePs3 {
            pub fn from_bytes(data: &BufType, offset: usize, kind: u32) -> Result<Self> {
                Ok(
                    match kind {
                        keys::CRC_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Crc(
                                CrcPs3::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::GUID_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::GUID(
                                u32Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::COLOR_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Color(
                                u32Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR2_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Vector2(
                                Vector2Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?
                                    .into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR3_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Vector3(
                                Vector3Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?
                                    .into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR4_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Vector4(
                                Vector4Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?
                                    .into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Matrix4x4(
                                Matrix4x4Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?
                                    .into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::FLOAT_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Float(
                                f32Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::INT_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Int(
                                i32Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::BOOL_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::Bool(
                                u32Ps3::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::STRING_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::String({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                let off = val.offset.get() as usize + val.size();
                                core::str::from_utf8(
                                        &data[offset + off..offset + off + val.num.get() as usize],
                                    )?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::StringList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                let vals = ListPs3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("list info")?;
                                vals.iter()
                                    .enumerate()
                                    .map(|(i, v)| {
                                        Ok({
                                            let off = (val.offset.get() + v.offset.get()) as usize
                                                + val.size() * (i + 2);
                                            let s_data = &data[offset
                                                + off..offset + off + v.num.get() as usize];
                                            let s = std::str::from_utf8(s_data)
                                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("string {0}, {1:?}", i, s_data),
                                                    )
                                                }))?;
                                            NonNull::from_ref(s)
                                        })
                                    })
                                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::ObjectList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                U32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::NODELIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::NodeList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                Vector4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::INTLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::IntList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                i32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::CRCLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::CrcList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                U32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::WeightList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                WeightPs3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::MatrixList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                Matrix4x4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.get() as usize + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.get() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        _ => {
                            return Err(
                                ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                        )
                                    }),
                                ),
                            );
                        }
                    },
                )
            }
            pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> BaseTypeRefPs3<'_> {
                match self {
                    BaseTypePs3::Crc(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Crc(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::GUID(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::GUID(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Color(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Color(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Vector2(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Vector2(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Vector3(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Vector3(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Vector4(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Vector4(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Matrix4x4(val) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPs3::Matrix4x4(val.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePs3::Float(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Float(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Int(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Int(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Bool(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Bool(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::String(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::String(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::StringList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPs3::StringList(
                            vals.iter().map(|x| x.as_ref().into()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                    BaseTypePs3::ObjectList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPs3::ObjectList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePs3::NodeList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPs3::NodeList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePs3::IntList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPs3::IntList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::CrcList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPs3::CrcList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::WeightList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPs3::WeightList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePs3::MatrixList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPs3::MatrixList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                }
            }
            pub fn size(kind: u32) -> usize {
                match kind {
                    keys::CRC_KEY => u32Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::GUID_KEY => u32Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::COLOR_KEY => u32Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR2_KEY => Vector2Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR3_KEY => Vector3Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR4_KEY => Vector4Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::FLOAT_KEY => f32Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::INT_KEY => u32Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::BOOL_KEY => u32Ps3::size_of(),
                    keys::STRING_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => ListPs3::size_of(),
                    _ => 0,
                }
            }
        }

        pub mod keys {
            use super::*;
            pub const CRC_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Crc".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const GUID_KEY: u32 = hash_string("GUID".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const COLOR_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Color".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const VECTOR2_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Vector2".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const VECTOR3_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Vector3".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const VECTOR4_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Vector4".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const MATRIX4X4_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Matrix4x4".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const FLOAT_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Float".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const INT_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Int".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const BOOL_KEY: u32 = hash_string("Bool".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const STRING_KEY: u32 = hash_string("String".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const STRINGLIST_KEY: u32 = hash_string("StringList".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const OBJECTLIST_KEY: u32 = hash_string("ObjectList".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const NODELIST_KEY: u32 = hash_string("NodeList".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const INTLIST_KEY: u32 = hash_string("IntList".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const CRCLIST_KEY: u32 = hash_string("CrcList".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const WEIGHTLIST_KEY: u32 = hash_string("WeightList".as_bytes(), None);
            pub const MATRIXLIST_KEY: u32 = hash_string("MatrixList".as_bytes(), None);
        }
        pub enum BaseType {
            Crc(Crc),
            GUID(u32),
            Color(u32),
            Vector2(Vector2),
            Vector3(Vector3),
            Vector4(Vector4),
            Matrix4x4(Matrix4x4),
            Float(f32),
            Int(i32),
            Bool(u32),
            String(String),
            StringList(Vec<String>),
            ObjectList(Vec<u32>),
            NodeList(Vec<Vector4>),
            IntList(Vec<i32>),
            CrcList(Vec<Crc>),
            WeightList(Vec<Weight>),
            MatrixList(Vec<Matrix4x4>),
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for BaseType {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                match self {
                    BaseType::Crc(__self_0) => {
                        ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                            f,
                            "Crc",
                            &__self_0,
                        )
                    }
                    BaseType::GUID(__self_0) => {
                        ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                            f,

                    BaseTypeRefPc::GUID(val) => Self::GUID(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Color(val) => Self::Color(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Vector2(val) => Self::Vector2(val.conv()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Vector3(val) => Self::Vector3(val.conv()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Vector4(val) => Self::Vector4(val.conv()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Matrix4x4(val) => Self::Matrix4x4(val.conv()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Float(val) => Self::Float(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Int(val) => Self::Int(val.get()),

                    BaseTypeRefPc::StringList(vals) => {

                    BaseTypeRefPc::NodeList(vals) => {

                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::CrcList(vals) => {
                        Self::CrcList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::WeightList(vals) => {
                        Self::WeightList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::MatrixList(vals) => {
                        Self::MatrixList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect())
                    }
                }
            }

        pub enum BaseTypeDumpPc<'a> {
            Crc(&'a mut CrcPc),
            GUID(&'a mut u32Pc),
            Color(&'a mut u32Pc),
            Vector2(&'a mut Vector2Pc),
            Vector3(&'a mut Vector3Pc),
            Vector4(&'a mut Vector4Pc),
            Matrix4x4(&'a mut Matrix4x4Pc),
            Float(&'a mut f32Pc),
            Int(&'a mut i32Pc),
            Bool(&'a mut u32Pc),
            String(&'a mut [u8]),
            StringList(Vec<&'a mut [u8]>),
            ObjectList(&'a mut [U32Pc]),
            NodeList(&'a mut [Vector4Pc]),
            IntList(&'a mut [i32Pc]),
            CrcList(&'a mut [U32Pc]),
            WeightList(&'a mut [WeightPc]),
            MatrixList(&'a mut [Matrix4x4Pc]),
        }
        pub enum BaseTypeDumpXbox<'a> {

            Vector3(&'a mut Vector3Xbox),

            Matrix4x4(&'a mut Matrix4x4Xbox),

            NodeList(&'a mut [Vector4Xbox]),

        pub trait DumpBaseTypePc {
            fn off_size(&self) -> usize;
            fn list_len(&self) -> usize;
            fn string_lens(&self) -> Option<impl Iterator<Item = usize>>;
            fn write_into(&self, other: BaseTypeDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                obj_dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                val_dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                kind: u32,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let val = match kind {
                    keys::CRC_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Crc(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::GUID_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::GUID(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::COLOR_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Color(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR2_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector2(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR3_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector3(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR4_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector4(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Matrix4x4(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::FLOAT_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Float(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::INT_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Int(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::BOOL_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Bool(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::STRING_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let vals = u8::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("vals")?;
                        if vals.len() != 0 {
                            val_dst.split(1);
                        }
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::String(vals)
                    }
                    keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let mut offset = val_dst.offset;
                        let vals = ListPc::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("sub lists")?;
                        let mut valss = Vec::with_capacity(vals.len());
                        for (i, (len, val)) in self
                            .string_lens()
                            .unwrap()
                            .zip(vals)
                            .enumerate()
                        {
                            offset += ListPc::size_of();
                            val.offset = (val_dst.offset - offset).conv();
                            val.num = len.conv();
                            let s = u8::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, len)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("val {0}", i))
                                }))?;
                            if s.len() != 0 {
                                val_dst.split(1);
                            }
                            valss.push(s);
                        }
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::StringList(valss)
                    }
                    keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::ObjectList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::NodeList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let vals = i32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("vals")?;
                        val_dst.align(16);
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::IntList(vals)
                    }
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::CrcList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::WeightList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::MatrixList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    _ => {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                };
                self.write_into(val)
            }
        }

                    }
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListXbox::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpXbox::NodeList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListXbox::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let vals = i32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("vals")?;
                        val_dst.align(16);
                        BaseTypeDumpXbox::IntList(vals)
                    }
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListXbox::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpXbox::CrcList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListXbox::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpXbox::WeightList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListXbox::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpXbox::MatrixList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    _ => {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                };
                self.write_into(val)
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpBaseTypePs3 {
            fn off_size(&self) -> usize;
            fn list_len(&self) -> usize;
            fn string_lens(&self) -> Option<impl Iterator<Item = usize>>;
            fn write_into(&self, other: BaseTypeDumpPs3) -> Result<()>;
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                obj_dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                val_dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                kind: u32,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let val = match kind {
                    keys::CRC_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Crc(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::GUID_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::GUID(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::COLOR_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Color(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR2_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Vector2(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR3_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Vector3(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR4_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Vector4(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Matrix4x4(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::FLOAT_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Float(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::INT_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Int(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::BOOL_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::Bool(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::STRING_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let vals = u8::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("vals")?;
                        if vals.len() != 0 {
                            val_dst.split(1);
                        }
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::String(vals)
                    }
                    keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let mut offset = val_dst.offset;
                        let vals = ListPs3::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("sub lists")?;
                        let mut valss = Vec::with_capacity(vals.len());
                        for (i, (len, val)) in self
                            .string_lens()
                            .unwrap()
                            .zip(vals)
                            .enumerate()
                        {
                            offset += ListPs3::size_of();
                            val.offset = (val_dst.offset - offset).conv();
                            val.num = len.conv();
                            let s = u8::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, len)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("val {0}", i))
                                }))?;
                            if s.len() != 0 {
                                val_dst.split(1);
                            }
                            valss.push(s);
                        }
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::StringList(valss)
                    }
                    keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::ObjectList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::NodeList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let vals = i32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("vals")?;
                        val_dst.align(16);
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::IntList(vals)
                    }
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::CrcList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::WeightList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::MatrixList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    _ => {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                };
                self.write_into(val)
            }
        }
        impl DumpBaseTypePc for BaseTypeRefPc<'_> {
            fn string_lens(&self) -> Option<impl Iterator<Item = usize>> {
                match self {
                    Self::StringList(vals) => Some(vals.iter().map(|x| x.len())),
                    _ => None,
                }
            }
            fn list_len(&self) -> usize {
                match self {
                    Self::String(val) => val.len(),
                    Self::StringList(vals) => vals.len(),
                    Self::ObjectList(vals) => vals.len(),
                    Self::NodeList(vals) => vals.len(),
                    Self::IntList(vals) => vals.len(),
                    Self::CrcList(vals) => vals.len(),
                    Self::WeightList(vals) => vals.len(),
                    Self::MatrixList(vals) => vals.len(),
                    _ => 0,
                }
            }
            fn off_size(&self) -> usize {
                match self {
                    Self::String(vals) => {
                        if vals.len() != 0 { vals.len() + 1 } else { 0 }
                    }
                    Self::StringList(vals) => {
                        let mut s = vals.len() * ListPc::size_of();
                        for v in vals {
                            if v.len() != 0 {
                                s += v.len() + 1;
                            }
                        }
                        s
                    }
                    Self::ObjectList(vals) => vals.size(),
                    Self::NodeList(vals) => vals.size(),
                    Self::IntList(vals) => vals.size(),
                    Self::CrcList(vals) => vals.size(),
                    Self::WeightList(vals) => vals.size(),
                    Self::MatrixList(vals) => vals.size(),
                    _ => 0,
                }
            }
            fn write_into(&self, other: BaseTypeDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                match (self, other) {
                    (Self::Crc(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Crc(other)) => other.write_from(val),
                    (Self::GUID(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::GUID(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::Color(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Color(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::Vector2(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector2(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::Vector3(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector3(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::Vector4(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector4(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::Matrix4x4(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Matrix4x4(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::Float(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Float(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::Int(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Int(other)) => other.write_from(val),
                    (Self::Bool(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Bool(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::String(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::String(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val.as_bytes())
                    }
                    (Self::StringList(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::StringList(other)) => {
                        Ok(
                            for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                                other.write_from(val.as_bytes())?;
                            },
                        )
                    }
                    (Self::ObjectList(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::ObjectList(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::NodeList(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::NodeList(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::IntList(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::IntList(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::CrcList(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::CrcList(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::WeightList(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::WeightList(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    (Self::MatrixList(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::MatrixList(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val)
                    }
                    _ => {
                        Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missmatched BaseTypeRef and BaseTypeDump"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

                    }
                    BaseType::ObjectList(vals) => vals.len() * u32Pc::size_of(),
                    BaseType::NodeList(vals) => vals.len() * Vector4Pc::size_of(),
                    BaseType::IntList(vals) => vals.len() * i32Pc::size_of(),
                    BaseType::CrcList(vals) => vals.len() * CrcPc::size_of(),
                    BaseType::WeightList(vals) => vals.len() * WeightPc::size_of(),
                    BaseType::MatrixList(vals) => vals.len() * Matrix4x4Pc::size_of(),
                    _ => 0,

            fn write_into(&self, other: BaseTypeDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                match (self, other) {
                    (BaseType::Crc(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Crc(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::GUID(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::GUID(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Color(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Color(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Vector2(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector2(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Vector3(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector3(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Vector4(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector4(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Matrix4x4(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Matrix4x4(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();

                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Bool(val), BaseTypeDumpPc::Bool(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();

        impl TypePc {
            pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, mut offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                let start = offset;
                let header = TypeHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
                offset += header.size();
                let fields = TypeFieldPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[offset..],
                        header.size.get() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("fields")?;
                offset += fields.size();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    header: header.into(),
                    fields: fields.into(),
                    size: offset - start,
                })
            }
        }

        pub trait DumpTypePc {
            fn key(&self) -> u32;
            fn fields_len(&self) -> usize;
            fn fields(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl TypeFieldDump>;
            fn write_header(&self, header: &mut TypeHeaderPc) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_fields(&self, fields: &mut [TypeFieldPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn get_info(&self) -> (usize, Vec<(u32, u32, u32)>) {
                let mut off = 0;
                let infos = self
                    .fields()
                    .map(|t| {
                        off = off.max(t.offset() as usize + BaseTypePc::size(t.kind()));
                        (t.key(), t.kind(), t.offset())
                    })
                    .collect();
                (off, infos)
            }
            fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                let header = TypeHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                self.write_header(header).context("write header")?;
                let fields = TypeFieldPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.fields_len())
                    .context("fields")?;
                self.write_fields(fields).context("write fields")?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(&self) -> usize {
                TypeHeaderPc::size_of() + self.fields_len() * TypeFieldPc::size_of()
            }
        }

        impl<'a> ObjRefPc<'a> {
            pub fn from_data(
                src: &'a [u8],
                types: &MapImpl<u32, TypeRefPc<'_>>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let mut offset = 0;
                let header = ObjHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
                offset += header.size();
                let ts = types
                    .get(&header.key.get())
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("Missing Key {0:?}", header.key.get()),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    )?
                    .fields;
                let mut fields = MapImpl::with_capacity(ts.len());
                for t in ts.iter() {
                    fields
                        .insert(
                            t.key.into(),
                            BaseTypeRefPc::from_data(
                                    &src[offset + t.offset.get() as usize..],
                                    t.kind.get(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| {
                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!(
                                                "{0}field {1}",
                                                if let Some(BaseTypeRefPc::GUID(o)) = fields
                                                    .get(&hash_string(b"guid", None))
                                                {
                                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("guid {0}, ", o.get()))
                                                    })
                                                } else {
                                                    String::new()
                                                },
                                                get_str_debug(&t.key.get()),
                                            ),
                                        )
                                    })
                                })?,
                        );
                }
                Ok(Self {
                    header: header.into(),
                    fields: fields.into(),
                })
            }
            pub fn size(&self) -> usize {
                self.header.size() + self.header.size.get() as usize
            }
        }

        impl ObjPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                mut offset: usize,
                types: &IndexMap<u32, TypePc>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let header = ObjHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
                offset += header.size();
                let ts = types
                    .get(&header.key.get())
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("Missing Key {0:?}", header.key.get()),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    )?
                    .fields();
                let mut fields = IndexMap::with_capacity(ts.len());
                for t in ts {
                    fields
                        .insert(
                            t.key.into(),
                            BaseTypePc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    offset + t.offset.get() as usize,
                                    t.kind.get(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| {
                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!(
                                                "{0}field {1}",
                                                if let Some(BaseTypePc::GUID(o)) = fields
                                                    .get(&hash_string(b"guid", None))
                                                {
                                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                            format_args!("guid {0}, ", unsafe { o.as_ref() }),
                                                        )
                                                    })
                                                } else {
                                                    String::new()
                                                },
                                                get_str_debug(&t.key.get()),
                                            ),
                                        )
                                    })
                                })?,
                        );
                }
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    header: header.into(),
                    fields,
                    size: header.size() + header.size.get() as usize,
                })
            }
        }

                val_offset: usize,
                fields: &[(u32, u32, u32)],
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = ObjHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                let mut obj_dst = dst.split(val_offset);
                dst.align(16);
                for (f, (key, kind, offset)) in self.fields().zip(fields) {
                    let mut obj_dst = obj_dst.view(*offset as usize);
                    f.dump_into(&mut obj_dst, dst, *kind)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("field {0}", key))
                        }))?;
                }
                dst.align(16);
                header.layer = self.layer().conv();
                header.key = self.key().conv();
                header.size = val_offset.conv();
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(&self, val_offset: usize, fields: &[(u32, u32, u32)]) -> usize {
                let mut off = align_offset(
                    val_offset + std::mem::size_of::<ObjHeaderPc>(),
                    16,
                );
                for (f, (key, _, _)) in self.fields().zip(fields) {
                    off += f.off_size();
                    if *key == keys::INTLIST_KEY {
                        off = align_offset(off, 16);
                    }
                }
                align_offset(off, 16)
            }
        }

                _size: usize,
                gamemodemask: i32,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let start = offset;
                let header = GameObjsHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..])
                    .context("header")?;
                if header.const_.get() != 1296123652 {
                    {

                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                }
                offset = start + header.types_offset.get() as usize;
                let mut types = IndexMap::with_capacity(header.types_num.get() as usize);
                for i in 0..header.types_num.get() {
                    let t = TypePc::from_bytes(src, offset)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("ty {0}", i))
                        }))?;

                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("obj {0}", i))

                                    format_args!("obj missing guid"),

                                error
                            }),

                    } else {

                    offset += t.size();
                    types.insert(t.header().key.get(), t);
                }
                offset = start + header.obj_offset.get() as usize;
                let mut objs = IndexMap::with_capacity(header.obj_num.get() as usize);
                for i in 0..header.obj_num.get() {
                    let o = ObjXbox::from_bytes(src, offset, &types)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("obj {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                    offset += o.size();
                    if let BaseTypeXbox::GUID(guid) = o
                        .fields
                        .get(&hash_string(b"guid", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("obj missing guid"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                    {
                        objs.insert(unsafe { guid.as_ref() }.get(), o);
                    } else {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("obj incorrect guid type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                }
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    gamemodemask,
                    header: header.into(),
                    objs,
                    types,
                })
            }
        }
        impl GameObjsPs3 {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &BufType,
                mut offset: usize,
                _size: usize,
                gamemodemask: i32,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let start = offset;
                let header = GameObjsHeaderPs3::from_data(&src[offset..])
                    .context("header")?;
                if header.const_.get() != 1296123652 {
                    {
                        {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Error;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!("Invalid gameobj block"),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::sub_blocks::gameobjs",
                                        "lotrc::sub_blocks::gameobjs",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                }
                offset = start + header.types_offset.get() as usize;
                let mut types = IndexMap::with_capacity(header.types_num.get() as usize);
                for i in 0..header.types_num.get() {
                    let t = TypePs3::from_bytes(src, offset)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("ty {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                    offset += t.size();
                    types.insert(t.header().key.get(), t);
                }
                offset = start + header.obj_offset.get() as usize;
                let mut objs = IndexMap::with_capacity(header.obj_num.get() as usize);
                for i in 0..header.obj_num.get() {
                    let o = ObjPs3::from_bytes(src, offset, &types)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("obj {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                    offset += o.size();
                    if let BaseTypePs3::GUID(guid) = o
                        .fields
                        .get(&hash_string(b"guid", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("obj missing guid"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                    {
                        objs.insert(unsafe { guid.as_ref() }.get(), o);
                    } else {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("obj incorrect guid type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                }
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    gamemodemask,
                    header: header.into(),
                    objs,
                    types,
                })
            }
        }

        pub type TypeInfos = IndexMap<u32, (usize, Vec<(u32, u32, u32)>)>;
        pub trait DumpGameObjsPc {
            fn gamemodemask(&self) -> i32;
            fn types(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpTypePc>;
            fn types_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn get_type(&self, key: u32) -> Option<impl DumpTypePc>;
            fn objs(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpObjPc>;
            fn objs_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn size(&self) -> (usize, TypeInfos) {
                let mut size = GameObjsHeaderPc::size_of()
                    + self.types_num() * TypeHeaderPc::size_of();
                let mut fields_num = 0;
                let type_infos: TypeInfos = self
                    .types()
                    .map(|x| {
                        fields_num += x.fields_len();
                        (x.key(), x.get_info())
                    })
                    .collect();
                size += fields_num * std::mem::size_of::<TypeFieldPc>();
                size = align_offset(size, 16)
                    + self
                        .objs()
                        .map(|x| {
                            let (off, info) = type_infos.get(&x.key()).unwrap();
                            x.size(*off, info)
                        })
                        .sum::<usize>();
                (size, type_infos)
            }
            fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice, infos: &TypeInfos) -> Result<()> {
                let start = dst.offset;
                let header = GameObjsHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                header.const_ = 1296123652u32.conv();
                header.types_offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                header.types_num = self.types_num().conv();
                for ty in self.types() {
                    ty.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("type {0}", ty.key()))
                        }))?;
                }
                dst.align(16);
                header.obj_offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                header.obj_num = self.objs_num().conv();
                for (i, obj) in self.objs().enumerate() {
                    let key = obj.key();
                    let (off, info) = infos.get(&key).unwrap();
                    obj.dump_into(dst, *off, info)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("obj {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
        }

            const Spray: ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u32 = SubBlockType::Spray as _;
            const PFields: ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u32 = SubBlockType::PFields as _;
            const Level: ::safer_ffi::ඞ::u32 = SubBlockType::Level as _;
            #[allow(non_exhaustive_omitted_patterns)]
            match discriminant {
                Polish
                | German
                | French
                | Spanish
                | Russian
                | Swedish
                | English
                | Italian
                | Norwegian
                | Atlas1
                | Atlas2
                | Crowd
                | Spray
                | PFields
                | Level => true,
                _ => false,
            }
        }
    }
