    impl<'a> SubBlockRefPc<'a> {
        pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], key: u32) -> Result<Self> {
            use keys::*;
            Ok(
                match key {
                    KEY_POLISH
                    | KEY_GERMAN
                    | KEY_FRENCH
                    | KEY_SPANISH
                    | KEY_RUSSIAN
                    | KEY_SWEDISH
                    | KEY_ENGLISH
                    | KEY_ITALIAN
                    | KEY_NORWEGIAN => {
                        Self::LangStrings(LangStringsRefPc::from_data(src)?)
                    }
                    KEY_SPRAY => Self::Spray(SprayRefPc::from_data(src)?),
                    KEY_CROWD => Self::Crowd(CrowdRefPc::from_data(src)?),
                    KEY_PFIELDS => Self::PFields(PFieldsRefPc::from_data(src)),
                    KEY_LEVEL => Self::Level(GameObjsRefPc::from_data(src, -1)?),
                    KEY_ATLAS1 | KEY_ATLAS2 => {
                        Self::AtlasUV(AtlasUVRefPc::from_data(src)?)
                    }
                    _ => {
                        match get_str(&key) {
                            Some(x) if x.ends_with(".lua") => {
                                Self::Lua(LuaRefPc::from_data(src))
                            }
                            Some(x) if x.ends_with(".ssa") => {
                                Self::SSA(SSARefPc::from_data(src)?)
                            }
                            Some(
                                x,
                            ) if x.ends_with(".csv") || x.ends_with(".txt")
                                || x.ends_with(".dat") => {
                                Self::Data(DataRefPc::from_data(src))
                            }
                            name => {
                                {
                                    {
                                        let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                        if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                            && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                        {
                                            ::log::__private_api::log(
                                                { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                                format_args!("Unknown block type {0:?}, {1:?}", key, name),
                                                lvl,
                                                &(
                                                    "lotrc::sub_blocks",
                                                    "lotrc::sub_blocks",
                                                    ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                                ),
                                                (),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                };
                                Self::Data(DataRefPc::from_data(src))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
            )
        }
    }

    impl SubBlockPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(
            src: &BufType,
            offset: usize,
            size: usize,
            key: u32,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            use keys::*;
            Ok(
                match key {
                    KEY_POLISH
                    | KEY_GERMAN
                    | KEY_FRENCH
                    | KEY_SPANISH
                    | KEY_RUSSIAN
                    | KEY_SWEDISH
                    | KEY_ENGLISH
                    | KEY_ITALIAN
                    | KEY_NORWEGIAN => {
                        Self::LangStrings(LangStringsPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                    }
                    KEY_SPRAY => Self::Spray(SprayPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?),
                    KEY_CROWD => Self::Crowd(CrowdPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?),
                    KEY_PFIELDS => {
                        Self::PFields(PFieldsPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                    }
                    KEY_LEVEL => {
                        Self::Level(GameObjsPc::from_bytes(&src, offset, size, -1)?)
                    }
                    KEY_ATLAS1 | KEY_ATLAS2 => {
                        Self::AtlasUV(AtlasUVPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                    }
                    _ => {
                        match get_str(&key) {
                            Some(x) if x.ends_with(".lua") => {
                                Self::Lua(LuaPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                            Some(x) if x.ends_with(".ssa") => {
                                Self::SSA(SSAPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                            Some(
                                x,
                            ) if x.ends_with(".csv") || x.ends_with(".txt")
                                || x.ends_with(".dat") => {
                                Self::Data(DataPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                            name => {
                                {
                                    {
                                        let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                        if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                            && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                        {
                                            ::log::__private_api::log(
                                                { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                                format_args!("Unknown block type {0:?}, {1:?}", key, name),
                                                lvl,
                                                &(
                                                    "lotrc::sub_blocks",
                                                    "lotrc::sub_blocks",
                                                    ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                                ),
                                                (),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                };
                                Self::Data(DataPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
            )
        }
    }

    impl SubBlock {
        fn from_pc(val: &SubBlockPc, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoPc]) -> Self {
            match val {
                SubBlockPc::LangStrings(val) => Self::LangStrings(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Data(val) => Self::Data(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Spray(val) => Self::Spray(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Crowd(val) => Self::Crowd(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::PFields(val) => {
                    Self::PFields(PFields::from_pc(val, pfield_infos))
                }
                SubBlockPc::Level(val) => Self::Level(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::AtlasUV(val) => Self::AtlasUV(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Lua(val) => Self::Lua(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::SSA(val) => Self::SSA(val.into()),
            }
        }
    }

            match self {
                Self::LangStrings(val) => DumpLangStringsPc::size(val),
                Self::Data(val) => val.size(),
                Self::Spray(val) => DumpSprayPc::size(val),
                Self::PFields(val) => val.size(),
                Self::Crowd(val) => DumpCrowdPc::size(val),
                Self::Level(val) => {
                    let (size, infos) = DumpGameObjsPc::size(val);
                    type_infos.replace(infos);
                    size
                }
                Self::AtlasUV(val) => DumpAtlasUVPc::size(val),
                Self::Lua(val) => val.size(),
                Self::SSA(val) => DumpSSAPc::size(val),
            }
        }

            match self {
                Self::LangStrings(val) => DumpLangStringsPc::dump_into(val, dst),
                Self::Data(val) => val.dump_into(dst),
                Self::Spray(val) => DumpSprayPc::dump_into(val, dst),
                Self::PFields(val) => val.dump_into(dst),
                Self::Crowd(val) => DumpCrowdPc::dump_into(val, dst),
                Self::Level(val) => DumpGameObjsPc::dump_into(val, dst, type_infos),
                Self::AtlasUV(val) => DumpAtlasUVPc::dump_into(val, dst),
                Self::Lua(val) => val.dump_into(dst),
                Self::SSA(val) => DumpSSAPc::dump_into(val, dst),

    impl<'a> SubBlocksRefPc<'a> {
        pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self> {
            let mut offset = 0;
            let header = SubBlocksHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
            offset += header.size();
            let block_headers = SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    header.block_num.get() as usize,
                )
                .context("block_headers")?;
            let mut blocks = MapImpl::<
                u32,
                SubBlockRefPc,
            >::with_capacity(block_headers.len());
            for info in block_headers {
                blocks
                    .insert(
                        info.key.get(),
                        SubBlockRefPc::from_data(
                                &src[info.offset.get()
                                    as usize..(info.offset.get() + info.size.get()) as usize],
                                info.key.get(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| {
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "sub_blocks {0}",
                                            get_str(&info.key.get())
                                                .map(|x| x.to_string())
                                                .unwrap_or_else(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("id: {0}", info.key.get()),
                                                    )
                                                })),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                })
                            })?,
                    );
            }
            Ok(Self {
                header: header,
                block_headers: block_headers.into(),
                blocks: blocks.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    impl SubBlocksPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, mut offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let start = offset;
            let header = SubBlocksHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
            offset += header.size();
            let block_headers = SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    header.block_num.get() as usize,
                )
                .context("block_headers")?;
            let blocks: IndexMap<u32, SubBlockPc> = block_headers
                .into_iter()
                .map(|info| {
                    Ok((
                        info.key.get(),
                        SubBlockPc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                start + info.offset.get() as usize,
                                info.size.get() as usize,
                                info.key.get(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| {
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "sub_blocks {0}",
                                            get_str(&info.key.get())
                                                .map(|x| x.to_string())
                                                .unwrap_or_else(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("id: {0}", info.key.get()),
                                                    )
                                                })),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                })
                            })?,
                    ))
                })
                .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                header: header.into(),
                block_headers: block_headers.into(),
                blocks: blocks.into(),
            })
        }
        pub fn get(&self, key: &u32) -> Option<&SubBlockPc> {
            self.blocks.get(key)
        }
        pub fn get_full(
            &self,
            key: &u32,
        ) -> Option<(&SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc, &SubBlockPc)> {
            self.blocks
                .get_full(key)
                .map(|(i, _, val)| {
                    let info = &self.block_headers()[i];
                    (info, val)
                })
        }
    }

    }
    impl SubBlocksPs3 {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, mut offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let start = offset;
            let header = SubBlocksHeaderPs3::from_data(&src[offset..])
                .context("header")?;
            offset += header.size();
            let block_headers = SubBlocksBlockHeaderPs3::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    header.block_num.get() as usize,
                )
                .context("block_headers")?;
            let blocks: IndexMap<u32, SubBlockPs3> = block_headers
                .into_iter()
                .map(|info| {
                    Ok((
                        info.key.get(),
                        SubBlockPs3::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                start + info.offset.get() as usize,
                                info.size.get() as usize,
                                info.key.get(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| {
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "sub_blocks {0}",
                                            get_str(&info.key.get())
                                                .map(|x| x.to_string())
                                                .unwrap_or_else(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("id: {0}", info.key.get()),
                                                    )
                                                })),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                })
                            })?,
                    ))
                })
                .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                header: header.into(),
                block_headers: block_headers.into(),
                blocks: blocks.into(),
            })
        }
        pub fn get(&self, key: &u32) -> Option<&SubBlockPs3> {
            self.blocks.get(key)
        }
        pub fn get_full(
            &self,
            key: &u32,
        ) -> Option<(&SubBlocksBlockHeaderPs3, &SubBlockPs3)> {
            self.blocks
                .get_full(key)
                .map(|(i, _, val)| {
                    let info = &self.block_headers()[i];
                    (info, val)
                })
        }
    }
    impl SubBlocksPc {
        pub fn header(&self) -> &SubBlocksHeaderPc {
            unsafe { self.header.as_ref() }
        }
        pub fn block_headers(&self) -> &[SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc] {
            unsafe { self.block_headers.as_ref() }
        }
    }
    impl SubBlocksXbox {
        pub fn header(&self) -> &SubBlocksHeaderXbox {

            unsafe { self.block_headers.as_ref() }

    pub struct SubBlocks {
        pub blocks: IndexMap<Crc, SubBlock>,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for SubBlocks {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field1_finish(
                f,
                "SubBlocks",
                "blocks",
                &&self.blocks,
            )
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for SubBlocks {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> SubBlocks {
            SubBlocks {
                blocks: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.blocks),
            }
        }
    }
    impl SubBlocks {
        pub fn from_pc(val: &SubBlocksPc, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoPc]) -> Self {
            Self {
                blocks: val
                    .blocks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(k, block)| (
                        (*k).into(),
                        SubBlock::from_pc(block, pfield_infos),
                    ))
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
        pub fn from_xbox(val: &SubBlocksXbox, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoXbox]) -> Self {
            Self {
                blocks: val
                    .blocks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(k, block)| (
                        (*k).into(),
                        SubBlock::from_xbox(block, pfield_infos),
                    ))
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
        pub fn from_ps3(val: &SubBlocksPs3, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoPs3]) -> Self {
            Self {
                blocks: val
                    .blocks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(k, block)| (
                        (*k).into(),
                        SubBlock::from_ps3(block, pfield_infos),
                    ))
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpSubBlocksPc {
        fn blocks_num(&self) -> usize;
        fn blocks(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpSubBlockPc>;
        fn write_names<'a>(&self, names: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPc>);
        fn level_name(&self) -> Result<u32>;
        fn size(&self, type_infos: &mut Option<TypeInfos>) -> usize {
            let mut size = SubBlocksHeaderPc::size_of()
                + SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc::size_of() * self.blocks_num();
            size = align_offset(size, 16);
            for block in self.blocks() {
                size = align_offset(size + block.size(type_infos), 16);
            }
            size
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice, type_infos: &TypeInfos) -> Result<()> {
            let start = dst.offset;
            let header = SubBlocksHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            let block_headers = SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                    dst,
                    self.blocks_num(),
                )
                .context("block_headers")?;
            header.block_num = block_headers.len().conv();
            dst.align(16);
            self.write_names(block_headers.iter_mut().map(|x| &mut x.key));
            for (i, (block, info)) in self.blocks().zip(block_headers).enumerate() {
                info.offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                let start = dst.offset;
                block
                    .dump_into(dst, type_infos)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                    }))?;
                info.size = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                dst.align(16);
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    impl DumpSubBlocksPc for SubBlocksRefPc<'_> {
        fn blocks_num(&self) -> usize {
            self.blocks.len()
        }
        fn blocks(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpSubBlockPc> {
            self.blocks.values()
        }
        fn write_names<'a>(&self, names: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPc>) {
            for (src, dst) in self.blocks.keys().zip(names) {
                *dst = src.conv();
            }
        }
        fn level_name(&self) -> Result<u32> {
            let level = self
                .blocks
                .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                .ok_or(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("level block missing"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )
                .and_then(|x| match x {
                    SubBlockRefPc::Level(val) => Ok(val),
                    _ => {
                        Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("level block wrong format"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )
                    }
                })?;
            let field = level
                .objs
                .values()
                .find(|v| v.header.key.get() == hash_string(b"templateLevel", None))
                .ok_or(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("templateLevel not found"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )?
                .fields
                .get(&hash_string(b"name", None))
                .ok_or(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("templateLevel missing name field"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )?;
            let name = field
                .crc()
                .ok_or(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("templateObject name field is not a crc"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )?
                .get();
            Ok(name)
        }
    }

    impl DumpStringPc for &String {
        fn string_size(&self) -> usize {
            self.encode_utf16().count() * u16Pc::size_of()
        }
        fn dump_string(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let val = self.encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            let string = u16Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, val.len()).context("string")?;
            for (src, dst) in val.into_iter().zip(string) {
                *dst = src.into();
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

        fn strings(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpStringPc>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            self.strings().map(|x| x.string_size() + u16Pc::size_of()).sum::<usize>()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, string) in self.strings().enumerate() {
                string
                    .dump_string(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string {0}", i))
                    }))?;
                u16Pc::from(0u16)
                    .dump_into(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string pad {0}", i))
                    }))?;

            Ok(())
        }

    impl<'a> SSARefPc<'a> {
        pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self> {
            let mut offset = 0;
            let n = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("n")?;
            let vals = SSAValPc::slice_from_data(&src[offset + 4..], n.get() as usize)
                .context("vals")?;
            let strings = (0..n.get() as usize)
                .map(|i| {
                    let start = vals[i].off.get() as usize + offset;
                    let end = if i == n.get() as usize - 1 {
                        src.len()
                    } else {
                        vals[i + 1].off.get() as usize
                    } + offset;
                    Ok(
                        u16Pc::slice_from_data(&src[start..], (end - start) / 2)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string {0}", i))
                            }))?
                            .into(),
                    )
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                .into_boxed_slice();
            Ok(Self {
                vals: vals.into(),
                strings: strings.into(),
            })
        }
    }

            let n = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("n")?;
            let vals = SSAValPc::slice_from_data(&src[offset + 4..], n.get() as usize)
                .context("vals")?;

                .map(|i| {

                    let end = if i == n.get() as usize - 1 {
                        size
                    } else {
                        vals[i + 1].off.get() as usize
                    } + offset;
                    Ok(
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            u16Pc::slice_from_data(&src[start..], (end - start) / 2)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                vals: vals.into(),
                strings: strings.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    impl From<&SSAPc> for SSA {
        fn from(val: &SSAPc) -> Self {
            Self {
                vals: val.vals().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                strings: val
                    .strings
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| {
                        String::from_utf16(
                                unsafe { x.as_ref() }
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|y| y.conv())
                                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                                    .as_ref(),
                            )
                            .unwrap()
                    })
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpSSAPc {
        fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn strings(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpStringPc>;
        fn write_vals(&self, vals: &mut [SSAValPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            u32Pc::size_of() + SSAValPc::size_of() * self.vals_len()
                + self.strings().map(|x| x.string_size()).sum::<usize>()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let start = dst.offset;
            let n = u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("n")?;
            let vals = SSAValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_len())
                .context("vals")?;
            *n = vals.len().conv();
            self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
            for (i, (string, val)) in self.strings().zip(vals).enumerate() {
                val.off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                string
                    .dump_string(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string {0}", i))
                    }))?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpSprayPc {
        fn instances_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn write_instances(&self, instances: &mut [SprayInstancePc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn write_vals(&self, vals: &mut [SprayValPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            u32Pc::size_of() * 2 + SprayInstancePc::size_of() * self.instances_len()
                + SprayValPc::size_of() * self.vals_len()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let n = u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("n1")?;
            let instances = SprayInstancePc::mut_slice_from_data(
                    dst,
                    self.instances_len(),
                )
                .context("instances")?;
            *n = instances.len().conv();
            self.write_instances(instances).context("write instances")?;
            let n = u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("n1")?;
            let vals = SprayValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_len())
                .context("vals")?;
            *n = vals.len().conv();
            self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpCrowdItemPc {
        fn animations_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn instances_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn write_header(&self, header: &mut CrowdItemHeaderPc) -> Result<()>;
        fn write_animations(&self, animations: &mut [CrcPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn write_instances(&self, instances: &mut [CrowdValPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            CrowdItemHeaderPc::size_of() + CrcPc::size_of() * self.animations_len()
                + CrowdValPc::size_of() * self.instances_len()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let header = CrowdItemHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            self.write_header(header).context("write header")?;
            header.animation_num = self.animations_len().conv();
            header.instance_num = self.instances_len().conv();
            let animations = CrcPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.animations_len())
                .context("animations")?;
            self.write_animations(animations).context("write animations")?;
            let instances = CrowdValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.instances_len())
                .context("instances")?;
            self.write_instances(instances).context("write instances")?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    impl<'a> CrowdRefPc<'a> {
        pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self> {
            let header = CrowdHeaderPc::from_data(src).context("header")?;
            if header.const0x65.get() != 0x65 {
                return Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("Invalid Block Data for Crowd Block"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                );
            }
            let offs = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[header.size()..],
                    header.n.get() as usize,
                )
                .context("offs")?;
            let vals = offs
                .into_iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(i, off)| {
                    CrowdItemRefPc::from_data(&src[off.get() as usize..])
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("item {0}", i))
                        }))
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                .into_boxed_slice();
            Ok(Self {
                header,
                offs: offs.into(),
                vals: vals.into(),
            })
        }
    }

                .into_boxed_slice();
            Ok(Self {
                header,
                offs: offs.into(),
                vals: vals.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    impl CrowdPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, offset: usize, _size: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let header = CrowdHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
            if header.const0x65.get() != 0x65 {
                return Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("Invalid Block Data for Crowd Block"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                );
            }
            let offs = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset + header.size()..],
                    header.n.get() as usize,
                )
                .context("offs")?;
            let vals = offs
                .into_iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(i, off)| {
                    CrowdItemPc::from_bytes(src, off.get() as usize + offset)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("item {0}", i))
                        }))
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                header: header.into(),
                offs: offs.into(),
                vals: vals.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpCrowdPc {
        fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn vals(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpCrowdItemPc>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            CrowdHeaderPc::size_of() + u32Pc::size_of() * self.vals_len()
                + self.vals().map(|x| x.size()).sum::<usize>()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let start = dst.offset;
            let header = CrowdHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            let offs = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_len()).context("offs")?;
            header.n = offs.len().conv();
            header.const0x65 = 0x65u32.into();
            for (i, (val, off)) in self.vals().zip(offs).enumerate() {
                *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                val.dump_into(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("val {0}", i))
                    }))?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

        }
    }
    impl From<&DataPc> for Data {
        fn from(val: &DataPc) -> Self {
            Self { data: val.data().to_vec() }
        }
    }
    impl From<&DataXbox> for Data {
        fn from(val: &DataXbox) -> Self {
            Self { data: val.data().to_vec() }
        }
    }
    impl From<&DataPs3> for Data {
        fn from(val: &DataPs3) -> Self {
            Self { data: val.data().to_vec() }
        }
    }
    type Lua = Data;
    pub struct PField {
        pub link_guid: u32,
        pub vals: Vec<(HashSet<u32>, Vec<u8>)>,
        pub width: u32,
        pub height: u32,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for PField {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field4_finish(
                f,
                "PField",
                "link_guid",
                &self.link_guid,
                "vals",
                &self.vals,
                "width",
                &self.width,
                "height",
                &&self.height,
            )
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::default::Default for PField {
        #[inline]
        fn default() -> PField {
            PField {
                link_guid: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                vals: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                width: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                height: ::core::default::Default::default(),
            }
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for PField {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> PField {
            PField {
                link_guid: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.link_guid),
                vals: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals),
                width: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.width),
                height: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.height),
            }
        }
    }
    pub struct PFields {
        pub vals: IndexMap<u32, PField>,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for PFields {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field1_finish(
                f,
                "PFields",
                "vals",
                &&self.vals,
            )
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::default::Default for PFields {
        #[inline]
        fn default() -> PFields {
            PFields {
                vals: ::core::default::Default::default(),
            }
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for PFields {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> PFields {
            PFields {
                vals: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals),
            }
        }
    }
    impl PFields {
        pub fn from_pc(val: &PFieldsPc, infos: &[PFieldInfoPc]) -> Self {
            let mut offset_maps: HashMap<u32, HashMap<u32, usize>> = HashMap::new();
            let mut pfields = IndexMap::new();
            let data = val.data();
            for info in infos {
                let link_guid = info.link_guid.get();
                let offset = info.offset.get();
                let gamemode_guid = info.gamemode_guid.get();
                let width = info.width.get();
                let height = info.height.get();
                if !pfields.contains_key(&link_guid) {
                    pfields
                        .insert(
                            link_guid,
                            PField {
                                link_guid,
                                width,
                                height,
                                ..Default::default()
                            },
                        );
                    offset_maps.insert(link_guid, HashMap::new());
                }
                let val = pfields.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                let offset_map = offset_maps.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                if let Some(&index) = offset_map.get(&offset) {
                    val.vals[index].0.insert(gamemode_guid);
                } else {
                    offset_map.insert(offset, val.vals.len());
                    let mut gamemodes = HashSet::new();
                    gamemodes.insert(gamemode_guid);
                    let offset = offset as usize;
                    let size = (width * height) as usize;
                    let vals = data[offset..offset + size].to_vec();
                    val.vals.push((gamemodes, vals));
                }
            }
            Self { vals: pfields }
        }
        pub fn from_xbox(val: &PFieldsXbox, infos: &[PFieldInfoXbox]) -> Self {
            let mut offset_maps: HashMap<u32, HashMap<u32, usize>> = HashMap::new();
            let mut pfields = IndexMap::new();
            let data = val.data();
            for info in infos {
                let link_guid = info.link_guid.get();
                let offset = info.offset.get();
                let gamemode_guid = info.gamemode_guid.get();
                let width = info.width.get();
                let height = info.height.get();
                if !pfields.contains_key(&link_guid) {
                    pfields
                        .insert(
                            link_guid,
                            PField {
                                link_guid,
                                width,
                                height,
                                ..Default::default()
                            },
                        );
                    offset_maps.insert(link_guid, HashMap::new());
                }
                let val = pfields.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                let offset_map = offset_maps.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                if let Some(&index) = offset_map.get(&offset) {
                    val.vals[index].0.insert(gamemode_guid);
                } else {
                    offset_map.insert(offset, val.vals.len());
                    let mut gamemodes = HashSet::new();
                    gamemodes.insert(gamemode_guid);
                    let offset = offset as usize;
                    let size = (width * height) as usize;
                    let vals = data[offset..offset + size].to_vec();
                    val.vals.push((gamemodes, vals));
                }
            }
            Self { vals: pfields }
        }
        pub fn from_ps3(val: &PFieldsPs3, infos: &[PFieldInfoPs3]) -> Self {
            let mut offset_maps: HashMap<u32, HashMap<u32, usize>> = HashMap::new();
            let mut pfields = IndexMap::new();
            let data = val.data();
            for info in infos {
                let link_guid = info.link_guid.get();
                let offset = info.offset.get();
                let gamemode_guid = info.gamemode_guid.get();

                        .insert(
                            link_guid,

                                height,

                }

                let offset_map = offset_maps.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();

                    val.vals[index].0.insert(gamemode_guid);
                } else {
                    offset_map.insert(offset, val.vals.len());
                    let mut gamemodes = HashSet::new();
                    gamemodes.insert(gamemode_guid);
                    let offset = offset as usize;
                    let size = (width * height) as usize;
                    let vals = data[offset..offset + size].to_vec();
                    val.vals.push((gamemodes, vals));
                }
            }
            Self { vals: pfields }
        }
        pub fn infos_pc(&self) -> Vec<PFieldInfoPc> {
            let mut infos = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut offset = 0u32;
            for pfield in self.vals.values() {
                for (gamemodes, _) in &pfield.vals {
                    for &gamemode_guid in gamemodes {
                        infos
                            .push(PFieldInfoPc {
                                link_guid: pfield.link_guid.into(),
                                width: pfield.width.into(),
                                height: pfield.height.into(),
                                gamemode_guid: gamemode_guid.into(),
                                offset: offset.into(),
                            });
                    }
                    offset += pfield.width * pfield.height;
                }
            }
            infos
        }
        pub fn infos_xbox(&self) -> Vec<PFieldInfoXbox> {
            let mut infos = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut offset = 0u32;
            for pfield in self.vals.values() {
                for (gamemodes, _) in &pfield.vals {
                    for &gamemode_guid in gamemodes {
                        infos
                            .push(PFieldInfoXbox {
                                link_guid: pfield.link_guid.into(),
                                width: pfield.width.into(),
                                height: pfield.height.into(),
                                gamemode_guid: gamemode_guid.into(),
                                offset: offset.into(),
                            });
                    }
                    offset += pfield.width * pfield.height;
                }
            }
            infos
        }
        pub fn infos_ps3(&self) -> Vec<PFieldInfoPs3> {
            let mut infos = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut offset = 0u32;
            for pfield in self.vals.values() {
                for (gamemodes, _) in &pfield.vals {
                    for &gamemode_guid in gamemodes {
                        infos
                            .push(PFieldInfoPs3 {
                                link_guid: pfield.link_guid.into(),
                                width: pfield.width.into(),
                                height: pfield.height.into(),
                                gamemode_guid: gamemode_guid.into(),
                                offset: offset.into(),
                            });
                    }
                    offset += pfield.width * pfield.height;
                }
            }
            infos
        }
        pub fn size_pc(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals
                .values()
                .flat_map(|x| x.vals.iter())
                .map(|(_, vals)| vals.size())
                .sum::<usize>()
        }
        pub fn size_xbox(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals
                .values()
                .flat_map(|x| x.vals.iter())
                .map(|(_, vals)| vals.size())
                .sum::<usize>()
        }
        pub fn size_ps3(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals
                .values()
                .flat_map(|x| x.vals.iter())
                .map(|(_, vals)| vals.size())
                .sum::<usize>()
        }
        pub fn dump_into_pc(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, pfield) in self.vals.values().enumerate() {
                for (j, (_, vals)) in pfield.vals.iter().enumerate() {
                    vals.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("pfield {0} val {1}", i, j),
                            )
                        }))?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn dump_into_xbox(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, pfield) in self.vals.values().enumerate() {
                for (j, (_, vals)) in pfield.vals.iter().enumerate() {
                    vals.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("pfield {0} val {1}", i, j),
                            )
                        }))?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn dump_into_ps3(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, pfield) in self.vals.values().enumerate() {
                for (j, (_, vals)) in pfield.vals.iter().enumerate() {
                    vals.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("pfield {0} val {1}", i, j),
                            )
                        }))?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

    pub struct DumpSlice<'a> {
        pub vals: &'a mut [u8],
        pub offset: usize,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl<'a> ::core::default::Default for DumpSlice<'a> {
        #[inline]
        fn default() -> DumpSlice<'a> {
            DumpSlice {
                vals: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                offset: ::core::default::Default::default(),
            }
        }
    }
    impl<'a, T: AsMut<[u8]>> From<&'a mut T> for DumpSlice<'a> {
        fn from(val: &'a mut T) -> Self {
            Self {
                vals: val.as_mut(),
                offset: 0,
            }
        }
    }
    impl<'a> From<&'a mut [u8]> for DumpSlice<'a> {
        fn from(vals: &'a mut [u8]) -> Self {
            Self { vals, offset: 0 }
        }
    }
    impl<'a> DumpSlice<'a> {
        pub fn view<'b>(&'b mut self, off: usize) -> DumpSlice<'b> {
            DumpSlice {
                vals: &mut self.vals[off..],
                offset: self.offset + off,
            }
        }
        pub fn split(&mut self, off: usize) -> Self {
            let Self { vals, mut offset } = std::mem::take(self);
            let (vals, rem) = vals.split_at_mut(off);
            let res = Self { vals, offset };
            offset += off;
            *self = Self { vals: rem, offset };
            res
        }
        pub fn align(&mut self, size: usize) {
            let new_off = align_offset(self.offset, size);
            self.split(new_off - self.offset);
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpData {
        fn write_from(&mut self, val: &Self) -> Result<()>;
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()>;
        fn dump(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let mut data = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, self.size());
            let mut slice = (&mut data).into();
            self.dump_into(&mut slice)?;
            Ok(data)
        }
        fn size(&self) -> usize;
    }
    impl<T: Sized + KnownLayout + Immutable + IntoBytes + FromBytes> DumpData for T {
        fn write_from(&mut self, val: &Self) -> Result<()> {
            val.write_to(self.as_mut_bytes())
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))
        }
        fn dump_into<'a>(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            self.write_to_prefix(dst.vals)
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))?;
            dst.split(std::mem::size_of::<T>());
            Ok(())
        }
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            std::mem::size_of::<T>()
        }
    }

    pub fn align_offset(offset: usize, size: usize) -> usize {
        (offset + (size - 1)) & (0xFFFFFFFF - (size - 1))
    }
    pub trait RefFromData
    where
        Self: Sized + KnownLayout + Immutable + FromBytes + IntoBytes + 'static,
    {
        fn from_data(data: &[u8]) -> Result<&Self> {
            Ok(
                FromBytes::ref_from_prefix(data)
                    .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                        let error = match e.to_string() {
                            error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                        };
                        error
                    }))?
                    .0,
            )
        }
        fn slice_from_data(data: &[u8], count: usize) -> Result<&[Self]> {
            Ok(
                FromBytes::ref_from_prefix_with_elems(data, count)
                    .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                        let error = match e.to_string() {
                            error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                        };
                        error
                    }))?
                    .0,
            )
        }
        fn size_of() -> usize {
            std::mem::size_of::<Self>()
        }
        fn mut_from_data<'a>(src: &mut DumpSlice<'a>) -> Result<&'a mut Self> {
            let val = FromBytes::mut_from_bytes(
                    src.split(std::mem::size_of::<Self>()).vals,
                )
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))?;
            Ok(val)
        }
        fn mut_slice_from_data<'a>(
            src: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
            count: usize,
        ) -> Result<&'a mut [Self]> {
            let val = FromBytes::mut_from_bytes_with_elems(
                    src.split(std::mem::size_of::<Self>() * count).vals,
                    count,
                )
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))?;
            Ok(val)
        }
    }

        fn try_from(val: &[f32]) -> Result<Self> {

                Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("need 4 values"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )
            } else {
                Ok(Self {
                    x: val[0],
                    y: val[1],
                    z: val[2],
                    w: val[3],
                })
            }
        }
    }

    impl TryFrom<&[u32]> for Weight {
        type Error = anyhow::Error;
        fn try_from(val: &[u32]) -> Result<Self> {
            if val.len() != 5 {
                Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("need 16 values"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )
            } else if val[1] > 255 || val[2] > 255 || val[3] > 255 || val[4] > 255 {
                Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("values 1-5 must be < 255"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )
            } else {
                Ok(Weight {
                    x: val[0],
                    a: val[1] as u8,
                    b: val[2] as u8,
                    c: val[3] as u8,
                    d: val[4] as u8,
                })
            }
        }
    }

    impl ::lazy_static::__Deref for CRC_VALS {
        type Target = Mutex<HashMap<u32, String>>;
        fn deref(&self) -> &Mutex<HashMap<u32, String>> {
            #[inline(always)]
            fn __static_ref_initialize() -> Mutex<HashMap<u32, String>> {
                { Mutex::new(HashMap::new()) }
            }
            #[inline(always)]
            fn __stability() -> &'static Mutex<HashMap<u32, String>> {
                static LAZY: ::lazy_static::lazy::Lazy<Mutex<HashMap<u32, String>>> = ::lazy_static::lazy::Lazy::INIT;
                LAZY.get(__static_ref_initialize)
            }

        }

        }

    pub fn update_crc<T>(vals: impl IntoIterator<Item = T>)
    where
        String: From<T>,
        T: Sized + AsRef<[u8]>,
    {
        let mut strings = CRC_VALS.lock();
        for string in vals {
            let k = hash_string(string.as_ref(), None);
            if strings.contains_key(&k) {
                continue;
            }
            strings.insert(k, String::from(string));
        }
    }
    pub fn get_str<'a>(val: &u32) -> Option<MappedMutexGuard<'a, str>> {
        MutexGuard::try_map(CRC_VALS.lock(), |x| x.get_mut(val).map(|x| x.as_mut_str()))
            .ok()
    }
    pub fn get_str_debug(val: &u32) -> String {
        CRC_VALS
            .lock()
            .get(val)
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("unknown string {0}", val))
            }))
    }
    pub fn decompress_block(
        data: &[u8],
        size_comp: usize,
        size: usize,
    ) -> Result<BufType> {
        let mut res = aligned_buffer::UniqueAlignedBuffer::<
            BUF_ALIGN,
        >::with_capacity(size);
        unsafe { res.set_len(size) }
        match size_comp {
            0 => res.copy_from_slice(&data[..size]),
            _ => {
                let mut off = 0;
                let mut reader = flate2::read::ZlibDecoder::new(&data[..size_comp]);
                while off < size {
                    off += reader.read(&mut res[off..])?;
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(res.into())
    }
    pub fn decompress_block_into(
        src: &[u8],
        dst: &mut [u8],
        size_comp: usize,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        match size_comp {
            0 => dst.copy_from_slice(&src[..dst.len()]),
            _ => {
                let mut off = 0;
                let mut reader = flate2::read::ZlibDecoder::new(src);
                while off < dst.len() {
                    off += reader.read(&mut dst[off..])?;
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub const fn hash_string(string: &[u8], mask: Option<u32>) -> u32 {
        let mut h = !match mask {
            Some(val) => val,
            None => 0,
        };
        let mut i: usize = 0;
        loop {
            if i >= string.len() {
                break;
            }
            h = (h << 8)
                ^ HASHING_ARRAY[LOWERCASE_BYTES[string[i] as usize]
                    ^ (h >> 24) as usize];
            i += 1;
        }
        !h
    }

        fn strings(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str>;
        fn num_strings(&self) -> usize;
        fn dump_into<'a>(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for val in self.strings() {
                let k = U32Pc::mut_from_data(dst)?;
                *k = (val.len() as u32).into();
                val.as_bytes().dump_into(dst)?;
            }

        }
    }

                vals: vals.into(),
                pad: pad.into(),
            })
        }
    }
    impl StringKeysPs3 {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &BufType, mut offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let header = StringKeysHeaderPs3::from_data(&src[offset..])
                .context("header")?;
            if !(header.num_a.get() == header.num_b.get()) {
                {
                    ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(format_args!("Seems to be true"));
                }
            }
            offset += header.size();
            let vals = StringKeysValPs3::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    header.num_a.get() as usize,
                )
                .context("vals")?;
            offset += vals.size();
            let pad = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(&src[offset..], vals.len())
                .context("pad")?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                header: header.into(),
                vals: vals.into(),
                pad: pad.into(),
            })
        }
    }
    impl StringKeysPc {
        pub fn header(&self) -> &StringKeysHeaderPc {

        pub fn vals(&self) -> &[StringKeysValPc] {

        }
        pub fn pad(&self) -> &[u32Pc] {

        }
    }

    pub trait DumpStringKeysPc {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPc>);
        fn num(&self) -> usize;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            StringKeysHeaderPc::size_of()
                + self.num() * (u32Pc::size_of() + StringKeysValPc::size_of())
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let num = self.num();
            let header = StringKeysHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            let vals = StringKeysValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, num).context("vals")?;
            let mut off = dst.offset;
            u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, num).context("pad")?;
            header.num_a = num.conv();
            header.num_b = num.conv();
            self.write_keys(vals.iter_mut().map(|x| &mut x.key));
            for val in vals {
                val.offset = off.conv();
                off += size_of::<u32Pc>();
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    pub struct CompressedBlock {
        pub data: AlignedBuf,
        pub compressed: Vec<u8>,
    }
    impl CompressedBlock {
        pub fn with_capacity(size: usize) -> Self {
            Self {
                data: AlignedBuf::with_capacity(size),
                compressed: ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
            }
        }
        pub fn dump_slice(&mut self) -> DumpSlice<'_> {
            (&mut self.data[..]).into()
        }
        pub fn compress(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    struct CompressedDataImpl {
        _ptr: BufType,
        data: NonNull<[u8]>,
        size: usize,
        size_comp: usize,
        data_decomp: std::sync::OnceLock<BufType>,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for CompressedDataImpl {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field5_finish(
                f,
                "CompressedDataImpl",
                "_ptr",
                &self._ptr,
                "data",
                &self.data,
                "size",
                &self.size,
                "size_comp",
                &self.size_comp,
                "data_decomp",
                &&self.data_decomp,
            )
        }
    }
    unsafe impl Sync for CompressedDataImpl {}
    unsafe impl Send for CompressedDataImpl {}
    pub struct CompressedDataRef(Arc<CompressedDataImpl>);
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for CompressedDataRef {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> CompressedDataRef {
            CompressedDataRef(::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.0))
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for CompressedDataRef {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                f,
                "CompressedDataRef",
                &&self.0,
            )
        }
    }
    impl Default for CompressedDataRef {
        fn default() -> Self {
            Self(
                Arc::new(CompressedDataImpl {
                    _ptr: BufType::new(),
                    data: NonNull::from_ref(&[]),
                    size: 0,
                    size_comp: 0,
                    data_decomp: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
                }),
            )
        }
    }
    impl CompressedDataRef {
        pub fn from_bytes(
            src: &BufType,
            offset: usize,
            size: usize,
            size_comp: usize,
        ) -> Self {
            let data = if size_comp == 0 {
                &src[offset..offset + size]
            } else {
                &src[offset..offset + size_comp]
            };
            Self(
                Arc::new(CompressedDataImpl {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    data: data.into(),
                    size,
                    size_comp,
                    data_decomp: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
                }),
            )
        }
        pub fn decomp(&self) -> Result<()> {
            let data_comp = unsafe { self.0.data.as_ref() };
            self.0
                .data_decomp
                .set(decompress_block(data_comp, self.0.size_comp, self.0.size)?)
                .ok();
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn get(&self) -> Result<&BufType> {
            let val = self.0.data_decomp.get();
            Ok(
                if val.is_none() {
                    self.decomp()?;
                    self.0.data_decomp.get().unwrap()
                } else {
                    val.unwrap()
                },
            )
        }
    }

    #[automatically_derived]
    impl<'a> ::core::default::Default for CompressedDataRefAlt<'a> {
        #[inline]
        fn default() -> CompressedDataRefAlt<'a> {
            CompressedDataRefAlt {
                data: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                data_decomp: ::core::default::Default::default(),
            }
        }

    impl<'a> CompressedDataRefAlt<'a> {
        pub fn from_data(src: &'a [u8], size_comp: usize, size: usize) -> Self {
            let mut data_decomp = AlignedBuf::with_capacity(size);
            let data = if size_comp == 0 {
                data_decomp.copy_from_slice(&src[..size]);
                &[] as _
            } else {
                &src[..size_comp]
            };
            Self {
                data: data.into(),
                data_decomp,
            }
        }
        pub fn decompress(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
            if self.data.len() != 0 {
                decompress_block_into(
                    &self.data[..],
                    &mut self.data_decomp[..],
                    self.data.len(),
                )?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn get(&self) -> &[u8] {
            &*self.data_decomp
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpCompressedData {
        fn compress(&mut self) -> Result<()>;
        fn size_comp(&self) -> usize;
        fn size(&self) -> usize;
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()>;
    }
    impl DumpCompressedData for &'_ CompressedDataRefAlt<'_> {
        fn compress(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
            Ok(())
        }
        fn size_comp(&self) -> usize {
            self.data.len()
        }
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            self.data_decomp.len()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            (&self.data[..]).dump_into(dst)
        }
    }
